3.151
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava ..
vāsudevāṃśakājjātāḥ sarve devagaṇā nṛpa .. 1 ..
3.31.d:
3.151
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
वासुदेवांशकाज्जाताः सर्वे देवगणा नृप ॥ 1 ॥
3.31.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I will declare another vow of the Four Forms for you. / All the hosts of gods were born from a portion of Vāsudeva, O king.

3.31.s:
adhikena tadaṃśena sādhyā jātāstathāsurāḥ ..
tatrāpi cādhikāṃśena caturātmā hariḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
3.31.d:
अधिकेन तदंशेन साध्या जातास्तथासुराः ॥
तत्रापि चाधिकांशेन चतुरात्मा हरिः स्मृतः ॥ 2 ॥
3.31.m: From a greater portion of him, the Sādhyas and the asuras were born; / even greater than that is the portion by which Hari is considered four-fold in nature:

3.31.s:
naro nārāyaṇaścaiva hayo haṃsaśca vīryavān ..
hayo haririti khyāto haṃsaḥ kṛṣṇaśca kīrtitaḥ .. 3 ..
3.31.d:
नरो नारायणश्चैव हयो हंसश्च वीर्यवान् ॥
हयो हरिरिति ख्यातो हंसः कृष्णश्च कीर्तितः ॥ 3 ॥
3.31.m: Nara, Nārāyaṇa, the powerful Steed, and the Swan; / the Steed is known as Hari, and the Swan is proclaimed as Kṛṣṇa.

3.31.s:
caturātmā hari rjāto gṛhe dharmasya yādava ..
ādityeṣu tathā yukto mitrāvaruṇasaṃjñakau .. 4 ..
3.31.d:
चतुरात्मा हरि र्जातो गृहे धर्मस्य यादव ॥
आदित्येषु तथा युक्तो मित्रावरुणसंज्ञकौ ॥ 4 ॥
3.31.m: Hari was born as four-fold in nature in the house of Dharma, O descendant of Yadu. / Likewise, among the Ādityas, he is joined as the two named Mitra and Varuṇa.

3.31.s:
tāveva sādhyau jānīhi hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca yādava ..
ādityeṣu tu yā yuktau śakraviṣṇū surottamau .. 5 ..
3.31.d:
तावेव साध्यौ जानीहि हरिं कृष्णं च यादव ॥
आदित्येषु तु या युक्तौ शक्रविष्णू सुरोत्तमौ ॥ 5 ॥
3.31.m: Know those two Sādhyas to be Hari and Kṛṣṇa, O descendant of Yadu; / and among the Ādityas, the two best gods Śakra and Viṣṇu are joined.

3.31.s:
tāveva siddhasādhyeṣu naranārāyaṇau punaḥ ..
caitraśuklacaturthyāṃ tu sopavāsastu pūjayet .. 6 ..
3.31.d:
तावेव सिद्धसाध्येषु नरनारायणौ पुनः ॥
चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्थ्यां तु सोपवासस्तु पूजयेत् ॥ 6 ॥
3.31.m: Moreover, among the perfected Sādhyas, those two are Nara and Nārāyaṇa. / Fasting on the fourth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, one should worship

3.31.s:
deveśaṃ caturātmānaṃ vittaśaktyā narādhipa ..
vratametannaraḥ kṛtvā pūrṇaṃ dvādaśavatsaram..
na durgatimavāpnoti mokṣopāyaṃ ca vindati..7..
3.31.d:
देवेशं चतुरात्मानं वित्तशक्त्या नराधिप ॥
व्रतमेतन्नरः कृत्वा पूर्णं द्वादशवत्सरम्॥
न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति मोक्षोपायं च विन्दति॥7॥
3.31.m: the Lord of the gods who has four forms, according to one's wealth, O ruler of men. / A man who performs this vow for twelve full years / does not meet misfortune and finds the means to liberation.

3.31.s:
tataḥ samāsādya ca niṣkalatvaṃ pareṇa puṃsā ca samatvameti ..
sarveśvaraścāpratimaprabhāvo vimuktaduḥkho bhuvanasya goptā .. 8 ..
samāptaṃ caturmūrtivratam ..
3.152
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pañcamūrtestathārcanam ..
pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca .. 1 ..
vāsudevasya devasya kathitāḥ pañcamūrtayaḥ ..
caitre tu pañcamīṃ śuklāṃ samāsādya vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
sopavāso hariṃ devaṃ pañcātmānaṃ samarcayet ..
pañcamaṇḍalagāḥ kāryāḥ pañcabhirvaṇakaiḥ pṛthak .. 3 ..
pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ śukla varṇaṃ mahīpate ..
vāruṇaṃ ca tathā śvetaṃ raktamāgneyamiṣyate .. 4 .. tu. agnipurāṇam adhyāyaḥ 74.18
pītaṃ bhavati vāyavyaṃ kṛṣṇamākāśadaivatam ..
samānavarṇairgaṃdhaistu puṣpaistānarcayetpṛthak .. 5 ..
3.31.d:
ततः समासाद्य च निष्कलत्वं परेण पुंसा च समत्वमेति ॥
सर्वेश्वरश्चाप्रतिमप्रभावो विमुक्तदुःखो भुवनस्य गोप्ता ॥ 8 ॥
समाप्तं चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतम् ॥
3.152
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि पञ्चमूर्तेस्तथार्चनम् ॥
पृथिव्यापस्तथा तेजो वायुराकाशमेव च ॥ 1 ॥
वासुदेवस्य देवस्य कथिताः पञ्चमूर्तयः ॥
चैत्रे तु पञ्चमीं शुक्लां समासाद्य विचक्षणः ॥ 2 ॥
सोपवासो हरिं देवं पञ्चात्मानं समर्चयेत् ॥
पञ्चमण्डलगाः कार्याः पञ्चभिर्वणकैः पृथक् ॥ 3 ॥
पार्थिवं मण्डलं कार्यं शुक्ल वर्णं महीपते ॥
वारुणं च तथा श्वेतं रक्तमाग्नेयमिष्यते ॥ 4 ॥ तु। अग्निपुराणम् अध्यायः 74.18
पीतं भवति वायव्यं कृष्णमाकाशदैवतम् ॥
समानवर्णैर्गंधैस्तु पुष्पैस्तानर्चयेत्पृथक् ॥ 5 ॥
3.31.m:
Then, attaining partlessness, he attains equality with the Supreme Person; / he becomes lord of all, of matchless majesty, free from sorrow, and protector of the world.
The vow of the Four Forms is completed. / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hereafter I shall explain the worship of the Five Forms: / earth, water, fire, wind, and ether.
The five forms of Lord Vāsudeva are thus declared. / Then, reaching the fifth day of the bright fortnight in Caitra, a discerning person,
fasting, should worship Lord Hari, whose self consists of the five [forms]. / Drawn in five sacred diagrams, they should be made separately with five colors.
The earthly sacred diagram is to be made white, O king; / and that of Varuṇa is likewise white; that of Agni is designated red.
That of Vāyu is yellow, and that whose deity is Ākāśa is black. / With perfumes and flowers of matching colors, he should worship them separately,

3.31.s:
śaktyā ca dhūpadīpādyairyathālābhamarindama ..
yavairvānyaistilaiścaiva sarṣapaiśca ghṛtena ca .. 6 ..
pañcabhirjuhuyānmiśraiḥ sarveṣāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak ..
talliṅgairatha mantrairvā tvatha vā nṛpa nāmabhiḥ .. 7..
oṃkārapūrvakairhutvā śaktyā viprām̐stu pūjayet ..
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā pūrṇe saṃvatsare tataḥ .. 8 ..
3.31.d:
शक्त्या च धूपदीपाद्यैर्यथालाभमरिन्दम ॥
यवैर्वान्यैस्तिलैश्चैव सर्षपैश्च घृतेन च ॥ 6 ॥
पञ्चभिर्जुहुयान्मिश्रैः सर्वेषां च पृथक्पृथक् ॥
तल्लिङ्गैरथ मन्त्रैर्वा त्वथ वा नृप नामभिः ॥ 7॥
ओंकारपूर्वकैर्हुत्वा शक्त्या विप्राम्̐स्तु पूजयेत् ॥
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा पूर्णे संवत्सरे ततः ॥ 8 ॥
3.31.m:
and according to his ability with incense, lamps, and the like, as available, O subduer of foes; / and with barley, grains, sesame, mustard, and ghee,
he should sacrifice with these five mixed together, and for all of them separately, / either with the mantras characteristic of them or, O king, with their names.
Having sacrificed with [mantras] preceded by the syllable Om, he should honor the brahmins according to his ability. / Having done so for a year, then, when the year is complete,

3.31.s:
dattvā vipreṣu vastrāṇi devaraṅgasamāni ca ..
mahābhūtavratamidaṃ yaḥ karotyatha pañcakam .. 9 ..
3.31.d:
दत्त्वा विप्रेषु वस्त्राणि देवरङ्गसमानि च ॥
महाभूतव्रतमिदं यः करोत्यथ पञ्चकम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.31.m: giving to the brahmins garments matching the colors of the deities: / he who performs this fivefold observance of the great elements

3.31.s:
pañcayajñamavāpnoti kramaśo ye'nukīrtitā. ..
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate .. 3.152.10 ..
3.31.d:
पञ्चयज्ञमवाप्नोति क्रमशो येऽनुकीर्तिता॥।
बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥ 3.152.10 ॥
3.31.m: attains the [fruit of] the five sacrifices that are celebrated in order. / He is glorified in the heavenly realm for many thousands of years.

3.31.s:
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo balānvito vairigaṇāpahartā ..
śrutena rūpeṇa guṇena yukto janābhirāmaḥ pramadā priyaśca .. 11 ..
3.153
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi pañcamūrtivrataṃ tava ..
saṃvatsaraḥ smṛto vahnistathārkaḥ parivatsaraḥ .. 1 ..
iḍāpūrvastathā soma anupūrvaḥ prajāpatiḥ ..
tatpūrvaśca tathā prokto devadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 2 ..
teṣāṃ maṇḍalavinyāsaiḥ prāgvadeva vidhīyate ..
yāgaśca pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ homaḥ kāryastathāvidhaḥ .. 3 ..
tilavrīhiyavaiścaiva ghṛtena sitasarṣapaiḥ ..
talliṅgairatha vā mantrairnāmabhiḥ pratyahaṃ kramāt .. 4 ..
naktāśanastathā tiṣṭhetprāgvaddivasapañcakam ..
saṃvatsarākhye varṣe tu vratametatsamārabhet .. 5 ..
vratāvasāne dātavyaṃ suvarṇaṃ pañca yādava ..
caturvedavidāṃ deyaṃ śākhābhedena yādava .. 6 ..
3.31.d:
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगो बलान्वितो वैरिगणापहर्ता ॥
श्रुतेन रूपेण गुणेन युक्तो जनाभिरामः प्रमदा प्रियश्च ॥ 11 ॥
3.153
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि पञ्चमूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
संवत्सरः स्मृतो वह्निस्तथार्कः परिवत्सरः ॥ 1 ॥
इडापूर्वस्तथा सोम अनुपूर्वः प्रजापतिः ॥
तत्पूर्वश्च तथा प्रोक्तो देवदेवो महेश्वरः ॥ 2 ॥
तेषां मण्डलविन्यासैः प्राग्वदेव विधीयते ॥
यागश्च पूजनं कार्यं होमः कार्यस्तथाविधः ॥ 3 ॥
तिलव्रीहियवैश्चैव घृतेन सितसर्षपैः ॥
तल्लिङ्गैरथ वा मन्त्रैर्नामभिः प्रत्यहं क्रमात् ॥ 4 ॥
नक्ताशनस्तथा तिष्ठेत्प्राग्वद्दिवसपञ्चकम् ॥
संवत्सराख्ये वर्षे तु व्रतमेतत्समारभेत् ॥ 5 ॥
व्रतावसाने दातव्यं सुवर्णं पञ्च यादव ॥
चतुर्वेदविदां देयं शाखाभेदेन यादव ॥ 6 ॥
3.31.m:
Reaching human birth, he becomes free of disease, endowed with strength, a slayer of hosts of foes, / possessed of learning, beauty, and virtue, delightful to people, and dear to women.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I shall declare to you another observance of the five forms: / Saṃvatsara is remembered as fire; Parivatsara is the sun;
preceded by Iḍā [i.e., Iḍāvatsara] is the moon; preceded by Anu [i.e., Anuvatsara] is Prajāpati; / and preceded by Tat [i.e., Idvatsara] is declared to be the god of gods, Maheśvara.
By arranging their sacred diagrams, [the rite] is enjoined just as before. / Sacrifice and worship are to be performed, and the oblation is to be performed in like manner,
with sesame, unhusked rice, barley, ghee, and white mustard, / either with the mantras characteristic of them or with their names, daily in succession.
He should remain eating only at night, as before, for a period of five days. / He should begin this observance in the year called Saṃvatsara.
At the conclusion of the observance, five [measures of] gold are to be given, O Yādava; / it should be given to knowers of the four Vedas according to the division of their branches, O Yādava.

3.31.s:
ekaikaṃ pañcamaṃ deyaṃ tathā kālavide bhavet ..
aśvamedhaphalaṃ hyetadvrataṃ tava mayeritam .. 7 ..
yatheṣṭaṃ lokamāpnoti kāmacārī vihaṅgamaḥ ..
kṛtaṃ nānena dharmajña pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ.8..
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo varṇena rūpeṇa balena yuktaḥ ..
nṛpaḥ pratāpānataśatrusaṃgho devottamo vā bahuyajñayājī .. 9 ..
3.154
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrīvrataṃ nāma te vratam ..
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ snānamabhyaṅgapūrvakam .. 1 ..
kṛtvā śuklāmbaro rājañśuklamālyānulepanaḥ ..
tiṣṭhed ghṛtaudanāhāro bhūmau svapyācca tāṃ niśām..2..
caturthyāṃ ca tathā snānaṃ bahirgatvā samācareta..
padminyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa tataḥ śuklāmbaraḥ śuciḥ .. 3 ..
lakṣmīṃ sampūjayetpadme kṛtake'kṛtake'pi vā ..
śuklena gandhamālyena ghṛtadīpena cā pyatha .. 4 ..
3.31.d:
एकैकं पञ्चमं देयं तथा कालविदे भवेत् ॥
अश्वमेधफलं ह्येतद्व्रतं तव मयेरितम् ॥ 7 ॥
यथेष्टं लोकमाप्नोति कामचारी विहङ्गमः ॥
कृतं नानेन धर्मज्ञ पूज्यमानः सुरासुरैः.8॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगो वर्णेन रूपेण बलेन युक्तः ॥
नृपः प्रतापानतशत्रुसंघो देवोत्तमो वा बहुयज्ञयाजी ॥ 9 ॥
3.154
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि श्रीव्रतं नाम ते व्रतम् ॥
चैत्रशुक्लतृतीयायां स्नानमभ्यङ्गपूर्वकम् ॥ 1 ॥
कृत्वा शुक्लाम्बरो राजञ्शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनः ॥
तिष्ठेद् घृतौदनाहारो भूमौ स्वप्याच्च तां निशाम्॥2॥
चतुर्थ्यां च तथा स्नानं बहिर्गत्वा समाचरेत॥
पद्मिन्यां च विशेषेण ततः शुक्लाम्बरः शुचिः ॥ 3 ॥
लक्ष्मीं सम्पूजयेत्पद्मे कृतकेऽकृतकेऽपि वा ॥
शुक्लेन गन्धमाल्येन घृतदीपेन चा प्यथ ॥ 4 ॥
3.31.m:
One [measure] each [is given to the four], and the fifth should be given likewise to a knower of time. / This observance yielding the fruit of a horse sacrifice has thus been declared by me to you.
He reaches whichever realm he desires, moving at will like a bird, / honored by gods and demons—[all that] is accomplished by this, O knower of dharma.
Reaching human birth, he becomes free of disease, endowed with high status, beauty, and strength, / a king whose adversaries are bowed by his majesty, or an exalted god, an offerer of many sacrifices.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Now then, I shall declare to you the observance named the observance of Śrī. / On the third day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, having bathed preceded by unction,
dressed in white garments, O king, wearing white garlands and ointments, / he should subsist on food of rice with ghee and sleep on the ground for that night.
On the fourth day, going outside, he should likewise perform a bath, / especially in a lotus pool; then, dressed in white garments and pure,
he should worship Lakṣmī on a lotus, either artificial or natural, / with white perfumes and garlands, and also with a ghee lamp,

3.31.d:
दध्ना च परमान्नेन आर्द्रकेण गुडेन च ॥
इक्षुणेक्षुविकारैश्च लवणेन च भूरिणा ॥ 5 ॥
स्वशक्त्या च महाराज भूयसा बलिक र्मणा ॥
श्रीसूक्तेन ततो वह्नौ पद्मानि जुहुयाच्छुचिः ॥ 6 ॥
तदलाभे च बिल्वानि तदलाभे तथा घृतम्॥
ब्राह्मणान्गोरसप्रायं घृतं भूयिष्ठमाशयेत्॥। 7 ॥
सुवर्णमाषकं दद्याद्ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् ॥
अनाहारस्ततः स्वप्याच्छुचौ देशे यथाविधि ॥ 8 ॥
ततस्तु पञ्चमीं प्राप्य पूर्वाह्णे पद्मिनी जले ॥
स्नात्वा सम्पूजनं कुर्यात्प्राग्वदेव तथा प्रियः ॥ 9 ॥
भूय एव द्विजे दद्यात्पूर्वं कनकमाषकम् ॥
पद्माक्षमथ वा बिल्वं प्राश्नीयात्तदनन्तरम्॥। 3.154.10 ॥
ततो हविष्यमश्नीयाद्वाग्यतो मानवोत्तमः ॥
संवत्सरमिदं बिल्वं प्राश्नीयात्तदनन्तरम् ॥
संवत्सरमिदं कृत्वा व्रतं पार्थिवसत्तम ॥11॥
3.31.m:
and with curd, milk-rice, ginger, molasses, / sugarcane, preparations of sugarcane, and plenty of salt,
and according to his ability, O great king, with abundant offerings. / Then, pure, he should offer lotuses into the fire with the Śrīsūkta.
If that is unavailable, [he should offer] bilva fruits; if that is unavailable, likewise ghee. / He should feed the brahmins [food] consisting mostly of milk and abundant in ghee.
He should give a māṣaka of gold as a sacrificial fee to the brahmins. / Then, without food, he should sleep in a pure place according to the rule.
Then, having reached the fifth day, having bathed in the morning in the water of a lotus pool, / he should perform worship just as before, as beloved [to her].
Once more he should give the aforementioned gold māṣaka to a twice-born. / Immediately thereafter he should eat a lotus seed or a bilva fruit.
Then, keeping silent, that best of men should eat sacrificial food. / For a year [he should eat a bilva fruit; immediately thereafter,] / having performed this observance for a year, O best of kings,

phalamāpnoti vipulaṃ rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ ..
vinā kanakadānena vratametatsamācaret .. 12 ..

3.31.s:

balamuttamamāpnoti rūpamārogyameva ca ..14 .. .
3.31.d:
नित्यमेव श्रियं देवीं श्रियमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
बलमुत्तममाप्नोति रूपमारोग्यमेव च ॥14 ॥ ।
3.31.m: always [worshipping] the goddess Śrī, he obtains unsurpassed fortune; / he obtains excellent strength, beauty, and freedom from disease.

जगत्प्रधाना वरदा वरेण्या विभावरी सर्वगता नरेन्द्र ॥

3.31.m: The foremost of the universe, the granter of boons, the choice one, the luminous, all-pervading one, O lord of men: / he who worships [her] here with faith attains his desires for all time.

इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे तृतीयखण्डे मार्कण्डेयवज्रसंवादे पञ्चमूर्तिविधौ लक्ष्मीव्रतवर्णनो नाम चतुष्पञ्चाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायु॥ 154 ॥
3.155
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अथापरं प्रवक्ष्यामि पञ्चमूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
शङ्खं चक्रं गदां पद्मं पृथिवीं च महाभुज ॥ 1 ॥
गन्धैर्मण्डलकान्कृत्वा पञ्चपञ्चसु पूजयेत् ॥
चैत्रशुक्लान्तमारभ्य पञ्चमीप्रभृतीर्नृप॥2॥
सोपवासो बहिः स्नातस्तथा शुक्लाम्बरः शुचिः ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा॥3॥।
सर्वेषां पूजनं कृत्वा जुहुयाज्जातवेदसि ॥
सर्वेषामेव देवानां नामभिस्तु तथा घृतम् ॥ 4 ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्चात्र तदा मधुरभोजनम् ॥।
संवत्सरमिदं कृत्वा व्रतान्ते वस्त्र पञ्चकम् ॥ 5 ॥
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति पञ्चरात्रविदे ददत् ॥
पञ्चवर्णं च राजेन्द्र राजसूयफलं लभेत् ॥ 6 ॥
3.31.m:
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Observance of Lakṣmī in the Rule of the Five Forms,' in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra in the third book of the glorious Viṣṇudharmottara.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Now I shall declare to you another observance of the five forms: / the conch, the discus, the mace, the lotus, and the earth, O mighty-armed one.
Having made diagrams with perfumes, he should worship the five on five [days], / beginning from the end of the bright fortnight of Caitra, starting with the fifth day, O king.
Fasting, bathed outside, likewise dressed in white garments, pure, / with perfumes, garlands, obeisance, incense, lamps, and an abundance of food,
having performed worship of all, he should offer into the fire / ghee with the names of all the deities.
And here he should feed brahmins sweet food at that time. / Having performed this for a year, at the end of the observance [he should give] five garments.
Giving [garments] of five colours to one who knows the Pañcarātra, O king of kings, / he attains [the fruit of] an Aśvamedha and obtains the fruit of a Rājasūya.

mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo balānvito dharmaparo vinītaḥ ..
dhanena rūpeṇa sukhena yukto rājādhirājo'pyatha vā narendraḥ .. 7 ..

मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगो बलान्वितो धर्मपरो विनीतः ॥
धनेन रूपेण सुखेन युक्तो राजाधिराजोऽप्यथ वा नरेन्द्रः ॥ 7 ॥
3.31.m: Attaining human birth, he becomes free from disease, endowed with strength, devoted to dharma, humble, / possessed of wealth, beauty, and happiness, an emperor or a ruler of men.

3.32.s:

3.156
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि षण्मूर्तेरर्चनं तव ॥

3.32.m: 3.156 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Now I shall explain to you the worship of the Six Forms: / In spring, one should regularly worship during the two months Madhu and Mādhava.

phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kaṣāyaistu grīṣmegrīṣme ca pūjayet ..

मधुरेण महाराज प्रावृट्काले हिते च तम् ॥2 ॥
3.32.m: And in every summer one should worship with astringent fruits and flowers; / in the rainy season, O great king, [worship] him beneficially with sweet [substances].

3.32.s:

अम्लेन पूजयेन्नित्यं शरदं लवणेन च॥
बटुकेन च हेमन्ते तिक्तेन शिशिरे तथा ॥3॥
3.32.m: In autumn one should constantly worship with sour and salty [substances], / in winter with pungent, and likewise in the cold season with bitter.

3.32.s:
naktāśanastathā tiṣṭhedṛtūktaṃ varjayedrasam ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayeccātra ṛtūktaṃ rasabhojanam.. .. 4 ..

ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्चात्र ऋतूक्तं रसभोजनम्॥ ॥ 4 ॥
3.32.m: He should eat only at night and abstain from the flavour prescribed for that season; / and here he should feed brahmins a meal containing the flavour prescribed for that season.

3.32.m: Having performed this supreme, purifying observance for a year, / he attains [the fruit of] an Aśvamedha and obtains [the fruit of] a Rājasūya.

3.32.s:
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..

फलमक्षय्यमाप्नोति व्रतस्यास्य नरोत्तम ॥ 6 ॥
3.32.m: He attains all desires; no doubt should be entertained on this point. / O best of men, he obtains the imperishable fruit of this observance.

caitrādathārabhya site ca ṣaṣṭhīṃ saṃpūjayedyo ṛtuṣaṭkamevam ..
kṛtopavāsastu yathoktametatphalaṃ labhetpūrṇamitīdamuktam .. 7 ..

mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..

caitramāsādathārabhya pratipatprabhṛti kramāt .. 1 ...

kravyādānupahūtām̐śca ājyapāṃśca sukālinaḥ .. 2 ..

naivedyaṃ kṛsaraṃ kuryāttilānagnau ca homayet .. 3 ..

naktāśanastathā tiṣṭheddhaviṣyāśī narādhipa ..4..

vratāvasāne dadyācca rajatasya palaṃ dvije ..5..

3.32.d:
चैत्रादथारभ्य सिते च षष्ठीं संपूजयेद्यो ऋतुषट्कमेवम् ॥
कृतोपवासस्तु यथोक्तमेतत्फलं लभेत्पूर्णमितीदमुक्तम् ॥ 7 ॥
3.157
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सप्तमूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
चैत्रमासादथारभ्य प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥ 1 ॥।
सुभास्वरा वर्हिषदो ह्यग्निष्वात्तास्तथैव च ॥
क्रव्यादानुपहूताम्̐श्च आज्यपांश्च सुकालिनः ॥ 2 ॥
पूजयेत्प्रत्यहं राजन्गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
नैवेद्यं कृसरं कुर्यात्तिलानग्नौ च होमयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
कृसरं भोजयेद्विप्रांस्तिलान्दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् ॥
नक्ताशनस्तथा तिष्ठेद्धविष्याशी नराधिप ॥4॥
संवत्सरमिदं कृत्वा व्रतं पुरुषसत्तम ॥
व्रतावसाने दद्याच्च रजतस्य पलं द्विजे ॥5॥
व्रतेनानेन चीर्णेन सूर्यलोकगतिर्भवेत् ॥
त्रिदशैः पूज्यमानस्तु कामचारी विहङ्गमः ॥ 6॥
3.32.m:
Beginning from Caitra, on the sixth lunar day of the bright fortnight, whoever thus worships the six seasons / having fasted as prescribed, obtains this complete fruit, so it is declared.
3.157 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hereafter I shall explain to you the observance of the Seven Forms, / beginning from the month of Caitra, from the first day onwards in due order:
The Subhāsvaras, Barhiṣads, and likewise the Agniṣvāttas, / the Kravyāds, Upahūtas, Ājyapas, and Sukālins—
he should worship [them] daily, O king, with perfumes, garlands, and unguents; / he should offer kṛsara as an oblation, and offer sesame seeds into the fire.
He should feed the brahmins kṛsara and give sesame seeds as a sacrificial fee; / he should eat only at night, eating sacrificial food, O lord of men.
Having performed this observance for a year, O best of men, / at the conclusion of the observance he should give a pala of silver to a twice-born.
By the performance of this observance, he attains the world of the sun, / honoured by the gods, moving at will as a celestial bird.

3.32.s:
varṣaṃ samagraṃ puruṣastu kṛtvā saṃsāramokṣaṃ labhate narendra..
kṛtvā tathā dvādaśavatsarāṇi mānuṣyamāsādya mahīpatiḥ syāt ..7..
3.158
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
caitramāsādathārabhya kṛṣṇapakṣadine dine ..
pātālapūjanaṃ kuryātpratipatprabhṛti kramāt ..1..
rukmabhaumaṃ tathā bhaumaṃ pātālaṃ nīlamṛttikam ..
raktabhaumaṃ pītabhaumaṃ śvetakṛṣṇamṛdāvapi..2..

ghṛtadīpapradānena vahnisantarpaṇena ca .. 3 ..

vratametannaraḥ kṛtvā nṛṇāmadhipatirbhavet ..5..

3.32.d:
वर्षं समग्रं पुरुषस्तु कृत्वा संसारमोक्षं लभते नरेन्द्र॥
कृत्वा तथा द्वादशवत्सराणि मानुष्यमासाद्य महीपतिः स्यात् ॥7॥
3.158
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
चैत्रमासादथारभ्य कृष्णपक्षदिने दिने ॥
पातालपूजनं कुर्यात्प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥1॥
रुक्मभौमं तथा भौमं पातालं नीलमृत्तिकम् ॥
रक्तभौमं पीतभौमं श्वेतकृष्णमृदावपि॥2॥
सुवर्णैर्गन्धमाल्यैश्च नैवेद्येन च भूरिणा ॥
घृतदीपप्रदानेन वह्निसन्तर्पणेन च ॥ 3 ॥
एवं नक्ताशनं कृत्वा व्रतं संवत्सरं तदा ॥
व्रतावसाने दद्याच्च दीपकं द्विजवेश्मसु ॥ 4 ॥
स तु वस्त्राणि राजेन्द्र यथावर्णानि चाप्यथ ॥
व्रतमेतन्नरः कृत्वा नृणामधिपतिर्भवेत् ॥5॥
पतिं लभन्ते नर देवकन्याः शतसहस्रशः ॥
रमयन्ति महाराज यथैवेडविडस्तथा॥6॥
3.32.m:
A man, having performed [it] for a whole year, obtains liberation from worldly existence, O ruler of men; / having performed it for twelve years, on attaining human birth he would become a ruler of the earth.
3.158 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Beginning from the month of Caitra, day by day in the dark fortnight, / one should worship the netherworlds from the first day onwards in due order:
the golden-earthed, the [bare-]earthed netherworld, the blue-soiled, / the red-earthed, the yellow-earthed, as well as the white- and black-soiled,
with gold, perfumes, garlands, abundant offerings of food, / with the presentation of ghee-lamps, and with the propitiation of fire.
Having thus observed the vow for a year, eating only at night, / at the conclusion of the observance he should present lamps in the homes of the twice-born,
and also garments according to their colours, O king of kings. / Having performed this observance, a man becomes a lord of men.
By hundreds and thousands divine maidens obtain him as their husband / and delight him, O great king, just like [the son of] Iḍaviḍā.

caitraśuklādathārabhya pratyahaṃ dinasaptakam .. 1 ..
jambuśākakuśakrauñcaśālmalidvīpasaṃjñitam ..
gomedaṃ puṣkaraṃ caiva pratyahaṃ pūjayetkramāt .. 2..
nityameva tathā snānaṃ bahireva samācaret ..
ghṛtena homaṃ kurvīta saptasasyaṃ ca dāpayet .. 3..
ekamannaṃ tathā naktaṃ sakṛdeva samācaret ..
adhaḥśāyī bhavennityaṃ taddeve divasatrayam ..4..
pūrṇe saṃvatsare dadyādrajatasya vinirmitam ..
palānāntu śatenaiva saṃsthānaṃ dvīpavatkṛtam .. 5 ..
vratametannaraḥ kṛtvā pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ śuciḥ ..
svargalokamavāpnoti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 6 ..
3.32.d:
कालेन चासाद्य मनुष्यलोकं राजा भवेच्छत्रुगणप्रमाथी॥
बलेन रूपेण धनेन युक्तो महामतिः सर्वजगत्प्रधानः॥7॥
3.159
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि सप्तद्वीपव्रतं शुभम् ॥
चैत्रशुक्लादथारभ्य प्रत्यहं दिनसप्तकम् ॥ 1 ॥
जम्बुशाककुशक्रौञ्चशाल्मलिद्वीपसंज्ञितम् ॥
गोमेदं पुष्करं चैव प्रत्यहं पूजयेत्क्रमात् ॥ 2॥
नित्यमेव तथा स्नानं बहिरेव समाचरेत् ॥
घृतेन होमं कुर्वीत सप्तसस्यं च दापयेत् ॥ 3॥
एकमन्नं तथा नक्तं सकृदेव समाचरेत् ॥
अधःशायी भवेन्नित्यं तद्देवे दिवसत्रयम् ॥4॥
पूर्णे संवत्सरे दद्याद्रजतस्य विनिर्मितम् ॥
पलानान्तु शतेनैव संस्थानं द्वीपवत्कृतम् ॥ 5 ॥
व्रतमेतन्नरः कृत्वा पूर्णं संवत्सरं शुचिः ॥
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.32.m:
And in course of time, attaining the world of men, he becomes a king who crushes the host of his foes, / endowed with strength, beauty, and wealth, of great intellect, foremost in all the world.
3.159 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Now I shall explain to you the auspicious observance of the seven continents: / beginning from the bright fortnight of Caitra, day by day for seven days,
named Jambu, Śāka, Kuśa, Krauñca, Śālmali, / Gomeda, and Puṣkara—he should worship them day by day in due order.
He should always bathe outside [the house], / offer oblations of ghee into the fire, and give the seven grains.
He should take only one single meal at night, / and should constantly sleep on the ground for three days dedicated to that deity.
When the year is completed, he should give a representation made of silver, / weighing a hundred palas, shaped like a continent.
A man who performs this observance pure for a full year / attains the heavenly world until the dissolution of all beings.

3.32.s:
mānuṣyamāsādya samastadvīpānbhunakti bhūmiṃ vijitāripakṣaḥ ..
saṃpūjyamānastridaśaiḥ sadaiva maharṣibhirbrāhmaṇapuṅgavaiśca .. 7 ..
3.160
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi samudravratameva te ..
caitraśuklādathārabhya pratyahaṃ divasatrayam .. 1 ..
lavaṇakṣīraājyaughadadhimaṇḍasurodakam ..
tathaivekṣusurodaṃ ca svādūdaṃ caiva pūjayet .. 2 ..
ācaretpratyahaṃ snānaṃ nityameva gṛhādbahiḥ ..
ghṛtena homaṃ kurvīta saptasasyaṃ ca dāpayet .. 3 ..
haviṣyāśī bhavennaktaṃ kuryātsaṃvatsaraṃ vratam ..
saṃvatsarānte dadyācca tathā dhenuṃ payasvinīm .. 4 ..
vratenānena cīrṇena saptasāgaramekhalām ..
bhunakti vasudhāṃ rājā saptajanmāntarāṇi ca .. 5 ..
ārogyakāmaḥ kurvīta vratametattathottamam ..
dharmakāmo yaśaḥkāmaḥ śrīkāmaśca tathāparaḥ .. 6 ..
3.32.d:
मानुष्यमासाद्य समस्तद्वीपान्भुनक्ति भूमिं विजितारिपक्षः ॥
संपूज्यमानस्त्रिदशैः सदैव महर्षिभिर्ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवैश्च ॥ 7 ॥
3.160
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि समुद्रव्रतमेव ते ॥
चैत्रशुक्लादथारभ्य प्रत्यहं दिवसत्रयम् ॥ 1 ॥
लवणक्षीरआज्यौघदधिमण्डसुरोदकम् ॥
तथैवेक्षुसुरोदं च स्वादूदं चैव पूजयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
आचरेत्प्रत्यहं स्नानं नित्यमेव गृहाद्बहिः ॥
घृतेन होमं कुर्वीत सप्तसस्यं च दापयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
हविष्याशी भवेन्नक्तं कुर्यात्संवत्सरं व्रतम् ॥
संवत्सरान्ते दद्याच्च तथा धेनुं पयस्विनीम् ॥ 4 ॥
व्रतेनानेन चीर्णेन सप्तसागरमेखलाम् ॥
भुनक्ति वसुधां राजा सप्तजन्मान्तराणि च ॥ 5 ॥
आरोग्यकामः कुर्वीत व्रतमेतत्तथोत्तमम् ॥
धर्मकामो यशःकामः श्रीकामश्च तथापरः ॥ 6 ॥
3.32.m:
Attaining human birth, having conquered his enemies, he enjoys the earth with all its continents, / constantly worshipped by the gods, the great sages, and the foremost among brahmins.
3.160 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Now I shall explain to you the observance of the oceans: / beginning from the bright fortnight of Caitra, day by day for three days,
one should worship [the oceans of] salt, milk, flood of clarified butter, curd-scum, wine, / and likewise sugarcane juice and sweet water.
He should always take his daily bath outside his house, / offer oblations of ghee into the fire, and give the seven grains.
He should eat sacrificial food at night and maintain the observance for a year; / and at the end of the year he should give a milch cow.
By the performance of this observance, he becomes a king who enjoys the earth / girdled by the seven oceans for seven successive births.
One desirous of health should observe this supreme observance, / as should one desirous of dharma, one desirous of fame, or another desirous of fortune.

3.32.s:
maṅgalyametatparamaṃ pavitraṃ śrīvardhanaṃ dharmavivṛddhikāri ..
kartavyametatprayatairmanuṣyairye rājyakāmāstu viśeṣatastaiḥ ..7..
3.32.d:
मङ्गल्यमेतत्परमं पवित्रं श्रीवर्धनं धर्मविवृद्धिकारि ॥
कर्तव्यमेतत्प्रयतैर्मनुष्यैर्ये राज्यकामास्तु विशेषतस्तैः ॥7॥
3.32.m: This is auspicious, supremely purifying, prosperity-enhancing, and causing the increase of dharma; / it must be performed by restrained men, and especially by those who desire kingdom.

3.33.s:
3.161
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tava śailavrataṃ śubham ..
mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣavānapi .. 1 ..
3.33.d:
3.161
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि तव शैलव्रतं शुभम् ॥
महेन्द्रो मलयः सह्यः शुक्तिमानृक्षवानपि ॥ 1 ॥
3.33.m: 3.161 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Now next I shall proclaim to you the auspicious mountain observance: / Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Śuktimān, and Ṛkṣavān,

3.33.s:
vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptaite kulaparvatāḥ ..
caitraśuklasamārambhātpratyahaṃ dinasaptakam..2..
3.33.d:
विन्ध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च सप्तैते कुलपर्वताः ॥
चैत्रशुक्लसमारम्भात्प्रत्यहं दिनसप्तकम्॥2॥
3.33.m: Vindhya, and Pāriyātra—these are the seven clan-mountains. / Beginning from the bright [fortnight] of Caitra, daily for seven days,

3.33.s:
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kuryādbahiḥ snānaṃ samācaret ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā .. 3 ..
3.33.d:
तेषां संपूजनं कुर्याद्बहिः स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥ 3 ॥
3.33.m: one should worship them, and bathe outdoors, / with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, salutations, incense, lamps, and food.

3.33.s:
yavairhomastathā kāryo dadyādvipreṣu dakṣiṇām ..
naktaṃ yavānnamaśnīyātkuryātsaṃvatsaraṃ vratam .. 4..
3.33.d:
यवैर्होमस्तथा कार्यो दद्याद्विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् ॥
नक्तं यवान्नमश्नीयात्कुर्यात्संवत्सरं व्रतम् ॥ 4॥
3.33.m: Likewise, an oblation should be made with barley, and one should give a sacrificial fee to brahmins; / at night one should eat barley-food, and observe the observance for a year.

3.33.s:
vratāvasāne dadyācca yavasthālīśca viṃśatim ..
vācakāya dvijendrāya suvarṇaṃ gāṃ ca tasya tu.. 5 ..
3.33.d:
व्रतावसाने दद्याच्च यवस्थालीश्च विंशतिम् ॥
वाचकाय द्विजेन्द्राय सुवर्णं गां च तस्य तु॥ 5 ॥
3.33.m: At the conclusion of the observance, one should give twenty pots of barley, / and to the reciter, an eminent twice-born, gold and a cow.

3.33.s:
dratenānena cīrṇena sarvāṃ sāgaramekhalām ..
bhunakti vasudhāṃ rājā vaśīkṛtvā ripūnnṛpa .. 6 ..
3.33.d:
द्रतेनानेन चीर्णेन सर्वां सागरमेखलाम् ॥
भुनक्ति वसुधां राजा वशीकृत्वा रिपून्नृप ॥ 6 ॥
3.33.m: O king, by performing this observance, having subdued his enemies, / a king enjoys the earth that has the ocean as its girdle.

3.33.s:
bhogāṃśca bhuktvā tridive ca rājanmānuṣyamāsādya yathoktametat ..
prāpnoti sarvaṃ hi mayeritaṃ yajjanmāntarāṇyeva narendra sapta .. 7 ..
3.162
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tava lokavrataṃ śubham ..
yāstu vyāhatayaḥ sapta trailokyāṃ tu prakīrtitāḥ .. .. 1 ..
ācaretpratyahaṃ snānaṃ bahirnityamatandritaḥ ..
caitraśuklādathārabhya krameṇa dinasaptakam .. 2 ..
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam ..
ekarātropavāsaśca krameṇaivaṃ samācaret .. 3 ..
mahāvyāhatibhirhomastilaiḥ kāryo dinedine ..
saṃvatsarānte dadyācca tathā vipreṣu dakṣiṇām .. 4 ..
suvarṇamahataṃ vāsaḥ kāṃsyaṃ dhenuṃ payasvinīm ..
saṃvatsaramidaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ puruṣasattama.. 5 ..
sarva lokacaraḥ śrīmānsvecchayā syānnarādhipa ..
yāvatkalpāvasānaṃ tu kalpādau pārthivo bhavet .. 6 ..
3.33.d:
भोगांश्च भुक्त्वा त्रिदिवे च राजन्मानुष्यमासाद्य यथोक्तमेतत् ॥
प्राप्नोति सर्वं हि मयेरितं यज्जन्मान्तराण्येव नरेन्द्र सप्त ॥ 7 ॥
3.162
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि तव लोकव्रतं शुभम् ॥
यास्तु व्याहतयः सप्त त्रैलोक्यां तु प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ ॥ 1 ॥
आचरेत्प्रत्यहं स्नानं बहिर्नित्यमतन्द्रितः ॥
चैत्रशुक्लादथारभ्य क्रमेण दिनसप्तकम् ॥ 2 ॥
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् ॥
एकरात्रोपवासश्च क्रमेणैवं समाचरेत् ॥ 3 ॥
महाव्याहतिभिर्होमस्तिलैः कार्यो दिनेदिने ॥
संवत्सरान्ते दद्याच्च तथा विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् ॥ 4 ॥
सुवर्णमहतं वासः कांस्यं धेनुं पयस्विनीम् ॥
संवत्सरमिदं कृत्वा व्रतं पुरुषसत्तम॥ 5 ॥
सर्व लोकचरः श्रीमान्स्वेच्छया स्यान्नराधिप ॥
यावत्कल्पावसानं तु कल्पादौ पार्थिवो भवेत् ॥ 6 ॥
3.33.m:
And having enjoyed pleasures in heaven, O king, and attained human birth as described, / he obtains all that has been proclaimed by me, O ruler of men, for seven successive lives.
3.162 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Beyond this, I shall proclaim to you the auspicious world-observance: / those seven sacred utterances that are renowned in the three worlds—
one should perform an outdoor bath daily, constantly unwearied, / beginning from the bright [fortnight] of Caitra, in order for seven days.
Cow urine, cow dung, milk, curd, clarified butter, water with kuśa grass, / and fasting for one night—one should observe [these] in this very order.
Day after day, an oblation of sesame seeds should be made with the great sacred utterances; / and at the end of the year, one should likewise give a sacrificial fee to brahmins:
gold, an unbleached garment, bronze, and a milch cow. / Having performed this observance for a year, O best of men,
one becomes prosperous and moves through all worlds at will, O lord of men, / until the end of the aeon; and at the beginning of an aeon, he becomes an earthly king.

3.33.s:
sa cakravartī nṛpavaryapūjyaḥ surāsurāṇāmadhikaprabhāvaḥ ..
saṃvatsarāṇāmayutaṃ śatānāṃ sampāti pṛthvīṃ sakalābhirāmaḥ .. 7 ..
3.163
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
caitraśuklādathārabhya pratyahaṃ dinasaptakam ..
hlādinīṃ hrādinīṃ caiva pāvanīṃ caiva pūjayet .. 1 ..
sītāṃ rāmaṃ tathā sindhuṃ tathā bhāgīrathīṃ kramāt ..
bahiḥsnānaṃ tataḥ kuryānnityaṃ naktāśano bhavet .. 2 ..
jale tu juhuyātkṣīraṃ tāsāṃ nāmnā dinedine ..
kṣīrapūrṇā ca dātavyā vāridhānyo dvijātiṣu .. 3 ..
kṣīrāśanastu tiṣṭhettu tattathā dinasaptakam ..
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā pūrṇe saṃvatsare naraḥ .. 4..
dvijātiṣu tato dadyādrajatasya palaṃpalam ..
phālgunasya site pakṣe saptamyāṃ divasa kramāt .. 5 ..
tallokamāpnoti naro yatra pāyasakardamam ..
nadyaḥ kṣīravahā divyāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ..6..
3.33.d:
स चक्रवर्ती नृपवर्यपूज्यः सुरासुराणामधिकप्रभावः ॥
संवत्सराणामयुतं शतानां सम्पाति पृथ्वीं सकलाभिरामः ॥ 7 ॥
3.163
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
चैत्रशुक्लादथारभ्य प्रत्यहं दिनसप्तकम् ॥
ह्लादिनीं ह्रादिनीं चैव पावनीं चैव पूजयेत् ॥ 1 ॥
सीतां रामं तथा सिन्धुं तथा भागीरथीं क्रमात् ॥
बहिःस्नानं ततः कुर्यान्नित्यं नक्ताशनो भवेत् ॥ 2 ॥
जले तु जुहुयात्क्षीरं तासां नाम्ना दिनेदिने ॥
क्षीरपूर्णा च दातव्या वारिधान्यो द्विजातिषु ॥ 3 ॥
क्षीराशनस्तु तिष्ठेत्तु तत्तथा दिनसप्तकम् ॥
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा पूर्णे संवत्सरे नरः ॥ 4॥
द्विजातिषु ततो दद्याद्रजतस्य पलंपलम् ॥
फाल्गुनस्य सिते पक्षे सप्तम्यां दिवस क्रमात् ॥ 5 ॥
तल्लोकमाप्नोति नरो यत्र पायसकर्दमम् ॥
नद्यः क्षीरवहा दिव्याः सर्वकामफलप्रदाः॥6॥
3.33.m:
A universal emperor worshipped by the best of kings, having power superior to gods and demons, / pleasing to all, he protects the earth for ten million years.
3.163 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Beginning from the bright [fortnight] of Caitra, daily for seven days, / one should worship Hlādinī, Hrādinī, and Pāvanī,
Sītā, Rāma, Sindhu, and Bhāgīrathī in order. / Then one should bathe outdoors and constantly eat at night.
Day after day, one should offer milk into water in their names, / and water-vessels filled with milk should be given to the twice-born.
One should subsist on milk in that manner for seven days. / Having done this for a year, when the year is completed, a man
should then give pala by pala of silver to the twice-born, / in the bright fortnight of Phālguna, in order of the days up to the seventh.
A man attains that world where the mud is sweet rice-milk, / where divine rivers flow with milk, granting the fruits of all desires.

3.33.s:
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ mahātmā mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogaḥ..
rūpeṇa śīlena dhanena yukto rājātha vā brāhmaṇapuṅgavaśca..7..

.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
caitraśuklādathārabhya pratyahaṃ dinasaptakam ..
suprabhāṃ kāñcanākṣīṃ ca viśālāṃ mānasaṃ hradam .. 1 ..
tāṃ trinādāṃ suveṇuṃ ca tathaiva vimalodakām ..
nityaṃ saṃpūjayedbhaktyā bahiḥ snānaṃ samācaret .. 2 ..
tāsāṃ ca pratyahaṃ nāmnā dadhnā homaṃ samācaret ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayeccātra dadhnā miśraṃ ca bhojanam .. 3 ..
ghṛtaudanaṃ tathāśnīyātsakṛdeva tathā niśi ..
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā pūrṇe saṃvatsare naraḥ .. 4 ..
phālgunāmalapakṣe tu pratyahaṃ divasakramāt ..
vastrāṇāṃ saptakaṃ dadyāttīrthasnāte dvijottame .. 5 ..
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ sārasvataṃ japet ..
tatroṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ manuṣyo jāyate tadā .. 6 ..
3.33.d:
तत्रोष्य कालं सुचिरं महात्मा मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगः॥
रूपेण शीलेन धनेन युक्तो राजाथ वा ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवश्च॥7॥
3.164
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
चैत्रशुक्लादथारभ्य प्रत्यहं दिनसप्तकम् ॥
सुप्रभां काञ्चनाक्षीं च विशालां मानसं ह्रदम् ॥ 1 ॥
तां त्रिनादां सुवेणुं च तथैव विमलोदकाम् ॥
नित्यं संपूजयेद्भक्त्या बहिः स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥ 2 ॥
तासां च प्रत्यहं नाम्ना दध्ना होमं समाचरेत् ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्चात्र दध्ना मिश्रं च भोजनम् ॥ 3 ॥
घृतौदनं तथाश्नीयात्सकृदेव तथा निशि ॥
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा पूर्णे संवत्सरे नरः ॥ 4 ॥
फाल्गुनामलपक्षे तु प्रत्यहं दिवसक्रमात् ॥
वस्त्राणां सप्तकं दद्यात्तीर्थस्नाते द्विजोत्तमे ॥ 5 ॥
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा व्रतं सारस्वतं जपेत् ॥
तत्रोष्य सुचिरं कालं मनुष्यो जायते तदा ॥ 6 ॥
3.33.m:
Having dwelt there for a very long time, that great-souled one attains human birth and becomes free from disease, / endowed with beauty, good character, and wealth, a king or an eminent brahmin.
3.164 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Beginning from the bright [fortnight] of Caitra, daily for seven days, / [one should worship] Suprabhā, Kāñcanākṣī, Viśālā, Lake Mānasa,
Trinādā, Suveṇu, and likewise Vimalodakā. / One should constantly worship them with devotion and bathe outdoors.
And day after day one should perform an oblation of curd in their names; / and here one should feed brahmins food mixed with curd.
Likewise, one should eat rice cooked with clarified butter only once, at night. / Having done this for a year, when the year is completed, a man
should give seven garments in the bright fortnight of Phālguna daily, in order of the days, / to an eminent twice-born who has bathed in a sacred bathing place.
Having observed the Sarasvatī observance thus for a year, one should recite [mantras]. / Having dwelt there for a very long time, a human is then born.

3.33.s:
tadā narendro vijitāripakṣo dvijottamo vā bahu yajñayājī ..
rūpeṇa śīlena dhanena yuktaḥ śrutānvitaḥ syācca janābhirāmaḥ ..7..
3.165
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
caitraśuklādathārabhya pratyahaṃ dinasaptakam ..
marīcimatryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum .. 1 ..
vasiṣṭhaṃ ca mahābhāga pūjayeddivasakramāt ..
kālodbhavaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpairgorasaiśca pṛthakpṛthak .. 2 ..
ācaretpratyahaṃ snānaṃ bahirnaktāśano bhavet ..
mahāvyāhṛtibhirhomaṃ phalairmūlaiḥ sagorasaiḥ .. 3 ..
vāridhānyaśca dātavyāḥ kṣīrapūrṇā dvijātiṣu ..
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vratānte cāhitāgnaye ..4..
dadyātkṛṣṇājinaṃ rājanyathāpūrvaṃ mayeritam ..
vratametannaraḥ kṛtvā mokṣopāyaṃ ca vindati .. 5 ..
mokṣopāyaṃ samāsādya mokṣaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam ..6..
3.33.d:
तदा नरेन्द्रो विजितारिपक्षो द्विजोत्तमो वा बहु यज्ञयाजी ॥
रूपेण शीलेन धनेन युक्तः श्रुतान्वितः स्याच्च जनाभिरामः ॥7॥
3.165
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
चैत्रशुक्लादथारभ्य प्रत्यहं दिनसप्तकम् ॥
मरीचिमत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् ॥ 1 ॥
वसिष्ठं च महाभाग पूजयेद्दिवसक्रमात् ॥
कालोद्भवैः फलैः पुष्पैर्गोरसैश्च पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 2 ॥
आचरेत्प्रत्यहं स्नानं बहिर्नक्ताशनो भवेत् ॥
महाव्याहृतिभिर्होमं फलैर्मूलैः सगोरसैः ॥ 3 ॥
वारिधान्यश्च दातव्याः क्षीरपूर्णा द्विजातिषु ॥
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा व्रतान्ते चाहिताग्नये ॥4॥
दद्यात्कृष्णाजिनं राजन्यथापूर्वं मयेरितम् ॥
व्रतमेतन्नरः कृत्वा मोक्षोपायं च विन्दति ॥ 5 ॥
मोक्षोपायं समासाद्य मोक्षं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥6॥
3.33.m:
Then he becomes a king who has conquered enemy factions, or an eminent twice-born who has performed many sacrifices, / endowed with beauty, good character, and wealth, possessed of sacred learning, and pleasing to the people.
3.165 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Beginning from the bright [fortnight] of Caitra, daily for seven days, / [one should worship] Marīci, Atri and Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu,
and Vasiṣṭha, O highly fortunate one, in order of the days, / individually with seasonal fruits, flowers, and dairy products.
One should bathe outdoors daily and eat at night, / offering an oblation with the great sacred utterances using fruits, roots, and dairy products.
And water-vessels filled with milk should be given to the twice-born. / Having done this for a year, at the end of the observance, to one who maintains the sacred fire,
O king, one should give a black antelope skin as previously stated by me. / Having performed this observance, a man finds the means to liberation;
having attained the means to liberation, he undoubtedly attains liberation.

3.33.s:
prāpnoti lokaṃ yadi vā munīnāṃ devasya viṣṇoryadi veśvarasya ..
pitāmahasyāpratimasya vāpi vratena cīrṇena mahānubhāva .. 7 ..
3.33.d:
प्राप्नोति लोकं यदि वा मुनीनां देवस्य विष्णोर्यदि वेश्वरस्य ॥
पितामहस्याप्रतिमस्य वापि व्रतेन चीर्णेन महानुभाव ॥ 7 ॥
3.33.m: Or else he attains the realm of the sages, or of the god Viṣṇu, or of the Lord, / or even of peerless Brahmā, by performing this vow, O noble one.

3.33.s: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare tṛtīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde saptarṣivratavarṇano nāma pañcaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..165.. ..
3.33.d: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे तृतीयखण्डे मार्कण्डेयवज्रसंवादे सप्तर्षिव्रतवर्णनो नाम पञ्चषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ॥165॥ ॥
3.33.m: Thus ends the one hundred sixty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Saptarṣi Vow', in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the third book of the venerable Viṣṇudharmottara.

3.34.s:
3.166
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
caitraśuklasya pakṣe tu samyak ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣitaḥ ..
saptamyāmarcanaṃ kuryānmarutāṃ pārthivottama .. 1 ..
3.34.d:
3.166
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
चैत्रशुक्लस्य पक्षे तु सम्यक् षष्ठ्यामुपोषितः ॥
सप्तम्यामर्चनं कुर्यान्मरुतां पार्थिवोत्तम ॥ 1 ॥
3.34.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having fasted properly on the sixth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, / one should worship the Maruts on the seventh day, O foremost of kings.

3.34.s:
saptaśreṇīgataṃ saptamaṇḍalaṃ nṛpa kārayet ..
śreṇīśreṇī tathā kāryā saptamaṇḍalakānvitā .. 2 ..
3.34.d:
सप्तश्रेणीगतं सप्तमण्डलं नृप कारयेत् ॥
श्रेणीश्रेणी तथा कार्या सप्तमण्डलकान्विता ॥ 2 ॥
3.34.m: O king, one should cause to be made seven sacred diagrams arranged in seven rows; / likewise, each row should be made containing seven sacred diagrams.

3.34.s:
gandhairmaṇḍalakāḥ kāryā nāmacihnāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
ekajyotiśca dvijyotistrijyotiśca mahābala .. 3 ..
3.34.d:
गन्धैर्मण्डलकाः कार्या नामचिह्नाः पृथक्पृथक् ॥
एकज्योतिश्च द्विज्योतिस्त्रिज्योतिश्च महाबल ॥ 3 ॥
3.34.m: The sacred diagrams should be drawn with fragrant pastes, each with individual name-marks: / Ekajyotis, Dvijyotis, Trijyotis, O mighty one,

3.34.s:
ekadvitricatuḥśaktikrameṇa ca tathā nṛpa ..
vinyasetprathamaṃ śreṇyāṃ yathāvannṛpasattama .. 4 ..
3.34.d:
एकद्वित्रिचतुःशक्तिक्रमेण च तथा नृप ॥
विन्यसेत्प्रथमं श्रेण्यां यथावन्नृपसत्तम ॥ 4 ॥
3.34.m: and in the order of Ekajyotiḥ, Dvijyotiḥ, Trijyotiḥ, and Caturjyotiḥ, O king; / one should ritually place them duly in the first row, O best of kings.

3.34.s:
indraśca gatyā dṛśyaśca tataḥ pratiśakṛttathā ..
mitaśca samitaścaiva amitaśca mahābalaḥ .. 5 ..
3.34.d:
इन्द्रश्च गत्या दृश्यश्च ततः प्रतिशकृत्तथा ॥
मितश्च समितश्चैव अमितश्च महाबलः ॥ 5 ॥
3.34.m: Indra, and Gati, Dṛśya, then Pratiśakṛt likewise, / Mita, Samita, and Amita of great strength—

3.34.s:
dvitīyāyāṃ tathā śreṇyāṃ devānetāṃśca vinyaset ..
ṛtajitsatyajiccaiva suṣeṇaścaiva vīryavān .. 6 ..
3.34.d:
द्वितीयायां तथा श्रेण्यां देवानेतांश्च विन्यसेत् ॥
ऋतजित्सत्यजिच्चैव सुषेणश्चैव वीर्यवान् ॥ 6 ॥
3.34.m: one should ritually place these deities in the second row: / Ṛtajit, Satyajit, and vigorous Suṣeṇa,

3.34.s:
atimitronamitraśca purumitrastathaiva ca ..
tṛtīyāyāṃ tathā śreṇyāṃ devānetāṃśca vinyaset .. 7 ..
3.34.d:
अतिमित्रोनमित्रश्च पुरुमित्रस्तथैव च ॥
तृतीयायां तथा श्रेण्यां देवानेतांश्च विन्यसेत् ॥ 7 ॥
3.34.m: Atimitra, Unamitra, and likewise Purumitra; / one should ritually place these deities in the third row.

3.34.s:
ṛtaśca ṛtavāndhartā vidhartā varuṇo dhruvaḥ ..
vidhāraṇaṃ caturthyāṃ tu śreṇyā pārthiva vinyaset .. 8 ..
3.34.d:
ऋतश्च ऋतवान्धर्ता विधर्ता वरुणो ध्रुवः ॥
विधारणं चतुर्थ्यां तु श्रेण्या पार्थिव विन्यसेत् ॥ 8 ॥
3.34.m: Ṛta, Ṛtavat, Dhartṛ, Vidhartṛ, Varuṇa, Dhruva, / and Vidhāraṇa—one should ritually place [these] in the fourth row, O king.

3.34.s:
īdṛkṣaśca sadṛkṣaśca etādṛgamitāśanaḥ ..
kīrtitaḥ prasadṛkṣaśca śarabhaśca mahāyaśāḥ .. 9 ..
3.34.d:
ईदृक्षश्च सदृक्षश्च एतादृगमिताशनः ॥
कीर्तितः प्रसदृक्षश्च शरभश्च महायशाः ॥ 9 ॥
3.34.m: Īdṛkṣa, Sadṛkṣa, Etādṛg, Amitāśana, / renowned Prasadṛkṣa, and far-famed Śarabha—

3.34.s:
vinyasetpañcamaśreṇyāṃ saptadevānnarādhipa ..
dhartā dugno dhvanirbhīmo atiyuktaḥ kṣamāsahaḥ .. 3.166.10 ..
3.34.d:
विन्यसेत्पञ्चमश्रेण्यां सप्तदेवान्नराधिप ॥
धर्ता दुग्नो ध्वनिर्भीमो अतियुक्तः क्षमासहः ॥ 3.166.10 ॥
3.34.m: one should ritually place these seven deities in the fifth row, O lord of men: / Dhartṛ, Dugna, Dhvani, Bhīma, Atiyukta, Kṣamāsaha.

3.34.s:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca vinyasecchreṇyāṃ saptadevānyathākramam ..
dyutirvasuranādhṛṣyo vāsaḥ kāmo jayo virāṭ .. 11 ..
3.34.d:
षष्ठ्यां च विन्यसेच्छ्रेण्यां सप्तदेवान्यथाक्रमम् ॥
द्युतिर्वसुरनाधृष्यो वासः कामो जयो विराट् ॥ 11 ॥
3.34.m: And in the sixth row one should ritually place the seven deities in due order: / Dyuti, Vasu, Anādhṛṣya, Vāsa, Kāma, Jaya, Virāj.

3.34.s:
saptamyāṃ ca tathā śreṇyāṃ vinyasetsapta pārthivān ..
prathamā tu bhavecchreṇī śuklā pārthivasattama .. 12 ..
3.34.d:
सप्तम्यां च तथा श्रेण्यां विन्यसेत्सप्त पार्थिवान् ॥
प्रथमा तु भवेच्छ्रेणी शुक्ला पार्थिवसत्तम ॥ 12 ॥
3.34.m: And likewise in the seventh row one should ritually place the seven rulers. / The first row should be white, O best of kings;

3.34.s:
dvitīyā padmapatrābhā tṛtīyā rudhiropamā ..
pītavarṇā caturthī syātpañcamā śukasannibhā .. 13 ..
3.34.d:
द्वितीया पद्मपत्राभा तृतीया रुधिरोपमा ॥
पीतवर्णा चतुर्थी स्यात्पञ्चमा शुकसन्निभा ॥ 13 ॥
3.34.m: the second has the hue of a lotus leaf, the third resembles blood, / the fourth should be yellow-coloured, and the fifth resembles a parrot,

3.34.s:
ākāśasannibhā ṣaṣṭhī kṛṣṇavarṇā ca saptamī ..
mālyānulepanaṃ deyaṃ tāsāṃ varṇasamaṃ nṛpa .. 14 ..
3.34.d:
आकाशसन्निभा षष्ठी कृष्णवर्णा च सप्तमी ॥
माल्यानुलेपनं देयं तासां वर्णसमं नृप ॥ 14 ॥
3.34.m: the sixth resembles the sky, and the seventh is black-coloured. / Garlands and ointments matching their colours should be offered, O king.

3.34.s:
ekonāstatra dātavyā dīpāḥ pañcāśadeva tu ..
pṛthakpṛthaktu devānāṃ naivedyaṃ vinivedayet .. 15 ..
3.34.d:
एकोनास्तत्र दातव्या दीपाः पञ्चाशदेव तु ॥
पृथक्पृथक्तु देवानां नैवेद्यं विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 15 ॥
3.34.m: Forty-nine lamps should be given there, / and one should offer the food offering to the deities individually.

3.34.s:
ghṛtaṃ ca juhuyādvahnau nāmabhiśca pṛthakpṛthak ..
bhojayedbrāhmaṇām̐ścātra surasaṃkhyā samanvitān .. 16 ..
3.34.d:
घृतं च जुहुयाद्वह्नौ नामभिश्च पृथक्पृथक् ॥
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणाम्̐श्चात्र सुरसंख्या समन्वितान् ॥ 16 ॥
3.34.m: And one should sacrifice clarified butter into the fire by their separate names, / and feed brahmins there equal in number to the gods.

3.34.s:
saṃvatsaramidaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ puruṣasattama ..
suvarṇasahitaṃ vāso gāṃ ca dadyāttathaiva ca .. 17 ..
3.34.d:
संवत्सरमिदं कृत्वा व्रतं पुरुषसत्तम ॥
सुवर्णसहितं वासो गां च दद्यात्तथैव च ॥ 17 ॥
3.34.m: Having observed this vow for one year, O best of men, / one should give a garment along with gold, and likewise a cow,

3.34.s:
paurāṇikāya viprāya vratānte vinivedayet ..
vratasyāsya tu rājendra samyagvipro vidhānavit .. 18 ..
3.34.d:
पौराणिकाय विप्राय व्रतान्ते विनिवेदयेत् ॥
व्रतस्यास्य तु राजेन्द्र सम्यग्विप्रो विधानवित् ॥ 18 ॥
3.34.m: and at the conclusion of the vow one should present [them] to a brahmin versed in the Purāṇas. / Of this vow, O king of kings, the brahmin should be well versed in the ritual.

3.34.s:
ārogyakāmaḥ kurvīta vratametannarottama ..
putrakāmorthakāmaśca dhanakāmotha vā punaḥ .. 19 ..
3.34.d:
आरोग्यकामः कुर्वीत व्रतमेतन्नरोत्तम ॥
पुत्रकामोर्थकामश्च धनकामोथ वा पुनः ॥ 19 ॥
3.34.m: One desiring good health should perform this vow, O best of men, / or one desiring a son, one desiring wealth, or again one desiring riches.

3.34.s:
sarvakāmapradaṃ hyetatpavitraṃ pāpanāśanam ..
maṅgalyaṃ svargadaṃ proktaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ..3.166.20 ..
3.34.d:
सर्वकामप्रदं ह्येतत्पवित्रं पापनाशनम् ॥
मङ्गल्यं स्वर्गदं प्रोक्तं व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् ॥3.166.20 ॥
3.34.m: For this grants all desires, is purifying, destroys sins, / is auspicious, and is said to grant heaven—the highest vow among vows.

3.34.s:
vratenānena cīrṇena ciraṃ svargaṃ samaśnute ..
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavetsvargabhraṣṭastathācirāt .. 21 ..
3.34.d:
व्रतेनानेन चीर्णेन चिरं स्वर्गं समश्नुते ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवेत्स्वर्गभ्रष्टस्तथाचिरात् ॥ 21 ॥
3.34.m: Having performed this vow, he enjoys heaven for a long time; / and descending from heaven, he would quickly attain human birth,

3.34.s:
dhanena rūpeṇa balena yukto janābhirāmaḥ pramadāpriyaśca ..
virogadehaḥ kṣataśatrupakṣo vāgmī tathā śāstradharaśca loke .. 22 ..
3.167
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
caitraśuklasya pakṣe tu samyak ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣitaḥ ..
saptamyāmarcanaṃ kuryāddevadevasya gopateḥ .. 1 ..
bahiḥ snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā gomayenopalepitam ..
lepayetsthaṇḍilaṃ samyakkuto gauramṛdā nṛpa .. 2 ..
tatrāṣṭapatraṃ kamalaṃ varṇakaistu samālikhet ..
karṇikāyāṃ nyasettatra devadevaṃ vibhāvasum .. 3 ..
pūrvapakṣe nyaseddevo dvau rājannuttare dale ..
āgneye ca nyasetpatre gandharvau ṛtukārikau .. 4..
dakṣiṇe ca nyasetpatre tathaivāpsarasordvayam ..

vāyavye yātudhānau dvau tathaiva nṛpasattama .. 6 ..
3.34.d:
धनेन रूपेण बलेन युक्तो जनाभिरामः प्रमदाप्रियश्च ॥
विरोगदेहः क्षतशत्रुपक्षो वाग्मी तथा शास्त्रधरश्च लोके ॥ 22 ॥
3.167
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
चैत्रशुक्लस्य पक्षे तु सम्यक् षष्ठ्यामुपोषितः ॥
सप्तम्यामर्चनं कुर्याद्देवदेवस्य गोपतेः ॥ 1 ॥
बहिः स्नानं नरः कृत्वा गोमयेनोपलेपितम् ॥
लेपयेत्स्थण्डिलं सम्यक्कुतो गौरमृदा नृप ॥ 2 ॥
तत्राष्टपत्रं कमलं वर्णकैस्तु समालिखेत् ॥
कर्णिकायां न्यसेत्तत्र देवदेवं विभावसुम् ॥ 3 ॥
पूर्वपक्षे न्यसेद्देवो द्वौ राजन्नुत्तरे दले ॥
आग्नेये च न्यसेत्पत्रे गन्धर्वौ ऋतुकारिकौ ॥ 4॥
दक्षिणे च न्यसेत्पत्रे तथैवाप्सरसोर्द्वयम् ॥
राक्षसौ द्वौ महाराज पत्रे नैरृतके न्यसेत ॥ 5 ॥
काद्रवेयौ महानागौ पश्चिमे ऋतवारिकौ ॥
वायव्ये यातुधानौ द्वौ तथैव नृपसत्तम ॥ 6 ॥
3.34.m:
endowed with wealth, beauty, and strength, pleasing to people, dear to women, / with a disease-free body, with his faction of enemies destroyed, eloquent, and an upholder of the scriptures in the world.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having fasted properly on the sixth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, / one should worship the Sun, the god of gods, on the seventh day.
Having bathed outside, the man should smear an altar / that has been smeared with cow dung, well prepared with white clay, O king.
There he should draw an eight-petalled lotus with colours; / in its pericarp he should ritually place Vibhāvasu, the god of gods.
On the eastern petal he should place two gods, O king, and on the northern petal; / and on the south-eastern petal he should place the two gandharvas of the season.
And on the southern petal he should place likewise two apsarases; / he should place two rākṣasas, O great king, on the south-western petal.
On the western [petal], the two great nāgas born of Kadrū, protectors of the season; / likewise on the north-western [petal], two yātudhānas, O best of kings.

3.34.s:
uttare ca tathā patre vinyasecca ṛṣidvayam ..
aiśānye vinyasetpatre grahamekaṃ narottama .. 7 ..

dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaiḥ pṛthakpṛthagarindama .. 8 ..

nāmnā tathaiva sarveṣāṃ caikaikaṃ bhojayeddvijam .. 3.167.10 ..
śaktyā ca dakṣiṇā deyā teṣāmeva yadūttama ..
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vratametannarottama .. 11 ..

3.34.d:
उत्तरे च तथा पत्रे विन्यसेच्च ऋषिद्वयम् ॥
ऐशान्ये विन्यसेत्पत्रे ग्रहमेकं नरोत्तम ॥ 7 ॥
तेषां संपूजनं कार्यं गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
धूपैर्दीपैश्च नैवेद्यैः पृथक्पृथगरिन्दम ॥ 8 ॥
एवं सम्पूजनं कृत्वा सर्वेषां तदनन्तरम् ॥
घृतेन होमं कुर्वीत सूर्यस्याष्टशतेन च ॥ 9 ॥
अन्येषां व तथा दद्यादष्टावष्टौ नरेश्वर ॥
नाम्ना तथैव सर्वेषां चैकैकं भोजयेद्द्विजम् ॥ 3.167.10 ॥
शक्त्या च दक्षिणा देया तेषामेव यदूत्तम ॥
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा व्रतमेतन्नरोत्तम ॥ 11 ॥
पौराणिकाय विप्राय व्रतस्यान्ते पयस्विनीम् ॥
विधिवच्च ततो दद्यात्सुवर्णं च यदूत्तम ॥12॥
सर्वकामप्रदं चैव व्रतमुक्तं स्वयम्भुवा ॥
व्रतेनानेन चीर्णेन सूर्यलोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥13॥
अथ द्वादशवर्षाणि करोत्येतन्महाव्रतम् ॥
भित्त्वार्कमण्डलं राजा विष्णोः सायुज्यतां व्रजेत् ॥14॥
3.34.m:
And on the northern petal he should ritually place two sages; / on the north-eastern petal he should ritually place one planet, O best of men.
Their worship should be performed with fragrant perfumes, garlands, and ointments, / with incenses, lamps, and food offerings, individually, O tamer of enemies.
Having thus worshipped all of them, immediately thereafter / one should perform an oblation with clarified butter with one hundred and eight [recitations] for Sūrya.
And for the others one should offer eight each, O lord of men; / and he should feed one twice-born for each of them by name.
And a sacrificial fee should be given to them according to one's capacity, O best of the Yadus. / Having observed this vow thus for one year, O best of men,
at the end of the vow he should then duly give a milch cow / and gold to a brahmin versed in the Purāṇas, O best of the Yadus.
This vow is proclaimed by the Self-born as granting all desires; / having observed this vow, one reaches the realm of Sūrya.
If the king performs this great vow for twelve years, / piercing the solar orb, he goes to union with Viṣṇu.

3.34.s:
etadvrataṃ pāpavināśakāri dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśakāri..
loke tathāsmiṃśca pare ca rājansvargapradaṃ mokṣakaraṃ tathaiva..15..

vajra uvāca ..
yasminyasminkratau brahmannanuyānti raviṃ prabhum ..
yeye devaprabhṛtayastanme tvaṃ vaktumarhasi .. 1 ..

dhātāryamā ca rājendra vasante devatādvayam ..
tumbururnāradaścaiva gandharvau gāyanau varau .. 2 ..

3.34.d:
एतद्व्रतं पापविनाशकारि धन्यं यशस्यं रिपुनाशकारि॥
लोके तथास्मिंश्च परे च राजन्स्वर्गप्रदं मोक्षकरं तथैव॥15॥
3.168
वज्र उवाच ॥
यस्मिन्यस्मिन्क्रतौ ब्रह्मन्ननुयान्ति रविं प्रभुम् ॥
येये देवप्रभृतयस्तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
धातार्यमा च राजेन्द्र वसन्ते देवताद्वयम् ॥
तुम्बुरुर्नारदश्चैव गन्धर्वौ गायनौ वरौ ॥ 2 ॥
कृतस्थलाप्सराश्चैव तथा या पुञ्जिकस्थला ॥
होता प्रहोता च तथा रक्षोघ्नौ मणिपुङ्गवौ ॥3॥
उरगो वासुकिश्चैव वाष्टकर्णी च तावुभौ ॥
रथकृत्स्ना रथौजाश्च यातुधानवरौ तथा ॥ 4 ॥
मित्रश्च पुलहश्चैव तथैवमृषिसत्तमौ ॥
अनुयाति सितश्चैव वसन्ते च यथा ग्रहः ॥ 5 ॥
येनुयान्ति रविं देवं निदाघे तान्निबोधसे ॥
मित्रश्च वरुणश्चैव ग्रीष्मे देवौ वसन्ति च ॥ 6 ॥
3.34.m:
This vow destroys sins, brings wealth, brings fame, and destroys enemies; / and in this world and the next, O king, it confers heaven and brings about liberation.
Vajra said: / In each sacrifice, O brahmin, which gods and others / follow the lord Ravi, that you should tell me.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Dhātṛ and Aryaman, O king of kings, are the pair of deities in spring, / and Tumburu and Nārada, the two excellent singing gandharvas.
And the apsaras Kṛtasthalā, and likewise she who is Puñjikasthalā, / and Hotṛ and Prahotṛ, the two foremost Yakṣas who destroy demons,
and both the serpent Vāsuki and Vāṣṭakarṇī, / and Rathakṛtsnā and Rathaujas, the two excellent yātudhānas,
and Mitra and Pulaha, the two best of ṛṣis; / and Venus follows as the planet in spring.
Hear from me those who follow the sun god in summer: / Mitra and Varuṇa are the two deities dwelling [with him] in summer,

3.34.s:
ṛṣiratrirvasiṣṭhaśca nāgau raṃbhakatakṣakau ..
menakā sahajanyā ca gandharvau ca hahāhuhū .. 7 ..
rathasvanapramāṇaśca rathakṛtsaśca tāvubhau ..
pauruṣādo vadhaścaiva yātudhānau tu tau smṛtau .. 8 ..

elapatrastathā sarpaḥ śaṅkhapālaśca pannagaḥ .. 3.168.10 ..
śucisenograsenau ca vrātaścaivāruṇaśca vai ..

3.34.d:
ऋषिरत्रिर्वसिष्ठश्च नागौ रंभकतक्षकौ ॥
मेनका सहजन्या च गन्धर्वौ च हहाहुहू ॥ 7 ॥
रथस्वनप्रमाणश्च रथकृत्सश्च तावुभौ ॥
पौरुषादो वधश्चैव यातुधानौ तु तौ स्मृतौ ॥ 8 ॥
अनुयाति कुजश्चैव निदाघे च तथा ग्रहः ॥
येनुयान्ति रविं देवं प्रावृट्काले निबोध मे ॥ 9 ॥
इन्द्रश्चैव विवस्वांश्च अङ्गिरा भृगुरेव च ॥
एलपत्रस्तथा सर्पः शङ्खपालश्च पन्नगः ॥ 3.168.10 ॥
शुचिसेनोग्रसेनौ च व्रातश्चैवारुणश्च वै ॥
प्रम्लोचेत्यप्सराश्चैव निम्लोचन्ती च ते उभे ॥ 11 ॥
यातुधानस्तथा सर्पो व्याघ्रश्च मनुजेश्वर ॥
प्रावृट्काले तु यात्येनं ग्रहो देवपुरोहितः ॥ 12 ॥
अतः परं निबोधस्व शरत्काले नराधिप ॥
पर्जन्यश्चैव पूषा च भरद्वाजश्च गौतमः ॥ 13 ॥
3.34.m:
and the ṛṣis Atri and Vasiṣṭha, and the two nāgas Rambhaka and Takṣaka, / and Menakā and Sahajanyā, and the two gandharvas Hāhā and Hūhū,
and both Rathasvanapramāṇa and Rathakṛtsa; / and Pauruṣāda and Vadha are recalled as the two yātudhānas,
and Mars follows as the planet in summer. / Hear from me those who follow the sun god in the rainy season:
Indra and Vivasvat, and Aṅgiras and Bhṛgu, / and the serpent Elāpatra and the snake Śaṅkhapāla,
and Śucisena and Ugrasena, and Vrāta and Aruṇa; / and both the apsarases Pramlocā and Nimlocantī,
and the yātudhāna Sarpa and Vyāghra, O lord of men. / In the rainy season, the priest of the gods follows him as the planet.
Hear thereafter concerning the autumn season, O ruler of men: / Parjanya and Pūṣan, and Bharadvāja and Gautama,

3.34.d:
चित्रसेनश्च गंधर्वस्तथा वसुरुचिश्च वै ॥
विश्वाची च घृताची च तथा चैवाप्सरोद्वयम् ॥ 14 ॥
नागश्चैरावतश्चैव विश्रुतश्च धनञ्जयः ॥
सेनजिच्च सुषेणश्च राक्षसौ भीमविक्रमौ ॥ 15 ॥
वातोद्वातौ च तथा यातुधानौ महाबलौ ॥
ग्रहः शनैश्चरश्चैवमनुयान्ति दिवाकरम् ॥ 16 ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि हेमन्ते तव पार्थिव ॥
अंशो भगश्च द्वावेतौ कश्यपश्च क्रतुश्च वै ॥ 17 ॥
भुजगश्च महापद्मः सर्पः कर्कोटकस्तथा ॥
चित्रसेनश्च गन्धर्व ऊर्णायुश्च महाबलः ॥ 18 ॥
अप्सराः पूर्वचित्तिश्च गन्धर्वी उर्वशी तथा ॥
तार्क्ष्यश्चारिष्टनेमिश्च राक्षसौ भीमविक्रमौ॥ 19 ॥
विद्युत्स्फूर्जस्तथैवोग्रौ यातुधानौ महाबलौ ॥
अनुयाति ग्रहश्चैव बुधो राजन्दिवाकरम् ॥3.168.20॥
3.34.m:
and the gandharva Citrasena, and also Vasuruci, / and Viśvācī and Ghṛtācī, the pair of apsarases,
and the nāga Airāvata, and the renowned Dhanañjaya, / and Senajit and Suṣeṇa, the two rākṣasas of terrible prowess,
and likewise Vāta and Udvāta, the two mighty yātudhānas; / and the planet Saturn follows the sun.
Thereafter I shall declare [those] to you in winter, O king: / Aṃśa and Bhaga, these two, and Kaśyapa and Kratu,
and the serpent Mahāpadma, and the snake Karkoṭaka, / and the gandharva Citrasena, and Ūrṇāyu of great might,
and the apsaras Pūrvacitti, and likewise the gandharvī Urvaśī, / and Tārkṣya and Ariṣṭanemi, the two rākṣasas of terrible prowess,
and Vidyutsphūrja, the two fierce and mighty yātudhānas; / and the planet Mercury, O king, follows the sun.

चन्द्रमा ग्रहराजश्च अनुयाति दिवाकरम्॥24॥
3.34.m: and the gandharva Dhṛtarāṣṭra, and Sūryavarcas as the other, / and the moon, king of the planets, follows the sun.
