sthānābhimānino hyete saptadvādaśakā gaṇāḥ .. 25 ..
3.34.d:
एवं हि शिशिरे राजन्ननुयानं प्रकुर्वते ॥
स्थानाभिमानिनो ह्येते सप्तद्वादशका गणाः ॥ 25 ॥
3.34.m: In this way, O king, they perform the following in the cold season. / These presiding deities of their positions are indeed groups of seven twelves.

3.34.s:
gaṇaṣaṭkastathaivaikamanuyāti divākaram ..
sūryamāpyāyayantyete tejasā teja uttamam .. 26 ..
3.34.d:
गणषट्कस्तथैवैकमनुयाति दिवाकरम् ॥
सूर्यमाप्याययन्त्येते तेजसा तेज उत्तमम् ॥ 26 ॥
3.34.m: Likewise, a group of six follows each sun. / These invigorate the sun, the supreme splendour, with their splendour.

3.34.s:
grathitaistavacobhiśca kurvanti ṛṣayastavam ..
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva gītairnṛtyairupāsate .. 27 ..
3.34.d:
ग्रथितैस्तवचोभिश्च कुर्वन्ति ऋषयस्तवम् ॥
गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव गीतैर्नृत्यैरुपासते ॥ 27 ॥
3.34.m: The ṛṣis offer praise with composed words of praise, / and the gandharvas and apsarases worship him with songs and dances.

3.34.s:
vidyāgrāmaṇinaścaiva kurvantyatrābhiṣugraham ..
sarpā vahanti vai sūryaṃ yātudhāno'nuyāti ca .. 28 ..
3.34.d:
विद्याग्रामणिनश्चैव कुर्वन्त्यत्राभिषुग्रहम् ॥
सर्पा वहन्ति वै सूर्यं यातुधानोऽनुयाति च ॥ 28 ॥
3.34.m: And the yakṣa chiefs hold the reins here; / the serpents carry the sun, and the yātudhāna follows.

3.34.s:
parivārya grahaścaiva nayatyastaṃ yathāvidhi ..
eteṣāmeva devānāṃ yathāvīryaṃ yathātapaḥ .. 29 ..
3.34.d:
परिवार्य ग्रहश्चैव नयत्यस्तं यथाविधि ॥
एतेषामेव देवानां यथावीर्यं यथातपः ॥ 29 ॥
3.34.m: Surrounding [him], the planet leads [him] to setting according to rule. / According to the valour and ascetic heat of these very gods,

3.34.s:
yathāsatvamasau sūryasteṣāṃ siddhastu tejasā ..
bhūtānāmaśubhaṃ karma vināśayati tejasā .. 3.168.30 ..
3.34.d:
यथासत्वमसौ सूर्यस्तेषां सिद्धस्तु तेजसा ॥
भूतानामशुभं कर्म विनाशयति तेजसा ॥ 3.168.30 ॥
3.34.m: and according to their essence, that sun, perfected by their splendour, / destroys the inauspicious deeds of living beings with his splendour.

3.34.s:
grīṣme hime ca varṣāsu janayansa divākaraḥ ..
dharmaṃ himaṃ ca varṣaṃ ca dinaṃ ca niśayā saha .. 31 ..
3.169
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
caitramāsasya saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣe narādhipa ..
gomayenopalipte tu mṛdā kuryāttu maṇḍalam .. 1 ..
tatrāṣṭapatraṃ kamalaṃ kartavyaṃ varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
kṛtopavāsastanmadhya bhāskaraṃ pūjayennaraḥ .. 2 ..
aruṇaṃ caiva dantākaṃ māṭharaṃ ca tathā damam ..
yamunāṃ ca yamaṃ kālaṃ dvitīyaṃ manumeva ca .. 3 ..
śanaiścaraṃ tathā rājñīṃ chāyāṃ revantameva ca ..
saptacchandāṃsi varṣaṃ ca dyāṃ ca piṅgalameva ca .. 4 ..
keśareṣu yajedvātha patreṣūktāśca devatāḥ ..
dikkālapūjanaṃ kāryaṃ bahiḥ padmasya pārthiva .. 5 ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā ..
vrate samāpte dātavyasturago brāhmaṇāya ca .. 6 ..
3.34.d:
ग्रीष्मे हिमे च वर्षासु जनयन्स दिवाकरः ॥
धर्मं हिमं च वर्षं च दिनं च निशया सह ॥ 31 ॥
3.169
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
चैत्रमासस्य सप्तम्यां शुक्लपक्षे नराधिप ॥
गोमयेनोपलिप्ते तु मृदा कुर्यात्तु मण्डलम् ॥ 1 ॥
तत्राष्टपत्रं कमलं कर्तव्यं वर्णकैः शुभैः ॥
कृतोपवासस्तन्मध्य भास्करं पूजयेन्नरः ॥ 2 ॥
अरुणं चैव दन्ताकं माठरं च तथा दमम् ॥
यमुनां च यमं कालं द्वितीयं मनुमेव च ॥ 3 ॥
शनैश्चरं तथा राज्ञीं छायां रेवन्तमेव च ॥
सप्तच्छन्दांसि वर्षं च द्यां च पिङ्गलमेव च ॥ 4 ॥
केशरेषु यजेद्वाथ पत्रेषूक्ताश्च देवताः ॥
दिक्कालपूजनं कार्यं बहिः पद्मस्य पार्थिव ॥ 5 ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसम्पदा ॥
व्रते समाप्ते दातव्यस्तुरगो ब्राह्मणाय च ॥ 6 ॥
3.34.m:
In summer, cold season, and the rains, generating heat, / cold, and rain, that sun creates the day along with the night.
3.169
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
On the seventh day of the bright fortnight of the month of Caitra, O ruler of men, / on [ground] smeared with cow dung, one should make a maṇḍala with clay.
An eight-petalled lotus should be made there with auspicious pigments. / Having observed a fast, a man should worship the sun in its centre,
and Aruṇa, Dantāka, Māṭhara, and Dama, / and Yamunā, Yama, Kāla, and the second Manu,
and Saturn, the queen, Chāyā, and Revanta, / the seven metres, the year, the sky, and Piṅgala.
One should worship the declared deities either on the filaments or on the petals. / The worship of the directions and time should be performed outside the lotus, O king,
with an abundance of perfume, garlands, obeisances, incense, lamps, and food. / When the observance is completed, a horse should be given to a brahmin.

3.34.s:
prāpyāśvamedhasya phalaṃ yathāvallokānavāpyātha purandarasya ..
tatroṣya rājansuciraṃ ca kālaṃ sāyujyamāyāti divākarasya .. 7 ..
3.170
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe narādhipa ..
sopavāsastu saptamyāṃ kamale pūjayedravim .. 1 ..
arcāyāṃ vā sthale vāpi śuklaiḥ puṣpairyathāvidhi ..
candanena tu raktena vaṭakaiḥ kṛsareṇa ca ..2..
dadyādvratānte dvijapuṅgavāya vastre tu rakte ripunāśanepsuḥ ..
saubhāgyakāmaśca tathaiva rājyaṃ prāpnoti lokānsavitustathānte .. 3 ..
3.34.d:
प्राप्याश्वमेधस्य फलं यथावल्लोकानवाप्याथ पुरन्दरस्य ॥
तत्रोष्य राजन्सुचिरं च कालं सायुज्यमायाति दिवाकरस्य ॥ 7 ॥
3.170
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
मार्गशीर्षस्य मासस्य कृष्णपक्षे नराधिप ॥
सोपवासस्तु सप्तम्यां कमले पूजयेद्रविम् ॥ 1 ॥
अर्चायां वा स्थले वापि शुक्लैः पुष्पैर्यथाविधि ॥
चन्दनेन तु रक्तेन वटकैः कृसरेण च ॥2॥
दद्याद्व्रतान्ते द्विजपुङ्गवाय वस्त्रे तु रक्ते रिपुनाशनेप्सुः ॥
सौभाग्यकामश्च तथैव राज्यं प्राप्नोति लोकान्सवितुस्तथान्ते ॥ 3 ॥
3.34.m:
Obtaining the fruit of the horse sacrifice according to rule, and then attaining the worlds of Indra, / dwelling there for a very long time, O king, he attains union with the sun.
3.170
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
In the dark fortnight of the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, O ruler of men, / fasting on the seventh day, one should worship the sun on a lotus,
either in an icon or on the ground, with white flowers according to rule, / with red sandalwood, with fried cakes, and with rice-and-pulse gruel.
Desiring the destruction of enemies, he should give two red garments to an eminent twice-born at the end of the observance; / and desiring good fortune, he likewise attains a kingdom, and at the end, the worlds of the sun.

3.35.s:
3.171
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
anena ca vidhānena pratimāsaṃ tu yo naraḥ ..
saptamīdvitayaṃ kuryādyāvatsaṃvatsaro bhavet .. 1 ..
3.35.d:
3.171
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
अनेन च विधानेन प्रतिमासं तु यो नरः ॥
सप्तमीद्वितयं कुर्याद्यावत्संवत्सरो भवेत् ॥ 1 ॥
3.35.m:
3.171
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
And by this rule, whichever man, month after month, / performs the pair of seventh lunar days until a year is complete,

3.35.s:
sośvamedhamavāpnoti sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati ..
kulamuddharate rājansarvānkāmānupāśnute .. 2 ..
3.35.d:
सोश्वमेधमवाप्नोति सूर्यलोकं च गच्छति ॥
कुलमुद्धरते राजन्सर्वान्कामानुपाश्नुते ॥ 2 ॥
3.35.m: attains [the fruit of] a horse sacrifice and goes to the realm of the sun; / he uplifts his lineage, O king, and attains all desires.

3.35.s:
śiraso vapanaṃ kṛtvā yorcayettu divākaram ..
tasyārkastoṣamāyāti vahniṣṭomaṃ ca vindati .. 3 ..
3.35.d:
शिरसो वपनं कृत्वा योर्चयेत्तु दिवाकरम् ॥
तस्यार्कस्तोषमायाति वह्निष्टोमं च विन्दति ॥ 3 ॥
3.35.m: One who shaves his head and worships the Sun— / the Sun becomes pleased with him, and he wins [the fruit of] an agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

3.35.s:
apūpaiḥ saguḍairbhaktyā tathā ca lavaṇānvitaiḥ ..
sahiraṇyaissamabhyarcya vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. 4 ..
3.35.d:
अपूपैः सगुडैर्भक्त्या तथा च लवणान्वितैः ॥
सहिरण्यैस्समभ्यर्च्य वह्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥ 4 ॥
3.35.m: Having worshipped with devotion with cakes accompanied by jaggery, / and likewise containing salt, along with gold, he obtains the fruit of an agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

3.35.s:
sūryāhṇe yastu naktāśī saṃpūjayati bhāskaram ..
iṣṭānkāmānavāpnoti sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 5 ..
3.35.d:
सूर्याह्णे यस्तु नक्ताशी संपूजयति भास्करम् ॥
इष्टान्कामानवाप्नोति सूर्यलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 5 ॥
3.35.m: One who eats at night on the day of the Sun and worships the Sun / attains desired wishes and goes to the realm of the sun.

3.35.s:
arkodaye sadā yastu pūjayecca divākaram ..
iṣṭānkāmānavāpnoti sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 6 ..
3.35.d:
अर्कोदये सदा यस्तु पूजयेच्च दिवाकरम् ॥
इष्टान्कामानवाप्नोति सूर्यलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 6 ॥
3.35.m: One who always worships the Sun at sunrise / attains desired wishes and goes to the realm of the sun.

3.35.s:
yathāyathā pūjayate tu sūryaṃ kāmāḥ samagrāḥ saphalā bhavanti ..
ārogyamagryaṃ ca tathā nṛvīra bhūtasya lokaḥ savitustathaiva .. 7 ..
3.172
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
varo dhruvaśca somaśca āpaścaivānilonalaḥ ..
pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavoṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ .. 1 ...
aṣṭātmā vāsudevo'yaṃ prabhavenāpyayena ca ..
aṣṭamyāṃ pūjayedyastu sopavāso narādhipa..2..
caitramāsādathārabhya śuklapakṣe ca yādava ..
maṇḍaleṣvatha vārcāsu yathāvanmanujādhipa .. 3 ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā ..
bahiḥsnānena rājendra tathādhaḥśayanena ca .. 4 ..
vratānte ca tathā dadyāddhenuṃ viprāya bhaktitaḥ ..
vratametannaraḥ kṛtvā sarvānkāmānupāśnute .. 5 ..
puṇḍarīkamavāpnoti kulamuddharati svakam ..
vasūnāṃ lokamāsādya modatemarasannibhaḥ .. 6 ..
3.35.d:
यथायथा पूजयते तु सूर्यं कामाः समग्राः सफला भवन्ति ॥
आरोग्यमग्र्यं च तथा नृवीर भूतस्य लोकः सवितुस्तथैव ॥ 7 ॥
3.172
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
वरो ध्रुवश्च सोमश्च आपश्चैवानिलोनलः ॥
प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवोष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ 1 ॥।
अष्टात्मा वासुदेवोऽयं प्रभवेनाप्ययेन च ॥
अष्टम्यां पूजयेद्यस्तु सोपवासो नराधिप॥2॥
चैत्रमासादथारभ्य शुक्लपक्षे च यादव ॥
मण्डलेष्वथ वार्चासु यथावन्मनुजाधिप ॥ 3 ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥
बहिःस्नानेन राजेन्द्र तथाधःशयनेन च ॥ 4 ॥
व्रतान्ते च तथा दद्याद्धेनुं विप्राय भक्तितः ॥
व्रतमेतन्नरः कृत्वा सर्वान्कामानुपाश्नुते ॥ 5 ॥
पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति कुलमुद्धरति स्वकम् ॥
वसूनां लोकमासाद्य मोदतेमरसन्निभः ॥ 6 ॥
3.35.m:
In whatever manner one worships the sun, all desires become fruitful, / and likewise foremost health, O hero among men; and after death, the realm of the Sun.
3.172
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Vara, Dhruva, Soma, Āpa, Anila, Anala, / Pratyūṣa, and Prabhāsa are celebrated as the eight Vasus.
This eight-formed Vāsudeva is through origination and dissolution. / Whoever worships on the eighth lunar day while fasting, O king,
beginning from the month of Caitra in the bright fortnight, O Yādava, / either in sacred diagrams or in images, duly, O lord of men,
with an abundance of fragrance, garlands, obeisances, incense, lamps, and food, / by outdoor bathing, O king of kings, and likewise by sleeping on the ground,
and at the end of the vow gives a milch cow to a brahmin with devotion— / having performed this vow, a man attains all desires.
He attains [the fruit of] a puṇḍarīka sacrifice, uplifts his own lineage, / and having reached the realm of the Vasus, rejoices like an immortal.

3.35.s:
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo jitendriyaḥ satyaparo vinītaḥ ..
dhanena dhānyena tathanvitaḥ syātstrīṇāmabhīṣṭaśca tathā suveśaḥ .. 7 ..
3.173
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
śuklapakṣādathārabhya somāṣṭamyāṃ narādhipa ..
pūjayetsopavāsastu devadevaṃ trilocanam .. 1 ..
liṅge vāpyatha vārcāyāṃ kamale yadi vā sthale ..
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekeṇa snānena vividhena ca .. 2 ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā ..
gītena nṛtyavādyena vahnisaṃtarpaṇena ca .. 3 ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjābhiryathāvanmanujottama ..
vratāvasāne dadyācca tathā dhenuṃ payasvinīm ..4..
puṇḍarīkaphalāvāptiḥ svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ..
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṣu cāpyevaṃ pūjayitvā maheśvaram .. 5 .. ..
vahniṣṭomamavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ..
aṣṭamīdvitayaṃ kṛtvā tathā saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ .. 6 ..
3.35.d:
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगो जितेन्द्रियः सत्यपरो विनीतः ॥
धनेन धान्येन तथन्वितः स्यात्स्त्रीणामभीष्टश्च तथा सुवेशः ॥ 7 ॥
3.173
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ ॥
शुक्लपक्षादथारभ्य सोमाष्टम्यां नराधिप ॥
पूजयेत्सोपवासस्तु देवदेवं त्रिलोचनम् ॥ 1 ॥
लिङ्गे वाप्यथ वार्चायां कमले यदि वा स्थले ॥
घृतक्षीराभिषेकेण स्नानेन विविधेन च ॥ 2 ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥
गीतेन नृत्यवाद्येन वह्निसंतर्पणेन च ॥ 3 ॥
ब्राह्मणानां च पूजाभिर्यथावन्मनुजोत्तम ॥
व्रतावसाने दद्याच्च तथा धेनुं पयस्विनीम् ॥4॥
पुण्डरीकफलावाप्तिः स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥
कृष्णाष्टमीषु चाप्येवं पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् ॥ 5 ॥ ॥
वह्निष्टोममवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥
अष्टमीद्वितयं कृत्वा तथा संवत्सरं नरः ॥ 6 ॥
3.35.m:
Attaining human birth, he becomes free from disease, master of his senses, intent on truth, well-disciplined; / he will be endowed with wealth and grain, beloved by women, and well attired.
3.173
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Beginning from the bright fortnight on the eighth lunar day of Soma, O king, / fasting, one should worship the three-eyed god of gods,
either in a liṅga, or in an image, on a lotus, or on the ground, / with an anointing of ghee and milk, and various kinds of bathing,
with an abundance of fragrance, garlands, obeisances, incense, lamps, and food, / with song, dance, and instrumental music, and satisfaction of the fire,
and with worship of brahmins duly, O best of men; / and at the conclusion of the vow, he should also give a milch cow yielding milk.
He attains the fruit of a puṇḍarīka sacrifice and goes to heaven. / Having likewise worshipped Maheśvara on the eighth lunar days of the dark fortnight,
he obtains [the fruit of] an agniṣṭoma sacrifice and goes to heaven. / Having performed the pair of eighth lunar days for a year,

3.35.s:
prāpyāśvamedhasya phalaṃ yathāvadbhuktvā bhogānsuranāthasya loke ..
lokānavāpyātha maheśvarasya sāyujyamāyātyacireṇa tasya .. 7 ..
3.174
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho nīla eva ca ..
śvetaśca śṛṅgavānmerurmālyavāngandhamādanaḥ .. 1 ..
navaitāñśailanṛpatīnnavamyāṃ pūjayennaraḥ ..
uttarāḥ kuravaḥ puṇyā ramyo hairaṇvatastathā .. 2 ..
bhadrāśvaḥ ketumālaśca tathaiva ca ilāvṛtaḥ ..
harivarṣaḥ kiṃpuruṣo varṣo bhārata eva ca .. 3 ..
pūjanīyāstathaivaite yathā saṃsthānato nṛpa ..
śuklapakṣanavamyāṃ tu caitrādārabhya pārthiva .. 4 ..
sopavāsena dharmajña gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā ..
jambūdvīpasya saṃsthānaṃ vratānte rajataṃ naraḥ .. 5 ..
tulāpramāṇaṃ dadyāttu sarvānkāmānupāśnute ..
aśvamedhamavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 6 ..
3.35.d:
प्राप्याश्वमेधस्य फलं यथावद्भुक्त्वा भोगान्सुरनाथस्य लोके ॥
लोकानवाप्याथ महेश्वरस्य सायुज्यमायात्यचिरेण तस्य ॥ 7 ॥
3.174
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
हिमवान्हेमकूटश्च निषधो नील एव च ॥
श्वेतश्च शृङ्गवान्मेरुर्माल्यवान्गन्धमादनः ॥ 1 ॥
नवैताञ्शैलनृपतीन्नवम्यां पूजयेन्नरः ॥
उत्तराः कुरवः पुण्या रम्यो हैरण्वतस्तथा ॥ 2 ॥
भद्राश्वः केतुमालश्च तथैव च इलावृतः ॥
हरिवर्षः किंपुरुषो वर्षो भारत एव च ॥ 3 ॥
पूजनीयास्तथैवैते यथा संस्थानतो नृप ॥
शुक्लपक्षनवम्यां तु चैत्रादारभ्य पार्थिव ॥ 4 ॥
सोपवासेन धर्मज्ञ गन्धमाल्यान्नसंपदा ॥
जम्बूद्वीपस्य संस्थानं व्रतान्ते रजतं नरः ॥ 5 ॥
तुलाप्रमाणं दद्यात्तु सर्वान्कामानुपाश्नुते ॥
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 6 ॥
3.35.m:
a man attains the fruit of a horse sacrifice, duly enjoys delights in the world of the lord of the gods, / and having attained the worlds of Maheśvara, he soon reaches union with him.
3.174
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Himavān, Hemakūṭa, Niṣadha, Nīla, / Śveta, Śṛṅgavān, Meru, Mālyavān, and Gandhamādana:
a man should worship these nine kingly mountains on the ninth lunar day. / Holy Uttarakuru, Ramyaka, Hairaṇvata,
Bhadrāśva, Ketumāla, and likewise Ilāvṛta, / Harivarṣa, Kiṃpuruṣa, and the continent of Bhārata:
these are likewise to be worshipped according to their arrangement, O king. / On the ninth lunar day of the bright fortnight, beginning from Caitra, O king,
fasting, O knower of dharma, with an abundance of fragrance, garlands, and food, / a man, at the end of the vow, [should give] a representation of Jambūdvīpa in silver
measuring a tulā; he attains all desires, / obtains [the fruit of] a horse sacrifice, and goes to heaven.

3.35.s:
mānuṣyamāsādya tu cakravartī nṛpo bhaveddevagaṇābhirāmaḥ ..
ciraṃ ca kālaṃ vasudhāṃ praśāsya lokānavāpnoti tatopi kāmān .. 7 ..
3.175
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
navamyāṃ sopavāsastu bhadrakālīṃ tu pūjayet..
śuklapakṣe mahārāja kārtikaprabhṛti kramāt..1..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā..
saṃvatsarānte saṃpūjya vratānte brāhmaṇāya ca .. 2 ..
vastrayugmaṃ naro dattvā yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamāpnuyāt ..
rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt .. 3 ..
rājakāryābhiyuktaśca mucyate mahato bhayāt ..
na caurebhyo bhayaṃ tasya nāraṇyebhyaḥ kadācana .. 4 ..
putrānavāpnoti dhanaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ striyaśca mukhyā vividhaṃ ca kupyam ..
pūjāṃ tu kṛtvā vidhivadbhavānyā kāmānavāpnoti tathā yatheṣṭān .. 5 ..
3.35.d:
मानुष्यमासाद्य तु चक्रवर्ती नृपो भवेद्देवगणाभिरामः ॥
चिरं च कालं वसुधां प्रशास्य लोकानवाप्नोति ततोपि कामान् ॥ 7 ॥
3.175
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
नवम्यां सोपवासस्तु भद्रकालीं तु पूजयेत्॥
शुक्लपक्षे महाराज कार्तिकप्रभृति क्रमात्॥1॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा॥
संवत्सरान्ते संपूज्य व्रतान्ते ब्राह्मणाय च ॥ 2 ॥
वस्त्रयुग्मं नरो दत्त्वा यथेष्टं काममाप्नुयात् ॥
रोगार्तो मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् ॥ 3 ॥
राजकार्याभियुक्तश्च मुच्यते महतो भयात् ॥
न चौरेभ्यो भयं तस्य नारण्येभ्यः कदाचन ॥ 4 ॥
पुत्रानवाप्नोति धनं यथेष्टं स्त्रियश्च मुख्या विविधं च कुप्यम् ॥
पूजां तु कृत्वा विधिवद्भवान्या कामानवाप्नोति तथा यथेष्टान् ॥ 5 ॥
3.35.m:
Attaining human birth, he becomes an emperor, a king delighting the hosts of gods; / and having ruled the earth for a long time, he attains those realms and desires thereafter.
3.175
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Fasting on the ninth lunar day, one should worship Bhadrakālī / in the bright fortnight, O great king, in order beginning from Kārtika,
with an abundance of fragrance, garlands, obeisances, incense, lamps, and food. / Having worshipped for a year, at the end of the vow, to a brahmin
a man gives a pair of garments and obtains his wish at will. / Afflicted with disease, he is freed from disease; bound, he is freed from bondage.
And when accused in royal affairs, he is freed from great fear; / he never has fear from thieves nor from wild beasts.
He obtains sons, wealth at will, excellent women, and various base metals; / having performed worship of Bhavānī according to rule, he attains desired wishes at will.

3.36.s:
3.176
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kraturdakṣo ripuḥ satyaḥ kālakāmau dhvanistathā ..
kulavānmanujo viśvo rocamānaśca te daśa .. 1 ..
3.36.d:
3.176
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
क्रतुर्दक्षो रिपुः सत्यः कालकामौ ध्वनिस्तथा ॥
कुलवान्मनुजो विश्वो रोचमानश्च ते दश ॥ 1 ॥
3.36.m:
3.176
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Kratu, Dakṣa, Ripu, Satya, Kāla, Kāma, Dhvani, / Kulavān, Manuja, Viśva, and Rocamāna—these ten

3.36.s:
viśvedevā samākhyātā daśātmā keśavo vibhuḥ ..
tasya saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ sitapakṣe narādhipa .. 2 ..
3.36.d:
विश्वेदेवा समाख्याता दशात्मा केशवो विभुः ॥
तस्य संपूजनं कार्यं सितपक्षे नराधिप ॥ 2 ॥
3.36.m: are celebrated as the Viśvedevas; the all-pervading Keśava has ten forms. / His worship should be performed in the bright fortnight, O lord of men,

3.36.s:
ārabhya kārtikānmāsāddaśamyāṃ nṛpapuṅgava ..
maṇḍaleṣu ca mukhyeṣu yadi vārcāsu yādava .. 3 ..
3.36.d:
आरभ्य कार्तिकान्मासाद्दशम्यां नृपपुङ्गव ॥
मण्डलेषु च मुख्येषु यदि वार्चासु यादव ॥ 3 ॥
3.36.m: beginning from the month of Kārtika on the tenth lunar day, O foremost of kings, / either in primary sacred diagrams or in images, O Yādava.
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, obeisances, incenses, lamps, and food. / At the end of the observance, one should give gold to a twice-born according to one's capacity.

3.36.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ prāpnoti teṣāṃ suciraṃ ca lokān ..
tatroṣya loke puruṣatvametya rājā bhavedbrāhmaṇapuṅgavo vā .. 5 ..
3.177
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
ātmā hyāyurmano dakṣo madaḥ prāṇastathaiva ca ..
haviṣmāṃśca gatīṣṭaśca ṛtaḥ satyaśca te daśa ..1..
devastvaṅgiraso nāma daśamyāṃ pūjayennaraḥ..
sopavāsaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe pūrvoktavidhinā naraḥ ..2 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭānprāpnoti teṣāṃ suciraṃ ca lokān ..
tatroṣya loke puruṣatvametya rājā bhavedbrāhmaṇa puṅgavo vā..3..
3.178
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śuklapakṣe daśamyāṃ tu sopavāsastathā naraḥ ..
mārgaśīrṣādathārabhya nityametadarindama .. 1 ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā ..
ghṛtena juhuyādvahniṃ brāhmaṇām̐ścātra ca pūjayet..2.
vratāvasāne dadyācca tathā dhenuṃ payasvinīm..
vratametadvinirdiṣṭamaśvamedhaphalapradam.. 3..
3.36.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं प्राप्नोति तेषां सुचिरं च लोकान् ॥
तत्रोष्य लोके पुरुषत्वमेत्य राजा भवेद्ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवो वा ॥ 5 ॥
3.177
मार्कण्डेय उवाच॥
आत्मा ह्यायुर्मनो दक्षो मदः प्राणस्तथैव च ॥
हविष्मांश्च गतीष्टश्च ऋतः सत्यश्च ते दश ॥1॥
देवस्त्वङ्गिरसो नाम दशम्यां पूजयेन्नरः॥
सोपवासः कृष्णपक्षे पूर्वोक्तविधिना नरः ॥2 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टान्प्राप्नोति तेषां सुचिरं च लोकान् ॥
तत्रोष्य लोके पुरुषत्वमेत्य राजा भवेद्ब्राह्मण पुङ्गवो वा॥3॥
3.178
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
शुक्लपक्षे दशम्यां तु सोपवासस्तथा नरः ॥
मार्गशीर्षादथारभ्य नित्यमेतदरिन्दम ॥ 1 ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥
घृतेन जुहुयाद्वह्निं ब्राह्मणाम्̐श्चात्र च पूजयेत्॥2.
व्रतावसाने दद्याच्च तथा धेनुं पयस्विनीम्॥
व्रतमेतद्विनिर्दिष्टमश्वमेधफलप्रदम्॥ 3॥
3.36.m:
Having performed this desired observance for a year, one attains their worlds for a very long time; / having dwelt there in that world and attained human birth, one becomes a king or a foremost brahmin.
3.177
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Ātman, Āyus, Manas, Dakṣa, Mada, and likewise Prāṇa, / Haviṣmat, Gati, Iṣṭa, Ṛta, and Satya—these are the ten.
Fasting on the tenth day of the dark fortnight, a person / should worship the god named Aṅgiras according to the previously stated rule.
Having performed this desired observance for a year, one attains their worlds for a very long time; / having dwelt there in that world and attained human birth, one becomes a king or a foremost brahmin.
3.178
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
On the tenth day of the bright fortnight, a person, fasting, / beginning from the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, O vanquisher of foes, should regularly [perform] this
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, obeisances, incenses, lamps, and food. / One should sacrifice ghee into the fire and worship brahmins here.
At the conclusion of the observance, one should likewise give a milch cow. / This observance is declared to bestow the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

3.36.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe tathāpyetatkṛtvā saṃvatsaraṃ vratam..
rājasūyamavāpnoti phalamuddharati svakam..4..
kṛtvā pakṣadvayepyetadvrataṃ manujasattama..
rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam.5.
3.36.d:
कृष्णपक्षे तथाप्येतत्कृत्वा संवत्सरं व्रतम्॥
राजसूयमवाप्नोति फलमुद्धरति स्वकम्॥4॥
कृत्वा पक्षद्वयेप्येतद्व्रतं मनुजसत्तम॥
राजसूयाश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम्.5.
3.36.m:
Likewise, having performed this observance for a year during the dark fortnight, / one obtains the fruit of a Rājasūya and delivers one's own [kin].
Having performed this observance in both fortnights, O best of men, / one undoubtedly obtains the fruit of the Rājasūya and horse sacrifices.

3.36.s:
svargalokamavāpnoti kulamuddharati svakam..
dharme matirbhavettasya dharmamāpnotyasaṃśayam.6..
3.36.d:
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति कुलमुद्धरति स्वकम्॥
धर्मे मतिर्भवेत्तस्य धर्ममाप्नोत्यसंशयम्.6॥
3.36.m: One attains the heavenly world and elevates one's own lineage; / one's mind turns toward dharma, and one undoubtedly attains dharma.

3.36.s:
yatrayatrābhijāyeta tatra dharmaparo bhavet..
pradhānaṃ taṃ tayā rājanyatra dharmaparo bhavet ..7..
3.36.d:
यत्रयत्राभिजायेत तत्र धर्मपरो भवेत्॥
प्रधानं तं तया राजन्यत्र धर्मपरो भवेत् ॥7॥
3.36.m: Wherever one may be born, there one becomes dedicated to dharma; / he is foremost by that [very dharma], O king, wherever he is dedicated to dharma.

3.36.s:
ārogyamāyuṣyakaraṃ yaśasyaṃ sthānapradaṃ pāpavināśakāri ..
kartavyametatpuruṣairyathāvatpūjyo hi viṣṇurbhagavānsadharmaḥ ..8..
3.179
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. aṅgārakaṃ tathā sūryaṃ nirṛtiṃ vādyaśastathā ..
havanaṃ ceśvaraṃ mṛtyuṃ kapālimatha kiṃkiṇam .. 1 ..
tatra caikādaśāṃśaistu devāṃstribhuvaneśvarān ..
ekādaśyāṃ sopavāsaḥ somaṃ saṃpūjayettathā .. 2 ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā ..
mārgaśīrṣādathārabhya yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ bhavet .. 3 ..
saṃvatsarānte dadyācca tathā dhenuṃ payasvinīm ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ bhadratvamāpnoti narastu rājan ..
rudreṇa sārdha suciraṃ ramitvā kāmānavāpyātha manobhirāmān .. 4 ..
3.180
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
bhuvano bhānavaścaiva sujanyaḥ sujanastathā ..
kratuḥ sarvaśca mūrdhā ca tyājaśca vyamnakastathā .. 1 ..
3.36.d:
आरोग्यमायुष्यकरं यशस्यं स्थानप्रदं पापविनाशकारि ॥
कर्तव्यमेतत्पुरुषैर्यथावत्पूज्यो हि विष्णुर्भगवान्सधर्मः ॥8॥
3.179
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥ अङ्गारकं तथा सूर्यं निरृतिं वाद्यशस्तथा ॥
हवनं चेश्वरं मृत्युं कपालिमथ किंकिणम् ॥ 1 ॥
तत्र चैकादशांशैस्तु देवांस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरान् ॥
एकादश्यां सोपवासः सोमं संपूजयेत्तथा ॥ 2 ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसम्पदा ॥
मार्गशीर्षादथारभ्य यावत्संवत्सरं भवेत् ॥ 3 ॥
संवत्सरान्ते दद्याच्च तथा धेनुं पयस्विनीम् ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं भद्रत्वमाप्नोति नरस्तु राजन् ॥
रुद्रेण सार्ध सुचिरं रमित्वा कामानवाप्याथ मनोभिरामान् ॥ 4 ॥
3.180
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
भुवनो भानवश्चैव सुजन्यः सुजनस्तथा ॥
क्रतुः सर्वश्च मूर्धा च त्याजश्च व्यम्नकस्तथा ॥ 1 ॥
3.36.m:
It brings health, grants longevity, confers renown, gives status, and destroys sin; / this should be performed duly by men, for the Lord Viṣṇu, endowed with dharma, is to be worshipped.
3.179
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Aṅgāraka, Sūrya, Nirṛti, and Ādyaśa, / Havana, Īśvara, Mṛtyu, Kapālin, and Kiṅkiṇa,
and with an eleventh part there, the gods who are the lords of the three worlds— / fasting on the eleventh day, one should likewise worship Soma
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, obeisances, incenses, lamps, and food, / beginning from Mārgaśīrṣa until a year is complete.
At the end of the year, one should also give a milch cow. / Having performed this desired observance for a year, a man attains prosperity, O king; / after delighting for a very long time together with Rudra and attaining delightful desires, [he is reborn here].
3.180
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Bhuvana, Bhānu, Sujanya, Sujana, / Kratu, Sarva, Mūrdhan, Tyāja, Vyamnaka,

3.36.s:
prasavaścāpyayaścaiva dakṣo dvādaśakastathā ..
bhṛgavo nāma nirdiṣṭā devā dvādaśa yājñiyāḥ .. 2 ..
teṣāṃ sampūjanaṃ kuryāddvādaśyāṃ nityameva tu ..
mārgaśīrṣādathārabhya kṛṣṇapakṣe sadaiva tu .. 3 ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā ..
saṃvatsarānte dadyācca brāhmaṇāya payasvinīm .. 4 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ prāpnoti teṣāṃ ca salokameva ..
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyo rājā bhavedvā dvijapuṅgavo vā .. 5 ..
3.36.d:
प्रसवश्चाप्ययश्चैव दक्षो द्वादशकस्तथा ॥
भृगवो नाम निर्दिष्टा देवा द्वादश याज्ञियाः ॥ 2 ॥
तेषां सम्पूजनं कुर्याद्द्वादश्यां नित्यमेव तु ॥
मार्गशीर्षादथारभ्य कृष्णपक्षे सदैव तु ॥ 3 ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसम्पदा ॥
संवत्सरान्ते दद्याच्च ब्राह्मणाय पयस्विनीम् ॥ 4 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं प्राप्नोति तेषां च सलोकमेव ॥
तत्रोष्य कालं सुचिरं मनुष्यो राजा भवेद्वा द्विजपुङ्गवो वा ॥ 5 ॥
3.36.m:
Prasava, Apyaya, and Dakṣa as the twelfth— / these twelve gods designated as Bhṛgus are worthy of sacrifice.
One should always perform their worship on the twelfth day, / beginning from Mārgaśīrṣa, always in the dark fortnight,
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, obeisances, incenses, lamps, and food. / At the end of the year, one should give a milch cow to a brahmin.
Having performed this desired observance for a year, one attains residence in the same world as theirs; / having dwelt there for a very long time, a human being becomes a king or a foremost twice-born.

3.37.s:
3.181
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
mano mantastathā prāṇo naro yānaśca vīryavān ..
citirhayo nayaścaiva haṃso nārāyaṇastathā .. 1 ..
3.37.d:
3.181
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
मनो मन्तस्तथा प्राणो नरो यानश्च वीर्यवान् ॥
चितिर्हयो नयश्चैव हंसो नारायणस्तथा ॥ 1 ॥
3.37.m:
3.181
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Manas, Manta, Prāṇa, Nara, and the heroic Yāna, / Citi, Haya, Naya, Haṃsa, Nārāyaṇa,

3.37.s:
vibhuścāpi prabhuścaiva sādhyā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ ..
pūjayecchuklalapakṣe tāndvādaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣataḥ ..2 ..
3.37.d:
विभुश्चापि प्रभुश्चैव साध्या द्वादश कीर्तिताः ॥
पूजयेच्छुक्ललपक्षे तान्द्वादश्यां मार्गशीर्षतः ॥2 ॥
3.37.m: Vibhu, and Prabhu—these are proclaimed as the twelve Sādhyas. / One should worship them in the bright fortnight on the twelfth day, beginning from Mārgaśīrṣa.

3.37.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ prāpnoti teṣāṃ tu salokameva ..
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ narendra rājā bhavedbāhmaṇapuṅgavo vā .. 3 ..
3.182
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhātā mitroryamā pūṣā śakreśo varuṇo bhagaḥ ..
tvaṣṭā vivasvānsavitā viṣṇurdvādaśakastathā.. 1 ..
pūjayeddvādaśādityāñchuklapakṣe hyupoṣitaḥ ..
mārgaśīrṣādathārabhya gandhamālyānnasampadā .. 2 ..
dattvā vratānte puruṣaḥ suvarṇamāpnoti lokānsaviturnṛvīra ..
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo jitendriyaścaiva dhanānvitaśca .. 3 ..
3.183
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śuklapakṣe mahārāja trayodaśyāmupoṣitaḥ ..
pūjayetkāmadevantu vaiśākhātprabhṛti prabho .. 1 ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā ..
dadyādvratānte viprāya gandhavastrayugaṃ tathā .. 2 ..
3.37.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं प्राप्नोति तेषां तु सलोकमेव ॥
तत्रोष्य कालं सुचिरं नरेन्द्र राजा भवेद्बाह्मणपुङ्गवो वा ॥ 3 ॥
3.182
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
धाता मित्रोर्यमा पूषा शक्रेशो वरुणो भगः ॥
त्वष्टा विवस्वान्सविता विष्णुर्द्वादशकस्तथा॥ 1 ॥
पूजयेद्द्वादशादित्याञ्छुक्लपक्षे ह्युपोषितः ॥
मार्गशीर्षादथारभ्य गन्धमाल्यान्नसम्पदा ॥ 2 ॥
दत्त्वा व्रतान्ते पुरुषः सुवर्णमाप्नोति लोकान्सवितुर्नृवीर ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगो जितेन्द्रियश्चैव धनान्वितश्च ॥ 3 ॥
3.183
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
शुक्लपक्षे महाराज त्रयोदश्यामुपोषितः ॥
पूजयेत्कामदेवन्तु वैशाखात्प्रभृति प्रभो ॥ 1 ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसम्पदा ॥
दद्याद्व्रतान्ते विप्राय गन्धवस्त्रयुगं तथा ॥ 2 ॥
3.37.m:
Having performed this desired observance for a year, one attains residence in the same world as theirs; / having dwelt there for a very long time, O ruler of men, one becomes a king or a foremost brahmin.
3.182
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Dhātṛ, Mitra, Aryaman, Pūṣan, Śakreśa, Varuṇa, Bhaga, / Tvaṣṭṛ, Vivasvat, Savitṛ, and Viṣṇu as the twelfth.
Fasting, one should worship the twelve Ādityas in the bright fortnight, / beginning from Mārgaśīrṣa, with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, and food.
Having given gold at the end of the observance, a man attains the worlds of Savitṛ, O heroic king; / attaining human birth, he becomes free from disease, endowed with self-control, and wealthy.
3.183
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Fasting on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight, O great king, / one should worship Kāmadeva, starting from [the month of] Vaiśākha, O lord,
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, obeisances, incenses, lamps, and food. / At the end of the observance, one should give a pair of perfumed garments to a brahmin.

3.37.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭamāsādya lokaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ ..
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo sukhānvito rūpasarūpatā ca .. 3 ..
3.184
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śuklapakṣe mahārāja trayodaśyāmupoṣitaḥ ..
phālgunāttu samārabhya nityaṃ saṃpūjayennaraḥ .. 1 ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā ..
suvarṇaṃ brāhmaṇendrāya vratānte pratipādayet .. 2 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ yakṣeṣu rājansuciraṃ tathoṣya ..
mānuṣyamāsādya dhanānvitaḥ syātsaubhāgyayuktaśca tathā virogaḥ .. 3 ..
3.185
śuklapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ jyeṣṭhā dārabhya yādava..
vāyuṃ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..1..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā..
saṃvatsarānte dātavyaṃ vastrayugmaṃ dvijātaye .. 2..
3.37.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टमासाद्य लोकं सुचिरं मनुष्यः ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगो सुखान्वितो रूपसरूपता च ॥ 3 ॥
3.184
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
शुक्लपक्षे महाराज त्रयोदश्यामुपोषितः ॥
फाल्गुनात्तु समारभ्य नित्यं संपूजयेन्नरः ॥ 1 ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसम्पदा ॥
सुवर्णं ब्राह्मणेन्द्राय व्रतान्ते प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं यक्षेषु राजन्सुचिरं तथोष्य ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य धनान्वितः स्यात्सौभाग्ययुक्तश्च तथा विरोगः ॥ 3 ॥
3.185
शुक्लपक्षचतुर्दश्यां ज्येष्ठा दारभ्य यादव॥
वायुं संपूजयेद्देवं सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ॥1॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा॥
संवत्सरान्ते दातव्यं वस्त्रयुग्मं द्विजातये ॥ 2॥
3.37.m:
Having performed this desired observance for a year and reached his world for a very long time, / a man, upon attaining human birth, becomes free from disease, happy, and possessed of beauty and likeness [to Kāma].
3.184
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Fasting on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight, O great king,
beginning from Phālguna, a man should constantly worship [Kubera] 1
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, salutations, incense, lamps, and food.
At the conclusion of the vow, he should bestow gold upon an eminent brahmin. 2
Having observed this desirable vow for a year, O king, and dwelt among the yakṣas for a very long time,
upon attaining human birth, he would become endowed with wealth, possessed of good fortune, and free from disease. 3
3.185
Beginning from Jyeṣṭha, on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight, O descendant of Yadu,
fasting and with restrained senses, one should worship the god Vāyu 1
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, salutations, incense, lamps, and food.
At the end of the year, a pair of garments should be given to a twice-born. 2

3.37.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ cāsādya lokaṃ marutāṃ manuṣyaḥ .
sukhāni bhuktvā suciraṃ mahīpa mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogaḥ .. 3 ..
3.37.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं चासाद्य लोकं मरुतां मनुष्यः ।
सुखानि भुक्त्वा सुचिरं महीप मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगः ॥ 3 ॥
3.37.m:
Having observed this desirable vow for a year, and having attained the world of the Maruts, a man,
after enjoying pleasures for a very long time, O ruler of the earth, upon attaining human birth, becomes free from disease. 3

3.38.s:
3.186
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ virūpākṣaṃ tu pūjayet..
pauṣamāsādathārabhya yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ vratam ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā..
uṣṭraṃ dvijātaye dadyādvratānte ca parantapa ..2..
3.38.d:
3.186
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कृष्णपक्षचतुर्दश्यां विरूपाक्षं तु पूजयेत्॥
पौषमासादथारभ्य यावत्संवत्सरं व्रतम् ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसम्पदा॥
उष्ट्रं द्विजातये दद्याद्व्रतान्ते च परन्तप ॥2॥
3.38.m:
3.186
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, one should worship Virūpākṣa,
beginning from the month of Pauṣa for the duration of a year as a vow,
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, salutations, incense, lamps, and food.
And at the conclusion of the vow, O scorcher of foes, one should give a camel to a twice-born. 2

3.38.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ bhayaṃ na cāpnoti sa rākṣasebhyaḥ ..
kāmānavāpnoti bhavatyarogo bhayaṃ ca rājanna ca vetti kiṃcit .. 3 ..
3.187
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
yatra kvacana nadyāṃ ca yatra kṛṣṇacatudarśī ..
anarkābhyudite kāle devaṃ saṃpūjayedyamam ..1..
dhūmrorṇaṃ citraguptaṃ ca kālapāśau ca yādava ..
mṛtyuṃ svargaṃ ca dharmajñaṃ gandhamālyānnasampadā .. 2..
yamo dadhāra ityarcāṃ tilām̐śca juhuyāttataḥ ..
namo yamāyeti tathā strīśūdrasya vidhīyate .. 3 ..
3.38.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं भयं न चाप्नोति स राक्षसेभ्यः ॥
कामानवाप्नोति भवत्यरोगो भयं च राजन्न च वेत्ति किंचित् ॥ 3 ॥
3.187
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
यत्र क्वचन नद्यां च यत्र कृष्णचतुदर्शी ॥
अनर्काभ्युदिते काले देवं संपूजयेद्यमम् ॥1॥
धूम्रोर्णं चित्रगुप्तं च कालपाशौ च यादव ॥
मृत्युं स्वर्गं च धर्मज्ञं गन्धमाल्यान्नसम्पदा ॥ 2॥
यमो दधार इत्यर्चां तिलाम्̐श्च जुहुयात्ततः ॥
नमो यमायेति तथा स्त्रीशूद्रस्य विधीयते ॥ 3 ॥
3.38.m:
Having observed this desirable vow for a year, he incurs no fear from rākṣasas;
he attains his desires, becomes free from disease, and, O king, knows no fear whatsoever. 3
3.187
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
At whatever river, whenever there is the fourteenth of the dark [fortnight],
at the time before the sun has risen, one should worship the god Yama, 1
Dhūmrorṇā, Citragupta, Kāla, and Pāśa, O descendant of Yadu,
Mṛtyu, Svarga, and Dharma, with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, and food. 2
With the worship [formula] ‘Yamo dadhāra’ he should then offer sesame seeds into the fire.
For a woman and a śūdra, however, ‘Namo Yamāya’ is prescribed. 3

3.38.s:
kṛsaraṃ bhojanaṃ viprānyathā śakti narottama ..
dadyādvratānte viprāya tathaiva ca payasvinīm .. 4 ..
3.38.d:
कृसरं भोजनं विप्रान्यथा शक्ति नरोत्तम ॥
दद्याद्व्रतान्ते विप्राय तथैव च पयस्विनीम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.38.m:
According to one's capacity, O best of men, [he should feed] brahmins a meal of kṛsara.
At the conclusion of the vow, he should likewise give a milch cow to a brahmin. 4

3.38.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ na yāti rājannarakaṃ manuṣyaḥ ..
prāṇakṣayaṃ prāpya sa yāti nākaṃ mānuṣyamāsādya ca dharmavānsyāt .. 5 ..
3.188
śuklapakṣādathārabhya phālgunasya narādhipa ..
pūjayettu caturdaśyāṃ sopavāso maheśvaram ..1..
gandhamālyanamaskāra dhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā ..
vratānte gāṃ tathā dadyādagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. 2 ..
etadeva vrataṃ kṛtvā śuklapakṣe tu vatsaram ..
puṇḍarīkamavāpnoti kulamuddharati svakam .. 3 ..
caturdaśīdvayaṃ caitatkṛtvā saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ ..
māsimāsi tathā bhaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 4 ..
āsādya kāmāṃśca maheśvarasya tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ ca rājan ..
sāyujyamāyāti maheśvarasya sarveśvasyāpratimasya tasya .. ..
3.189
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
prabhāsvarā barhiṣada agniṣvāttāstathaiva ca ..
kravyādaścopahūtāśca ājyapāśca sukālinaḥ .. 1 ..
3.38.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं न याति राजन्नरकं मनुष्यः ॥
प्राणक्षयं प्राप्य स याति नाकं मानुष्यमासाद्य च धर्मवान्स्यात् ॥ 5 ॥
3.188
शुक्लपक्षादथारभ्य फाल्गुनस्य नराधिप ॥
पूजयेत्तु चतुर्दश्यां सोपवासो महेश्वरम् ॥1॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कार धूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥
व्रतान्ते गां तथा दद्यादग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥ 2 ॥
एतदेव व्रतं कृत्वा शुक्लपक्षे तु वत्सरम् ॥
पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति कुलमुद्धरति स्वकम् ॥ 3 ॥
चतुर्दशीद्वयं चैतत्कृत्वा संवत्सरं नरः ॥
मासिमासि तथा भक्त्या सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 4 ॥
आसाद्य कामांश्च महेश्वरस्य तत्रोष्य कालं सुचिरं च राजन् ॥
सायुज्यमायाति महेश्वरस्य सर्वेश्वस्याप्रतिमस्य तस्य ॥ ॥
3.189
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
प्रभास्वरा बर्हिषद अग्निष्वात्तास्तथैव च ॥
क्रव्यादश्चोपहूताश्च आज्यपाश्च सुकालिनः ॥ 1 ॥
3.38.m:
Having observed this desirable vow for a year, a man, O king, does not go to hell.
Reaching the end of his life, he goes to heaven, and upon attaining human birth, he becomes righteous. 5
3.188
Beginning from the bright fortnight of Phālguna, O ruler of men,
fasting on the fourteenth day, one should worship Maheśvara 1
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, salutations, incense, lamps, and food.
At the conclusion of the vow, he should likewise give a cow; he obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma. 2
Having performed this very vow for a year in the bright fortnight,
he obtains [the fruit of] a Puṇḍarīka [sacrifice] and delivers his own family. 3
And having observed [the vow on] both fourteenth days for a year,
month by month with devotion, a man would obtain all his desires. 4
Having obtained his desires and having dwelt there for a very long time, O king,
he attains union with Maheśvara, the matchless Lord of all. [5]
3.189
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
The Prabhāsvaras, Barhiṣads, and likewise the Agniṣvāttas,
the Kravyāds, the Upahūtas, the Ājyapas, and the Sukālins 1

3.38.s:
pūjyāḥ pitṛgaṇā rājannupavāsena nityaśaḥ ..
caitraśuklādathārabhya pañcadaśyāṃ narādhipa ..2 ..
śrāddhaṃ tadahni kurvīta yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ bhavet ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā .. 3 ..
saṃvatsarānte dadyācca tathā dhenuṃ payasvinīm ..
brāhmaṇāya mahābhāga pitṛbhaktāya bhaktitaḥ .. 4 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ prāpnoti lokaṃ ca tathā sa teṣām ..
tatroṣya rājansuciraṃ sukālaṃ prāpnoti mokṣaṃ puruṣapradhāna ..5..
3.190
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe pañcadaśyāṃ caitrādārabhya yādava ..
vahnisampūjanaṃ kṛtvā gandhamālyānnasampadā .. 1 ..
tilairhomastataḥ kuryānnāmnā vahnernarādhipa ..
saṃvatsarānte dadyācca suvarṇaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca .. 2 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ prāpnoti vittaṃ satataṃ yaśaśca ..
dharme matiṃ rūpamanuttamaṃ ca kāmānyatheṣṭānpuruṣapradhāna .. 3 ..
3.38.d:
पूज्याः पितृगणा राजन्नुपवासेन नित्यशः ॥
चैत्रशुक्लादथारभ्य पञ्चदश्यां नराधिप ॥2 ॥
श्राद्धं तदह्नि कुर्वीत यावत्संवत्सरं भवेत् ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसम्पदा ॥ 3 ॥
संवत्सरान्ते दद्याच्च तथा धेनुं पयस्विनीम् ॥
ब्राह्मणाय महाभाग पितृभक्ताय भक्तितः ॥ 4 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं प्राप्नोति लोकं च तथा स तेषाम् ॥
तत्रोष्य राजन्सुचिरं सुकालं प्राप्नोति मोक्षं पुरुषप्रधान ॥5॥
3.190
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कृष्णपक्षे पञ्चदश्यां चैत्रादारभ्य यादव ॥
वह्निसम्पूजनं कृत्वा गन्धमाल्यान्नसम्पदा ॥ 1 ॥
तिलैर्होमस्ततः कुर्यान्नाम्ना वह्नेर्नराधिप ॥
संवत्सरान्ते दद्याच्च सुवर्णं ब्राह्मणाय च ॥ 2 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं प्राप्नोति वित्तं सततं यशश्च ॥
धर्मे मतिं रूपमनुत्तमं च कामान्यथेष्टान्पुरुषप्रधान ॥ 3 ॥
3.38.m:
are the classes of ancestors to be worshipped, O king, constantly with fasting,
beginning from the bright [fortnight] of Caitra, on the fifteenth day, O ruler of men. 2
He should perform a śrāddha on that day until a year is completed,
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, salutations, incense, lamps, and food. 3
And at the end of the year, he should give a milch cow with devotion
to a brahmin devoted to the ancestors, O fortunate one. 4
Having observed this desirable vow for a year, he attains their world;
and having dwelt there for a very long and happy time, O king, he attains liberation, O foremost of men. 5
3.190
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
On the fifteenth day of the dark fortnight, beginning from Caitra, O descendant of Yadu,
having performed the worship of Fire with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, and food, 1
he should then make an oblation with sesame seeds invoking the name of Fire, O ruler of men.
And at the end of the year, he should give gold to a brahmin. 2
Having observed this desirable vow for a year, he constantly obtains wealth and fame,
a mind [fixed] on dharma, unsurpassed beauty, and desires as he wishes, O foremost of men. 3

3.39.s:
3.191
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
amāvāsyāṃ tu velāyāṃ sopavāso narottama ..
padmadvayaṃ pūjayeta caṃdrārkāvekarāśigau .. .. 1 ..
3.39.d:
3.191
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अमावास्यां तु वेलायां सोपवासो नरोत्तम ॥
पद्मद्वयं पूजयेत चंद्रार्कावेकराशिगौ ॥ ॥ 1 ॥
3.39.m:
3.191
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
At the time of the new moon, fasting, O best of men,
he should worship two lotuses, with the moon and the sun stationed in a single zodiacal sign: 1

3.39.s:
ādityamaṣṭakamale candraṃ ṣoḍaśake tathā ..
ādityaṃ sarvaraktena candraṃ śuklena yādava .. 2 ..
3.39.d:
आदित्यमष्टकमले चन्द्रं षोडशके तथा ॥
आदित्यं सर्वरक्तेन चन्द्रं शुक्लेन यादव ॥ 2 ॥
3.39.m:
the sun in an eight-[petalled] lotus, and the moon in a sixteen-[petalled] one;
the sun with everything red, and the moon with white, O descendant of Yadu, 2

3.39.s:
mālyādinā mahābhāga homayettilataṇḍulaiḥ ..
ghṛtakṣīrayuto rājantayornāmnā yathāvidhi .. 3..
3.39.d:
माल्यादिना महाभाग होमयेत्तिलतण्डुलैः ॥
घृतक्षीरयुतो राजन्तयोर्नाम्ना यथाविधि ॥ 3॥
3.39.m:
with garlands and the like, O fortunate one. He should offer oblations of sesame and rice grains
combined with ghee and milk, O king, with the names of the two according to rule. 3

3.39.s:
vratānte brāhmaṇendrāya kanakaṃ pratipādayet ..
rajataṃ ca mahābhāga ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ .. 4 ..
3.39.d:
व्रतान्ते ब्राह्मणेन्द्राय कनकं प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
रजतं च महाभाग य इच्छेद्भूतिमात्मनः ॥ 4 ॥
3.39.m:
At the conclusion of the vow, he who desires his own prosperity
should bestow gold and silver upon an eminent brahmin, O fortunate one. 4

3.39.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatmarametadiṣṭaṃ dattvā ca dīpānvidhivatprabhūtān ..
cakṣuḥ paraṃ prāpya vivṛddhatejā dhanānvitaḥ syāttridivādihasthaḥ .. 5 ..
3.192
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kārtikāttu tathārabhya sampūrṇaśaśalakṣaṇam ..
pūjayedudare rājansadā naktāśano bhavet .. 1 ..
lāvaṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā candanenānulepite ..
daśanakṣatrasahitaṃ tatra somaṃ tu pūjayet .. 2 ..
kṛttikārohiṇīyuktaṃ kārtike māsi pūjayet ..
saumyārdrāsahitaṃ rājanmāsi saumye tathaiva ca .. 3 ..
ādityapuṣyasahitaṃ māsi pauṣe ca yādava ..
maghāsarpayutaṃ māghe phālgune śṛṇu pārthiva .. 4 ..
aryamṇabhāgyasāvitraiḥ sahitaṃ pūjayedvibhum ..
citrāsvātiyutaṃ caitraṃ vaiśākhe śṛṇu pārthiva .. 5 ..
3.39.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्मरमेतदिष्टं दत्त्वा च दीपान्विधिवत्प्रभूतान् ॥
चक्षुः परं प्राप्य विवृद्धतेजा धनान्वितः स्यात्त्रिदिवादिहस्थः ॥ 5 ॥
3.192
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कार्तिकात्तु तथारभ्य सम्पूर्णशशलक्षणम् ॥
पूजयेदुदरे राजन्सदा नक्ताशनो भवेत् ॥ 1 ॥
लावणं मण्डलं कृत्वा चन्दनेनानुलेपिते ॥
दशनक्षत्रसहितं तत्र सोमं तु पूजयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
कृत्तिकारोहिणीयुक्तं कार्तिके मासि पूजयेत् ॥
सौम्यार्द्रासहितं राजन्मासि सौम्ये तथैव च ॥ 3 ॥
आदित्यपुष्यसहितं मासि पौषे च यादव ॥
मघासर्पयुतं माघे फाल्गुने शृणु पार्थिव ॥ 4 ॥
अर्यम्णभाग्यसावित्रैः सहितं पूजयेद्विभुम् ॥
चित्रास्वातियुतं चैत्रं वैशाखे शृणु पार्थिव ॥ 5 ॥
3.39.m:
Having observed this desirable vow for a year, and having duly given plentiful lamps,
having attained excellent sight and increased brilliance, he would be endowed with wealth, [as if] stationed in heaven while still here. 5
3.192 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Beginning indeed from Kārtika, when the hare-marked [moon] is full, / one should worship [it], O king, inside [the house?], and always eat only at night.
Having made a saline sacred diagram on [ground] smeared with sandalwood, / one should worship Soma there together with ten asterisms.
In the month of Kārtika, one should worship [him] joined with Kṛttikā and Rohiṇī; / and likewise, O king, in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, joined with Saumyā and Ārdrā;
in the month of Pauṣa, joined with Āditya and Puṣya, O Yādava; / in Māgha, joined with Maghā and Sarpā. In Phālguna, listen, O king:
one should worship the lord joined with Aryamṇa, Bhāgya, and Sāvitra; / in Caitra, joined with Citrā and Svāti; in Vaiśākha, listen, O king:

3.39.s:
viśākhayā ca maitreṇa yutaṃ saṃpūjayettathā..
jyeṣṭhāmūlayutaṃ jyeṣṭhe āṣāḍhādyāmanantaram .. 6 ..
3.39.d:
विशाखया च मैत्रेण युतं संपूजयेत्तथा॥
ज्येष्ठामूलयुतं ज्येष्ठे आषाढाद्यामनन्तरम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.39.m: one should likewise worship [him] joined with Viśākhā and Maitra; / in Jyeṣṭha, joined with Jyeṣṭhā and Mūla; next, in Āṣāḍha with the first [Āṣāḍhā];

3.39.s:
śrāvaṇe śravaṇopetaṃ sahitaṃ ca śraviṣṭhayā ..
tathā bhādrapade pauṣṇāmājāhirbudhnyasaṃyutam ..7..
3.39.d:
श्रावणे श्रवणोपेतं सहितं च श्रविष्ठया ॥
तथा भाद्रपदे पौष्णामाजाहिर्बुध्न्यसंयुतम् ॥7॥
3.39.m: in Śrāvaṇa, attended by Śravaṇa and accompanied by Śraviṣṭhā; / and so in Bhādrapada, joined with Pauṣṇā, Ājā, and Ahirbudhnyā;
and in Āśvayuja, the lord joined with Aśvinī and Bharaṇī, / with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, salutations, incense, lamps, and food,

3.39.s:
guḍena paramānnena lavaṇena ghṛtena ca..
ikṣuṇekṣuvikāraiśca payasā pāyasena ca ..9..
3.39.d:
गुडेन परमान्नेन लवणेन घृतेन च॥
इक्षुणेक्षुविकारैश्च पयसा पायसेन च ॥9॥
3.39.m: with jaggery, fine rice-milk, salt, and ghee, / with sugarcane, sugarcane products, milk, and sweet milk-rice.

3.39.s:
pūjyāścāvidhavānāryastathā tallakṣaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
tato'nantaramaśnīyāddhaviṣyaṃ prayato naraḥ .. 10 ..
3.39.d:
पूज्याश्चाविधवानार्यस्तथा तल्लक्षणैः शुभैः ॥
ततोऽनन्तरमश्नीयाद्धविष्यं प्रयतो नरः ॥ 10 ॥
3.39.m: And non-widowed women should be worshipped with their auspicious marks. / Immediately thereafter, the restrained man should eat sacrificial food.

3.39.s:
brāhmaṇānāṃ vratānte tu mahārajataraṃjitam ..
śaktyā ca vasanaṃ dadyānnārī vā yadi vā naraḥ .. 11 ..
3.39.d:
ब्राह्मणानां व्रतान्ते तु महारजतरंजितम् ॥
शक्त्या च वसनं दद्यान्नारी वा यदि वा नरः ॥ 11 ॥
3.39.m: At the conclusion of the vow, to brahmins, dyed with safflower / according to one's capacity, a cloth should be given, either by a woman or a man.

3.39.s:
rūpasaubhāgyalāvaṇyadhanayukto bhavennaraḥ ..
vratenānena cīrṇena svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 12 ..
3.39.d:
रूपसौभाग्यलावण्यधनयुक्तो भवेन्नरः ॥
व्रतेनानेन चीर्णेन स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 12 ॥
3.39.m: The man becomes endowed with beauty, good fortune, charm, and wealth; / and having observed this vow, he goes to the heavenly world.

3.39.s:
sopavāsastu yaḥ kuryādvratametadanuttamam ..
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 13 ..
3.39.d:
सोपवासस्तु यः कुर्याद्व्रतमेतदनुत्तमम् ॥
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ 13 ॥
3.39.m: A mortal who performs this unsurpassed vow fasting / obtains the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices.

3.39.s:
saubhāgyādi ca yatproktaṃ tadāpnoti viśeṣavat ..
manasā kāṃkṣitānkāmānsarvānprāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 14 ..
3.39.d:
सौभाग्यादि च यत्प्रोक्तं तदाप्नोति विशेषवत् ॥
मनसा कांक्षितान्कामान्सर्वान्प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.39.m: And he obtains in full what was mentioned—good fortune and the rest; / without doubt, he obtains all the desires longed for in his mind.

3.39.s:
janābhirāmaśca śaśāṅkavatsyāddhanādilābhaśca tathaiva lakṣmyā ..
śakreṇa tulyaśca tathaiva śaktyā mānuṣyamāsādya bhavecca rājan .. 19 ..
3.193
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kārtike paurṇamāsyāṃ tu pūrṇaṃ śiśiradīdhitim..
padme ṣoḍaśapatreṣu karṇikāyāṃ tu pūjayet .. 1 ..
kesare pūjayettatra nakṣatrāṇyaṣṭaviṃśatiḥ ..
patreṣu tithidevāṃśca tathā jyotsnāṃ ca pūjayet .. 2 ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā ..
guḍena paramānnena dadhnā ca lavaṇena ca .. 3 ..
apūpaiśca mahābhāga phalaiḥ kālodbhavaistathā..
vratāvasāne dadyācca vāsoyugmaṃ dvijātaye .. 4 ..
brāhmaṇyai ca mahābhāga mahārajatarañjitam ..
pūjyau ca vidhinā śaktyā kālavidvācakāvubhau .. 6 .
sopavāso'tha naktāśī vratametatsamācaret ..
naktāśano vā dharmajña tathaiva ca haviṣyabhuk .. 6 ..
3.39.d:
जनाभिरामश्च शशाङ्कवत्स्याद्धनादिलाभश्च तथैव लक्ष्म्या ॥
शक्रेण तुल्यश्च तथैव शक्त्या मानुष्यमासाद्य भवेच्च राजन् ॥ 19 ॥
3.193
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कार्तिके पौर्णमास्यां तु पूर्णं शिशिरदीधितिम्॥
पद्मे षोडशपत्रेषु कर्णिकायां तु पूजयेत् ॥ 1 ॥
केसरे पूजयेत्तत्र नक्षत्राण्यष्टविंशतिः ॥
पत्रेषु तिथिदेवांश्च तथा ज्योत्स्नां च पूजयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥
गुडेन परमान्नेन दध्ना च लवणेन च ॥ 3 ॥
अपूपैश्च महाभाग फलैः कालोद्भवैस्तथा॥
व्रतावसाने दद्याच्च वासोयुग्मं द्विजातये ॥ 4 ॥
ब्राह्मण्यै च महाभाग महारजतरञ्जितम् ॥
पूज्यौ च विधिना शक्त्या कालविद्वाचकावुभौ ॥ 6 ।
सोपवासोऽथ नक्ताशी व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत् ॥
नक्ताशनो वा धर्मज्ञ तथैव च हविष्यभुक् ॥ 6 ॥
3.39.m:
He will be charming to people like the moon, and likewise gain wealth through Lakṣmī; / and having attained human birth, O king, he will be equal to Śakra in power.
3.193 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On the full moon in Kārtika, in the pericarp / of a sixteen-petalled lotus, one should worship the full, cool-rayed [moon].
There on the filaments one should worship the twenty-eight asterisms, / and on the petals the deities of the lunar days, and likewise worship moonlight,
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, salutations, incense, lamps, and food, / with jaggery, fine rice-milk, curds, and salt,
and with cakes, O fortunate one, as well as fruits produced in season. / At the end of the vow, one should give a pair of garments to a twice-born,
and to a brahmin woman, O fortunate one, [cloth] dyed with safflower. / Both, being astrologer and reciter, should be honoured according to rule and according to one's capacity.
One should perform this vow fasting, or eating at night; / or eating at night, O knower of dharma, and likewise eating sacrificial food.

3.39.s:
saubhāgyadaṃ rūpavivardhanaṃ ca lāvaṇyadaṃ strīratibhogadaṃ ca ..
kāryaṃ prayatnena narendra puṃsā kāryaṃ tathā strībhiradīnasattva .. 7 ..
3.194
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
mārgaśīrṣādathārabhya candramaṇḍalake naraḥ ..
sopavāsastu saṃpūjya pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet .. 1 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadiṣṭaṃ prāpnoti lokaṃ sa niśākarasya ..
tatroṣya rājansuciraṃ ca kālaṃ sāyujyamāpnoti tataśca tasya .. 2 ..
3.195
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
proṣṭhapādādathārabhya saṃpūrṇe śaśalāñchane ..
saṃpūjya varuṇaṃ devaṃ gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā .. 1 ..
dattvā vratāvasāne tu jaladhenuṃ dvijātaye ..
chatropānahasaṃyuktāṃ vāsoyugavibhūṣitām .. 2 ..
prāpnoti lokaṃ varuṇasya rājaṃstatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ ..
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogī rūpānvito vittayutastathaiva .. 3 ..
3.39.d:
सौभाग्यदं रूपविवर्धनं च लावण्यदं स्त्रीरतिभोगदं च ॥
कार्यं प्रयत्नेन नरेन्द्र पुंसा कार्यं तथा स्त्रीभिरदीनसत्त्व ॥ 7 ॥
3.194
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
मार्गशीर्षादथारभ्य चन्द्रमण्डलके नरः ॥
सोपवासस्तु संपूज्य पौण्डरीकफलं लभेत् ॥ 1 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं प्राप्नोति लोकं स निशाकरस्य ॥
तत्रोष्य राजन्सुचिरं च कालं सायुज्यमाप्नोति ततश्च तस्य ॥ 2 ॥
3.195
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
प्रोष्ठपादादथारभ्य संपूर्णे शशलाञ्छने ॥
संपूज्य वरुणं देवं गन्धमाल्यान्नसंपदा ॥ 1 ॥
दत्त्वा व्रतावसाने तु जलधेनुं द्विजातये ॥
छत्रोपानहसंयुक्तां वासोयुगविभूषिताम् ॥ 2 ॥
प्राप्नोति लोकं वरुणस्य राजंस्तत्रोष्य कालं सुचिरं मनुष्यः ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगी रूपान्वितो वित्तयुतस्तथैव ॥ 3 ॥
3.39.m:
Bestowing good fortune, enhancing beauty, bestowing charm, and granting the pleasure of love with women, / [this vow] must be performed with effort by a man, O lord of men, and likewise by women, O you of undaunted spirit.
3.194 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Beginning from Mārgaśīrṣa, having worshipped [the deity] in the disc of the moon / while fasting, a man obtains the fruit of a Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice.
Having performed this desired vow for a year, he reaches the world of the moon; / and dwelling there for a very long time, O king, he then attains union with him.
3.195 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Beginning from Proṣṭhapada, on the full moon, / having worshipped the god Varuṇa with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, and food,
and at the end of the vow having given to a twice-born a water-cow / accompanied by an umbrella and shoes, and adorned with a pair of garments,
a man reaches the world of Varuṇa, O king; and dwelling there for a very long time, / upon attaining human birth he becomes free from disease, endowed with beauty, and rich.

3.40.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-sixth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Vow of Śakra', in the third book of the auspicious Viṣṇudharmottara, in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra.
3.197 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Fasting on the fourteenth and on the full moon, the best of men / should then drink the five products of the cow and partake of sacrificial food.
Having done so for a year, he is freed from the sins of a month; / therefore, with all effort, one should observe it month by month.
Reaching the world of the lord of men for a year, and dwelling there for a very long time, O king, / upon attaining human birth, honoured by kings, that foremost of the twice-born becomes either a king or an eminent twice-born.
3.198
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Fasting on the fourteenth, / one who worships the god Hari in the form of yoga on the full moon obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.
Likewise [worshipping him] in the form of brahman on the new moon and on the full moon, / one obtains [the fruit of] a Rājasūya sacrifice and elevates one's own family.

ब्रह्मभूतममावस्यां पौर्णमास्यां च पूजयेत् ॥
योगभूतं परिचरन्केशवं महदाप्नुयात् ॥ 3 ॥
अत्यर्थं प्रीतिमायाति मासपक्षान्तयोः सदा ॥
पूजितः सोपवासेन भक्त्या देववरो हरिः ॥ 4 ॥
महाव्रतमिदं ख्यातं सर्वकल्मषनाशनम् ॥

सर्वपापप्रशमनं व्रतमेतत्प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
स्ववित्तशक्तिरेवात्र सर्वकर्मसु कारणम् ॥ 6 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं द्वादशवत्सराणि प्राप्नोति लोकं पुरुषोत्तमस्य ॥
तत्रोष्य राजन्सुचिरं सुकालं प्राप्नोति मोक्षं पुरुषस्ततोन्ते ॥ 7 ॥
3.199

भगवन्कर्मणा केन तिर्यग्योनौ न जायते ॥

मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
मेषसंक्रमणे भानोः सोपवासो नरोत्तमः ॥
पूजयेद्भार्गवं रामं देवं शक्त्या यथाविधि ॥ 2 ॥
3.40.m:
One should worship him in the form of brahman on the new moon and on the full moon; / serving Keśava in the form of yoga, one attains greatness.
At the ends of the months and fortnights, the supreme god Hari / is always exceedingly pleased when worshipped with devotion by one who fasts.
This is known as the Great Observance, which destroys all impurities. / Having performed this for a year, one is exalted in the vault of heaven.
This observance is proclaimed to pacify all sins. / Here, one's own financial capacity alone is the measure in all rituals.
Having observed the vow for twelve years, a man reaches the world of Puruṣottama; / having dwelt there for a very long, auspicious time, O king, he then ultimately attains liberation.
3.199
Vajra said:
O venerable one, by what action is a man not born in an animal womb / or in a barbarian land? Tell that to me as I ask.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
At the Sun's transit into Aries, fasting, the best of men / should worship the god Bhārgava Rāma according to rule and to the best of his ability.

कन्यासंक्रमणे प्राप्ते तथा कृष्णं च पूजयेत् ॥
तथा मिथुनसंक्रान्तौ पूजयेद्भोगशायिनम् ॥ 3 ॥
तथा कुलीरसंक्रान्तौ वराहमपराजितम् ॥
नरसिंहं तथा देवं सिंहसंक्रमणे विभुम् ॥
कन्यासंक्रमणे देवं स्त्रीरूपं पूजयेन्नरः ॥ 4 ॥
तुलासंक्रमणे प्राप्ते वामनं नृप पूजयेत् ॥
तथा वृश्चिकसंक्रान्तौ देवदेवं त्रिविक्रमम् ॥ 5 ॥
धनुःसंक्रमणे देवं तथाश्वशिरसं नृप ॥
तथा मकरसंक्रान्तौ रामं दशरथात्मजम् ॥ 6 ॥
कुंभसंक्रमणे राजन्रामं यादवनन्दनम् ॥
मीनसंक्रणे मत्स्यं वासुदेवं तु पूजयेत् ॥7॥
पटे वा यदि वार्चायां गन्धमाल्यान्नसंपदा ॥
प्रादुर्भावस्य नाम्नाश्च होमं कुर्वीत पार्थिव॥8॥
व्रतान्ते जलधेनुं च च्छत्रोपानत्समन्विताम्॥
वस्त्रयुग्मयुतां दद्यात्प्रतिमासं च काञ्चनम् ॥
रात्रौ च दीपमालाभिर्देवदेवं तु पूजयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
3.40.m:
[...] and when the transit into Gemini occurs, one should worship the one who reclines on the serpent hood.
Likewise, at the transit into Cancer, the invincible Boar; / likewise, at the transit into Leo, the lord god Narasiṃha; / at the transit into Virgo, a man should worship the god in female form.
When the transit into Libra has arrived, O king, one should worship Vāmana; / likewise, at the transit into Scorpio, the god of gods, Trivikrama.
At the transit into Sagittarius, O king, [worship] the horse-headed god; / likewise, at the transit into Capricorn, Rāma, the son of Daśaratha.
At the transit into Aquarius, O king, [worship] Rāma, the delight of the Yādavas; / and at the transit into Pisces, one should worship the Fish, Vāsudeva.
Either on a painted cloth or in an icon, with an abundance of perfume, garlands, and food, / and in the name of each manifestation, one should make a fire oblation, O ruler of the earth.
At the end of the observance, one should give a water-cow provided with an umbrella and sandals / and accompanied by a pair of garments, and gold every month; / and at night one should worship the god of gods with rows of lamps.

कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदिष्टं म्लेच्छेषु तिर्यक्षु न चापि जन्म ॥
प्राप्नोत्यवाप्नोति चिरं च नाकं कामं तथाप्नोति मनोभिरामम् ॥ 30 ॥
3.200
वज्र उवाच ॥
इष्टां जातिमवाप्नोति कर्मणा येन मानवः ॥
तन्ममाचक्ष्व धर्मज्ञ त्वं हि सर्वविदुच्यसे ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
पौरुषेषु सदा ते वै त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः ॥
चैत्रमासादथारभ्य कार्तिके पूजयेद्धरिम् ॥ 2 ॥
पौरुषेण च सूक्तेन ऋग्भिः पुष्पैः फलैस्तथा ॥
धूपैर्दीपैस्तथान्नेन घृताहुतिभिरेव च ॥ 3 ॥
धेनुर्व्रतान्ते दातव्या कृत्वा संवत्सरं व्रतम् ॥
यथेष्टां जातिमाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 4 ॥
न केवलं जातिकरं प्रदिष्टं व्रतोत्तमं यावददीनसत्त्व ॥
कामानभीष्टान्पुरुषस्य दद्यान्मोक्षं च दद्यात्पुरुषप्रधान ॥ 5 ॥
3.40.m:
Having performed this desired observance for a year, one is not born among barbarians or animals; / he reaches heaven for a long time and attains desired happiness pleasing to the heart.
3.200
Vajra said:
By which action does a human being obtain the desired birth? / Tell me that, O knower of dharma, for you are said to be all-knowing.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Always on days sacred to Puruṣa, fasting for three nights, a man, / beginning from the month of Caitra, should worship Hari in Kārtika,
with the Puruṣasūkta, with its verses, with flowers, and likewise with fruits, / with incenses, lamps, and food, and with oblations of clarified butter.
A cow should be given at the end of the observance, having performed the observance for a year. / He obtains the birth he desires; no doubt should be entertained here.
This best of observances is not taught to yield [a good] birth alone, O unflagging soul; / it bestows the desired wishes of a man, and gives liberation, O foremost of men.

Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Having faced the great direction, fasting for three nights, a man, / beginning from Mārgaśīrṣa, should worship Trivikrama,
