3.41.m: he should offer an oblation of the three sweets, and three lamps, O best of kings; / a fire offering should be made with barley and sesame together with mustard seeds.

3.41.s:
dadyāttrilohaṃ ca tathā dvijebhyastāmraṃ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ca rājan ..
na kevalaṃ satkuladaṃ vrataṃ tu yatheṣṭakāmāptikaraṃ pradiṣṭam .. 5 ..
3.202
vajra uvāca ..
bhavankarmaṇā kena rūpavāñjāyate naraḥ ..
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi tvaṃ hi sarvaviducyase .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
phālgunyāṃ samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt ..
yāvaccaitrī mahārāja tāvatsnāto dinedine..2..
bahiḥ sampūjayeddevaṃ keśavaṃ bhogaśāyinam ..
ekabhaktāśano naktamadhaḥśāyī tathā bhaveta .. 3 ..
trirātropoṣitaḥ kuryātpūjāṃ caitryāṃ tathaiva ca ..
svaśaktyā rajataṃ dadyādvastrayugmaṃ tathaiva ca .. 4 ..
rūpārthino māsamidaṃ mayoktaṃ vratottamaṃ nityamadīnasattva ..
kṛtvā ca nākaṃ manujastvavāpya mānuṣyamāsādya ca rūpavānsyāt .. 5 ..
3.41.d:
दद्यात्त्रिलोहं च तथा द्विजेभ्यस्ताम्रं सुवर्णं रजतं च राजन् ॥
न केवलं सत्कुलदं व्रतं तु यथेष्टकामाप्तिकरं प्रदिष्टम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.202
वज्र उवाच ॥
भवन्कर्मणा केन रूपवाञ्जायते नरः ॥
एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि त्वं हि सर्वविदुच्यसे ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
फाल्गुन्यां समतीतायां प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥
यावच्चैत्री महाराज तावत्स्नातो दिनेदिने॥2॥
बहिः सम्पूजयेद्देवं केशवं भोगशायिनम् ॥
एकभक्ताशनो नक्तमधःशायी तथा भवेत ॥ 3 ॥
त्रिरात्रोपोषितः कुर्यात्पूजां चैत्र्यां तथैव च ॥
स्वशक्त्या रजतं दद्याद्वस्त्रयुग्मं तथैव च ॥ 4 ॥
रूपार्थिनो मासमिदं मयोक्तं व्रतोत्तमं नित्यमदीनसत्त्व ॥
कृत्वा च नाकं मनुजस्त्ववाप्य मानुष्यमासाद्य च रूपवान्स्यात् ॥ 5 ॥
3.41.m:
And likewise, O king, he should give the three metals—copper, gold, and silver—to brahmins. / The observance is taught not only to bestow a noble family, but also to bring about the attainment of all desired wishes.
3.202
Vajra said:
O venerable one, by what action is a man born handsome? / Cut this doubt of mine, for you are said to be all-knowing.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
When the full moon of Phālguna has passed, beginning from the first lunar day in order, / until the full moon of Caitra, O great king, bathing day by day,
one should worship outside the god Keśava reclining on the serpent hood; / one should eat only one meal, at night, and likewise sleep on the ground.
Fasting for three nights, one should perform the worship on the full moon of Caitra as well; / according to one's means, one should give silver, and likewise a pair of garments.
This best of observances lasting a month has been told by me for one desiring beauty, O unflagging soul. / Having performed it, a man reaches heaven, and on attaining human existence he becomes handsome.

3.41.s:
3.203
vajra uvāca ..
bhagavankarmaṇā kena naro lāvaṇyamāpnuyāt ..
lāvaṇyarahitaṃ rūpaṃ niṣphalaṃ pratibhāti me ..1..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kārtikyāṃ samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt ..
paṭe vā yadi vārcāyāṃ pradyumnaṃ pūjayetprabhum..2..
bahiḥ snānaṃ sadā kuryānnaktamaśnīta vāgyataḥ ..
ekabhuktaṃ mahārāja haviṣyaprayataḥ sadā..3..
mārgaśīrṣaṃ tathā prāpya trirātropoṣitaḥ śuciḥ ..
saṃpūjya deva pradyumnaṃ hutvāgnau ghṛtameva ca ..4..
bhojayedbrāhmaṇāṃścātra bhojanaṃ lavaṇotkaṭam ..
cūrṇitasya tataḥ prasthaṃ lavaṇasya dvijātaye.5..
3.41.d:
3.203
वज्र उवाच ॥
भगवन्कर्मणा केन नरो लावण्यमाप्नुयात् ॥
लावण्यरहितं रूपं निष्फलं प्रतिभाति मे ॥1॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कार्तिक्यां समतीतायां प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥
पटे वा यदि वार्चायां प्रद्युम्नं पूजयेत्प्रभुम्॥2॥
बहिः स्नानं सदा कुर्यान्नक्तमश्नीत वाग्यतः ॥
एकभुक्तं महाराज हविष्यप्रयतः सदा॥3॥
मार्गशीर्षं तथा प्राप्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितः शुचिः ॥
संपूज्य देव प्रद्युम्नं हुत्वाग्नौ घृतमेव च ॥4॥
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणांश्चात्र भोजनं लवणोत्कटम् ॥
चूर्णितस्य ततः प्रस्थं लवणस्य द्विजातये.5॥
3.41.m:
3.203
Vajra said:
O venerable one, by what action does a man attain charm? / Beauty devoid of charm seems fruitless to me.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
When the full moon of Kārtika has passed, beginning from the first lunar day in order, / either on a painted cloth or in an icon, one should worship the lord Pradyumna.
He should always bathe outdoors, eat at night with restrained speech, / [eating] once a day, O great king, always dedicated to sacrificial food.
Then, having reached [the month of] Mārgaśīrṣa, pure, having fasted for three nights, / having worshipped the divine Pradyumna and offered oblations of ghee into the fire,
and he should feed brahmins here a meal rich in salt. / Then [he should give] a prastha of powdered salt to a twice-born [brahmin],

3.41.s:
mahārajataraktaṃ ca vastrayugmaṃ tathā guroḥ ..
dadyācca kanakaṃ rājankāṃsyapātraṃ rasairyutam..6..
3.41.d:
महारजतरक्तं च वस्त्रयुग्मं तथा गुरोः ॥
दद्याच्च कनकं राजन्कांस्यपात्रं रसैर्युतम्॥6॥
3.41.m: and a pair of garments dyed with safflower to the guru, / and he should give gold, O king, [and] a bronze vessel filled with savory liquids.

3.41.s:
etaddhi lāvaṇyakaraṃ pradiṣṭaṃ vratottamaṃ nākagatipradaṃ ca ..
na kevalaṃ yādavavīra kāmānnarāya dadyātpuruṣapradhānaḥ ..7..
3.204
vajra uvāca ..
bhagavankarmaṇā kena saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnuyāt..
lāvaṇyarūpe saubhāgyaṃ vinā jñeyaṃ nirarthakam ..1..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
māghyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt ..
paṭe vā yadi vārcāyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sampūjayetsadā .. 2 ..
pūrvoktaṃ sakalaṃ kuryāddhaviṣyaṃ ca dharādhipa ..
nityaṃ samācaretsnānaṃ tathā gandhapriyaṅgunā .. 3 ..
phālgunyāṃ tāṃ tato dadyāttrirāpoṣitaḥ śuciḥ..4..
vastre ca deye nṛpa kuṃkumākte kṣaudrasya pātraṃ ca tathaiva kāṃsyam ..
saubhāgyadaṃ caitadanuttamaṃ te vrataṃ mayaitatkathitaṃ nṛvīra ..5..
3.205
vajra uvāca..
bhagavankarmaṇā kena narastvārogyamāpnuyāt..
rūpasaubhāgyalāvaṇyāḥ sarogasya nirarthakāḥ .. 1 ..
3.41.d:
एतद्धि लावण्यकरं प्रदिष्टं व्रतोत्तमं नाकगतिप्रदं च ॥
न केवलं यादववीर कामान्नराय दद्यात्पुरुषप्रधानः ॥7॥
3.204
वज्र उवाच ॥
भगवन्कर्मणा केन सौभाग्यं महदाप्नुयात्॥
लावण्यरूपे सौभाग्यं विना ज्ञेयं निरर्थकम् ॥1॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच॥
माघ्यां तु समतीतायां प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥
पटे वा यदि वार्चायां कृष्णं सम्पूजयेत्सदा ॥ 2 ॥
पूर्वोक्तं सकलं कुर्याद्धविष्यं च धराधिप ॥
नित्यं समाचरेत्स्नानं तथा गन्धप्रियङ्गुना ॥ 3 ॥
फाल्गुन्यां तां ततो दद्यात्त्रिरापोषितः शुचिः॥4॥
वस्त्रे च देये नृप कुंकुमाक्ते क्षौद्रस्य पात्रं च तथैव कांस्यम् ॥
सौभाग्यदं चैतदनुत्तमं ते व्रतं मयैतत्कथितं नृवीर ॥5॥
3.205
वज्र उवाच॥
भगवन्कर्मणा केन नरस्त्वारोग्यमाप्नुयात्॥
रूपसौभाग्यलावण्याः सरोगस्य निरर्थकाः ॥ 1 ॥
3.41.m:
For this best of vows is declared to produce beauty of charm and grant ascent to heaven; / not only would the foremost of beings bestow desires upon a man, O hero of the Yādavas.
3.204 / Vajra said: / Blessed one, by what action would a man attain great good fortune? / Beauty and charm are to be known as meaningless without good fortune.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the full moon of Māgha has passed, beginning from the first lunar day in due order, / whether on a cloth or on an image, he should always worship Kṛṣṇa.
He should perform everything mentioned earlier, [subsisting on] sacrificial food, O lord of the earth; / he should constantly perform his bath with fragrant priyaṅgu.
Then, having fasted for three nights, pure, he should make that [gift] on the full moon of Phālguna:
Two garments smeared with saffron are to be given, O king, and likewise a bronze vessel of honey. / And this unequalled vow granting good fortune has been spoken to you by me, O hero among men.
3.205 / Vajra said: / Blessed one, by what action would a man attain health? / Beauty, good fortune, and charm are meaningless for one afflicted with disease.

3.41.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
proṣṭhapadyāmatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛtikramāt ..
paṭe vā yadi vārcāyāmaniruddhaṃ tu pūjayet .. 2 ..
pūrvoktena vidhānena yāvadāśvayujī bhavet ..
sārasairarcayeddevaṃ jātīpuṣpairdinedine .. 3 ..
ghṛtena juhuyādvahniṃ ghṛtaṃ dadyāddvijātaye ..
bhojanaṃ gorasaprāyaṃ tathā viprāṃśca bhojayet .. 4 ..
trirātropoṣitaḥ samyagāśvayujyāṃ tato naraḥ ..
saghṛtaṃ sasuvarṇaṃ ca kāṃsyapātraṃ dvijātaye .. 5 ..
dadyānnṛpatiśārdūla narastvārogyavṛddhaye ..
vratametadvinirdiṣṭaṃ svagarlokapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 6 ..
na kevalaṃ rogaharaṃ pradiṣṭamājñākaraṃ rūpavivṛddhidaṃ ca ..
vratottamaṃ te kathitaṃ nṛvīra tatheṣṭakāmāptikaraṃ nṛloke .. 7 ..
3.41.d:
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
प्रोष्ठपद्यामतीतायां प्रतिपत्प्रभृतिक्रमात् ॥
पटे वा यदि वार्चायामनिरुद्धं तु पूजयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन यावदाश्वयुजी भवेत् ॥
सारसैरर्चयेद्देवं जातीपुष्पैर्दिनेदिने ॥ 3 ॥
घृतेन जुहुयाद्वह्निं घृतं दद्याद्द्विजातये ॥
भोजनं गोरसप्रायं तथा विप्रांश्च भोजयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
त्रिरात्रोपोषितः सम्यगाश्वयुज्यां ततो नरः ॥
सघृतं ससुवर्णं च कांस्यपात्रं द्विजातये ॥ 5 ॥
दद्यान्नृपतिशार्दूल नरस्त्वारोग्यवृद्धये ॥
व्रतमेतद्विनिर्दिष्टं स्वगर्लोकप्रदं नृणाम् ॥ 6 ॥
न केवलं रोगहरं प्रदिष्टमाज्ञाकरं रूपविवृद्धिदं च ॥
व्रतोत्तमं ते कथितं नृवीर तथेष्टकामाप्तिकरं नृलोके ॥ 7 ॥
3.41.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the full moon of Bhādrapada has passed, beginning from the first lunar day in due order, / whether on a cloth or on an image, he should worship Aniruddha.
By the previously stated rite until the full moon of Āśvina arrives, / he should worship the god day after day with lotuses and jasmine flowers.
He should offer oblations into the fire with ghee, give ghee to a twice-born [brahmin], / and feed the brahmins food mostly consisting of dairy products.
Then, on the full moon of Āśvina, having fasted completely for three nights, a man / [should give] a bronze vessel containing ghee and gold to a twice-born [brahmin].
A man should give [this], O tiger among kings, for the increase of health; / this vow is prescribed as granting the world of heaven to men.
It is declared not merely to remove disease, but to produce authority and bestow increase of beauty; / the supreme vow has been told to you, O hero among men, which also brings about the attainment of desired wishes in the world of men.

3.41.s: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare tṛtīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde ārogyavratavarṇano nāma pañcottaradviśatatamo' dhyāya .. 205 ..
3.41.d: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे तृतीयखण्डे मार्कण्डेयवज्रसंवादे आरोग्यव्रतवर्णनो नाम पञ्चोत्तरद्विशततमो' ध्याय ॥ 205 ॥
3.41.m: Thus in the glorious Viṣṇudharmottara, in the third book, in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, the two hundred and fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Vow for Health'.

3.42.s:
3.206
vajra uvāca..
bhagavankarmaṇā kena prajñāyukto bhavennaraḥ ..
etadeva manuṣyāṇāṃ manuṣyatvamudāhṛtam..1..
3.42.d:
3.206
वज्र उवाच॥
भगवन्कर्मणा केन प्रज्ञायुक्तो भवेन्नरः ॥
एतदेव मनुष्याणां मनुष्यत्वमुदाहृतम्॥1॥
3.42.m: 3.206 / Vajra said: / Blessed one, by what action would a man become endowed with intellect? / This alone is proclaimed as the true humanity of humans.

3.42.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
caitryāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ yāvanmāsaṃ dinedine ..
pūrvavatpūjayeddevaṃ nṛsiṃhamaparājitam .. 2 ..
3.42.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
चैत्र्यां तु समतीतायां यावन्मासं दिनेदिने ॥
पूर्ववत्पूजयेद्देवं नृसिंहमपराजितम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.42.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the full moon of Caitra has passed, for a whole month, day after day, / he should worship the invincible god Nṛsiṃha as before.

3.42.s:
homaṃ ca pratyahaṃ kuryāttathā siddhārthakairnṛpa ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayeccātra tathā trimadhuraṃ sadā.. 3 ..
3.42.d:
होमं च प्रत्यहं कुर्यात्तथा सिद्धार्थकैर्नृप ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेच्चात्र तथा त्रिमधुरं सदा॥ 3 ॥
3.42.m: And he should perform a fire sacrifice daily with white mustard seeds, O king; / and he should always feed brahmins here the three sweet substances.

3.42.s:
vaiśākhyāṃ kanakaṃ dadyātrirātropoṣito naraḥ ..
jñānāvāptipradaṃ hyetadvrataṃ buddhivivardhanam .. 4 ..
3.42.d:
वैशाख्यां कनकं दद्यात्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः ॥
ज्ञानावाप्तिप्रदं ह्येतद्व्रतं बुद्धिविवर्धनम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.42.m: On the full moon of Vaiśākha, having fasted for three nights, a man should give gold; / for this vow grants the attainment of knowledge and increases the intellect.

3.42.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsamidaṃ mayoktamāsādya nākaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ ..
mānuṣyamāsādya ca buddhiyukto jñānena yuktaśca tathā bhavettu .. 5 ..
3.207
vajra uvāca ..
bhagavankarmaṇā kena vidyāvānpuruṣo bhavet ..
suvidya eva vijñeyaḥ puruṣaḥ paśuranyathā .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
pauṣyāntu samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt ..
prāgvatsaṃpūjayeddevaṃ turaṃgaśirasaṃ harim..2..
tilām̐śca juhuyādvahnau tilairdevaṃ samarcayet..
trirātropoṣito māghyāṃ tilānkanakameva ca..3..
dadyādbrāhmaṇamukhyāya samyakprayatamānasaḥ..
mukhyaṃ yajñopavītañca prabhūtamapi cendhanam..4..
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsamidaṃ mayoktaṃ vidyānvitaḥ syātpuruṣaḥ sadaiva..
svarlokamāsādya sukhāni bhuktvā kāmānabhīṣṭānpuruṣośnute ca..5..
3.42.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं मासमिदं मयोक्तमासाद्य नाकं सुचिरं मनुष्यः ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य च बुद्धियुक्तो ज्ञानेन युक्तश्च तथा भवेत्तु ॥ 5 ॥
3.207
वज्र उवाच ॥
भगवन्कर्मणा केन विद्यावान्पुरुषो भवेत् ॥
सुविद्य एव विज्ञेयः पुरुषः पशुरन्यथा ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
पौष्यान्तु समतीतायां प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥
प्राग्वत्संपूजयेद्देवं तुरंगशिरसं हरिम्॥2॥
तिलाम्̐श्च जुहुयाद्वह्नौ तिलैर्देवं समर्चयेत्॥
त्रिरात्रोपोषितो माघ्यां तिलान्कनकमेव च॥3॥
दद्याद्ब्राह्मणमुख्याय सम्यक्प्रयतमानसः॥
मुख्यं यज्ञोपवीतञ्च प्रभूतमपि चेन्धनम्॥4॥
कृत्वा व्रतं मासमिदं मयोक्तं विद्यान्वितः स्यात्पुरुषः सदैव॥
स्वर्लोकमासाद्य सुखानि भुक्त्वा कामानभीष्टान्पुरुषोश्नुते च॥5॥
3.42.m:
Having performed this vow for a month as spoken by me, and having attained heaven for a very long time, / upon attaining human birth, a man would indeed become endowed with intellect and endowed with knowledge.
3.207 / Vajra said: / Blessed one, by what action would a man become learned? / A man is to be known as truly a man only when well-educated; otherwise he is a beast.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the full moon of Pauṣa has passed, beginning from the first lunar day in due order, / he should worship the horse-headed god Hari as before.
And he should offer sesamum seeds into the fire, and worship the god with sesamum seeds; / having fasted for three nights on the full moon of Māgha, [he should give] sesamum seeds and gold,
he should give [these] to an eminent brahmin with a fully restrained mind, / as well as an excellent sacred thread and abundant firewood.
Having performed this vow for a month as spoken by me, a man would always be endowed with learning; / having attained the heavenly world and enjoyed pleasures, a man also attains his cherished desires.

3.42.s:
3.208
vajra uvāca..
bhagavankarmaṇā kena śīlavānpuruṣo bhavet ..
kulajātiśrutibhyaśca śīlameva viśiṣyate .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
āgrāyaṇyāmatītāyāṃ māsamekaṃ dinedine ..
pūrvavatpūjayeddevaṃ varāhamaparājitam..2..
ghṛtena snāpayeddevaṃ ghṛtena juhuyāddhaviḥ ..
ghṛtaṃ dvijebhyo dadyācca ghṛtameva nivedayet ..3..
trirātropoṣitaḥ pauṣyāṃ ghṛtapātreṇa ca dvijān ..
pūjayetsasuvarṇena yathāśakti narādhipa .. 4 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsamidaṃ mayoktaṃ cāsādya nākaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ ..
mānuṣyamāsādya ca śīlavānsyātprāpnoti puṣṭiṃ cirajīvitaṃ ca ..5..
3.209
vajra uvāca ..
bhagavankarmaṇā kena nityaṃ dharmaparo bhavet ..
dharmmavicca mahārāja dharmmasā phalyakāraṇāt .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
āṣāḍhyāṃ samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt ..
pūrvvavatpūjayeddevaṃ dharmmavigrahadhāriṇam ..2..
3.42.d:
3.208
वज्र उवाच॥
भगवन्कर्मणा केन शीलवान्पुरुषो भवेत् ॥
कुलजातिश्रुतिभ्यश्च शीलमेव विशिष्यते ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
आग्रायण्यामतीतायां मासमेकं दिनेदिने ॥
पूर्ववत्पूजयेद्देवं वराहमपराजितम्॥2॥
घृतेन स्नापयेद्देवं घृतेन जुहुयाद्धविः ॥
घृतं द्विजेभ्यो दद्याच्च घृतमेव निवेदयेत् ॥3॥
त्रिरात्रोपोषितः पौष्यां घृतपात्रेण च द्विजान् ॥
पूजयेत्ससुवर्णेन यथाशक्ति नराधिप ॥ 4 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं मासमिदं मयोक्तं चासाद्य नाकं सुचिरं मनुष्यः ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य च शीलवान्स्यात्प्राप्नोति पुष्टिं चिरजीवितं च ॥5॥
3.209
वज्र उवाच ॥
भगवन्कर्मणा केन नित्यं धर्मपरो भवेत् ॥
धर्म्मविच्च महाराज धर्म्मसा फल्यकारणात् ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
आषाढ्यां समतीतायां प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥
पूर्व्ववत्पूजयेद्देवं धर्म्मविग्रहधारिणम् ॥2॥
3.42.m:
3.208 / Vajra said: / Blessed one, by what action would a man become virtuous? / Indeed, good conduct surpasses family, caste, and Vedic learning.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the Āgrāyaṇī full moon has passed, for one month, day after day, / he should worship the invincible divine Boar as before.
He should bathe the god with ghee, offer oblations with ghee, / give ghee to the twice-born, and offer ghee alone [as food].
Having fasted for three nights on the full moon of Pauṣa, he should honor the twice-born / with a vessel of ghee accompanied by gold according to his capacity, O lord of men.
Having performed this vow for a month as spoken by me, and having attained heaven for a very long time, / a man, upon attaining human birth, would be virtuous and attain prosperity and long life.
3.209 / Vajra said: / Blessed one, by what action would [a man] constantly be devoted to dharma, / and a knower of dharma, O great king, on account of the fruitfulness of dharma?
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the full moon of Āṣāḍha has passed, beginning from the first lunar day in due order, / he should worship the god who bears the form of dharma as before.

3.42.s:
māsasya cānte nṛpa paurṇamāsyāṃ kṛtvā trirātraṃ kanakañca dadyāt ..
vratottamaṃ dharmmakaraṃ tavoktaṃ sarvvārthadaṃ nātra vicāraṇāsti .. 3 ..
3.210
vajra uvāca ..
bhagavankarmaṇā kena dhanavānpuruṣo bhavet ..
dhanavāneva lokeṣu pūjyo bhavati mānavaḥ .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śrāvaṇyāṃ samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt ..
pūrvavatpūjayedviṣṇuṃ devaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ prabhum .. 2 ..
nīlotpalaistathā patrairnṛpa bhṛṃgirajasya ca ..
ghṛtena paramānnena tathā bilvaiśca śaktitaḥ .. 2 ..
trirātropoṣitaḥ samyak proṣṭhapadyāṃ tato naraḥ ..
gāṃ ca dadyāddvijendrāya vratānte manujottamaḥ .. 4 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsamidaṃ yathoktaṃ cāsādya nākaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ ..
mānuṣyamāsādya dhanānvitaḥ syādvratena cīrṇena narendrasiṃha .. 5 ..
3.42.d:
मासस्य चान्ते नृप पौर्णमास्यां कृत्वा त्रिरात्रं कनकञ्च दद्यात् ॥
व्रतोत्तमं धर्म्मकरं तवोक्तं सर्व्वार्थदं नात्र विचारणास्ति ॥ 3 ॥
3.210
वज्र उवाच ॥
भगवन्कर्मणा केन धनवान्पुरुषो भवेत् ॥
धनवानेव लोकेषु पूज्यो भवति मानवः ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
श्रावण्यां समतीतायां प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥
पूर्ववत्पूजयेद्विष्णुं देवं सङ्कर्षणं प्रभुम् ॥ 2 ॥
नीलोत्पलैस्तथा पत्रैर्नृप भृंगिरजस्य च ॥
घृतेन परमान्नेन तथा बिल्वैश्च शक्तितः ॥ 2 ॥
त्रिरात्रोपोषितः सम्यक् प्रोष्ठपद्यां ततो नरः ॥
गां च दद्याद्द्विजेन्द्राय व्रतान्ते मनुजोत्तमः ॥ 4 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं मासमिदं यथोक्तं चासाद्य नाकं सुचिरं मनुष्यः ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य धनान्वितः स्याद्व्रतेन चीर्णेन नरेन्द्रसिंह ॥ 5 ॥
3.42.m:
And at the end of the month, O king, on the full moon day, having observed a three-night fast, he should give gold. / This supreme observance, which brings about dharma and bestows all aims, has been told to you; there is no doubt about this.
3.210 / Vajra said: / By what action, O venerable one, may a man become wealthy? / For only a wealthy man is honored among the worlds.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the Śrāvaṇa full moon day has passed, beginning from the first lunar day in due order, / he should worship, as before, God Viṣṇu, the Lord Saṃkarṣaṇa,
with blue lotuses and leaves of the bhṛṅgarāja plant, O king, / with ghee, with fine milk-rice, and with bilva fruits according to his capacity.
Then, having properly fasted for three nights on the Proṣṭhapadā full moon day, / that best of men should give a cow to an eminent twice-born at the end of the observance.
Having performed this month-long observance as prescribed and reached heaven for a very long time, / a human being, having obtained human birth, becomes endowed with wealth through the observance he performed, O lion among kings.

3.43.s:
3.211
vajra uvāca ..
śrīvihīnasya lokesminkiṃ dhanena mahādyute ..
tasmādvrataṃ samācakṣva yena syācchrīyuto naraḥ... 1 ..
3.43.d:
3.211
वज्र उवाच ॥
श्रीविहीनस्य लोकेस्मिन्किं धनेन महाद्युते ॥
तस्माद्व्रतं समाचक्ष्व येन स्याच्छ्रीयुतो नरः॥। 1 ॥
3.43.m: 3.211 / Vajra said: / Of what use is wealth in this world to one devoid of fortune, O you of great splendor? / Therefore, explain the observance by which a man may be endowed with fortune.

3.43.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
vaiśākhyāṃ samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt ..
pūrvavatpūjayeddevaṃ śrīsahāyaṃ dinedine ..2 ..
3.43.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
वैशाख्यां समतीतायां प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥
पूर्ववत्पूजयेद्देवं श्रीसहायं दिनेदिने ॥2 ॥
3.43.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the Vaiśākha full moon day has passed, beginning from the first lunar day in due order, / he should worship, day by day as before, the God accompanied by Śrī.

3.43.s:
puṣpairmūlaiḥ phalaiścaiva juhuyādakṣatāṃstathā ..
bilvāṃśca vahnau satataṃ gorasairbhojayeddvijān .. 3 ..
3.43.d:
पुष्पैर्मूलैः फलैश्चैव जुहुयादक्षतांस्तथा ॥
बिल्वांश्च वह्नौ सततं गोरसैर्भोजयेद्द्विजान् ॥ 3 ॥
3.43.m: He should offer unbroken grains with flowers, roots, and fruits, / and always offer bilva fruits into the fire, and feed twice-borns with dairy preparations.

3.43.s:
trirātropoṣito jyeṣṭhe kanakaṃ pratipādayet ..
vastrayugmaṃ ca rājendra tena sāphalyamaśnute..4..
3.43.d:
त्रिरात्रोपोषितो ज्येष्ठे कनकं प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
वस्त्रयुग्मं च राजेन्द्र तेन साफल्यमश्नुते॥4॥
3.43.m: Having fasted for three nights in the Jyeṣṭha month, he should bestow gold / and a pair of garments, O lord of kings; thereby he attains fulfillment.

3.43.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsamidaṃ yathoktaṃ cāsādya nākaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ ..
mānuṣyamāsādya vivṛddhatejā śriyā yutaḥ syājjagati pradhānaḥ..5..
3.212
vajra uvāca ..
bhagavankarmaṇā kena bhogānāpnoti mānavaḥ ..
kinnu bhogavihīnasya kāryamasti dhanairdvija ..1..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt..
pūrvavatpūjayeddevaṃ viśvarūpadharaṃ harim ..2..
kṛtvā vratānte ca tathā trirātraṃ dattvā suyuktaṃ śayanaṃ dvijāya..
svarlokamāsādya ciraṃ tathoṣya mānuṣyamāsādya ca bhogavānsyāt .. 3 ..
3.213
vajra uvāca ..
bhagavankarmaṇā kena sarvatra jayamāpnuyāt ..
vyavahāre raṇe dyūte vivāde ca dvijottama ..1..
jayāvāpteḥ paraṃ nāsti saukhyaṃ lokeṣu sattama ..
jayāvāptiḥ paraṃ saukhyaṃ tadāptivratamucyatām .. 2 ..
3.43.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं मासमिदं यथोक्तं चासाद्य नाकं सुचिरं मनुष्यः ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य विवृद्धतेजा श्रिया युतः स्याज्जगति प्रधानः॥5॥
3.212
वज्र उवाच ॥
भगवन्कर्मणा केन भोगानाप्नोति मानवः ॥
किन्नु भोगविहीनस्य कार्यमस्ति धनैर्द्विज ॥1॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ज्येष्ठायां समतीतायां प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात्॥
पूर्ववत्पूजयेद्देवं विश्वरूपधरं हरिम् ॥2॥
कृत्वा व्रतान्ते च तथा त्रिरात्रं दत्त्वा सुयुक्तं शयनं द्विजाय॥
स्वर्लोकमासाद्य चिरं तथोष्य मानुष्यमासाद्य च भोगवान्स्यात् ॥ 3 ॥
3.213
वज्र उवाच ॥
भगवन्कर्मणा केन सर्वत्र जयमाप्नुयात् ॥
व्यवहारे रणे द्यूते विवादे च द्विजोत्तम ॥1॥
जयावाप्तेः परं नास्ति सौख्यं लोकेषु सत्तम ॥
जयावाप्तिः परं सौख्यं तदाप्तिव्रतमुच्यताम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.43.m:
Having performed this month-long observance as prescribed and reached heaven for a very long time, / a human being, having attained human birth, with augmented radiance and endowed with fortune, becomes foremost in the world.
3.212 / Vajra said: / By what action, O venerable one, does a man obtain enjoyments? / For what purpose do riches serve for one devoid of enjoyment, O twice-born?
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the Jyeṣṭha full moon day has passed, beginning from the first lunar day in due order, / he should worship, as before, the God Hari who bears the universal form.
And having thus observed a three-night fast at the end of the observance and given a well-furnished bed to a twice-born, / he reaches the heavenly world, dwells there for a long time, and, having attained human birth, becomes endowed with enjoyments.
3.213 / Vajra said: / By what action, O venerable one, may one attain victory everywhere— / in legal proceedings, in battle, in gambling, and in debate, O best of the twice-born?
There is no happiness in the worlds higher than the attainment of victory, O best of good men; / the attainment of victory is supreme happiness; tell me the observance for attaining it.

3.43.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
āśvayujyāmatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt ..
pūrvavatpūjayedviṣṇuṃ devadevaṃ trivikramam .. 3 ..
trirātrānte tu kārtikyāṃ dadyādukṣāṇamuttamam ..
sarvasasyadharaṃ kṛtvā śaktyā ratnairalaṅkṛtam .. 4 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsamidaṃ yathoktaṃ prāpnoti nākaṃ suciraṃ nṛvīraḥ..
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ prāpnoti sarvatra jayaṃ nṛloke .. 5 ..
3.214
vajra uvāca ..
vratānyanyāni me brūhi kāmyāni dvijapuṅgava ..
nārīṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vā sarvajñastvaṃ mato mama .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kṛttikāsvarcayeddevaṃ kārtikīprabhṛtikramāt ..
yāvatsyātkārtikaṃ bhūyo narasiṃhamupoṣitaḥ ..2 ..
anulepanapuṣpādyaiḥ sarvadoktaissadaiva tu ..
vratāvasāne dattvā ca candanaṃ tagaraṃ dvije .. 3 ..
carma caivāyudhaṃ mukhyaṃ vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca ..
sarvatra jayamāpnoti yatrayatrābhijāyate .. 4 ..
3.43.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
आश्वयुज्यामतीतायां प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥
पूर्ववत्पूजयेद्विष्णुं देवदेवं त्रिविक्रमम् ॥ 3 ॥
त्रिरात्रान्ते तु कार्तिक्यां दद्यादुक्षाणमुत्तमम् ॥
सर्वसस्यधरं कृत्वा शक्त्या रत्नैरलङ्कृतम् ॥ 4 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं मासमिदं यथोक्तं प्राप्नोति नाकं सुचिरं नृवीरः॥
तत्रोष्य कालं सुचिरं मनुष्यः प्राप्नोति सर्वत्र जयं नृलोके ॥ 5 ॥
3.214
वज्र उवाच ॥
व्रतान्यन्यानि मे ब्रूहि काम्यानि द्विजपुङ्गव ॥
नारीणां पुरुषाणां वा सर्वज्ञस्त्वं मतो मम ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कृत्तिकास्वर्चयेद्देवं कार्तिकीप्रभृतिक्रमात् ॥
यावत्स्यात्कार्तिकं भूयो नरसिंहमुपोषितः ॥2 ॥
अनुलेपनपुष्पाद्यैः सर्वदोक्तैस्सदैव तु ॥
व्रतावसाने दत्त्वा च चन्दनं तगरं द्विजे ॥ 3 ॥
चर्म चैवायुधं मुख्यं वासांसि विविधानि च ॥
सर्वत्र जयमाप्नोति यत्रयत्राभिजायते ॥ 4 ॥
3.43.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the Āśvina full moon day has passed, beginning from the first lunar day in due order, / he should worship, as before, Viṣṇu, the God of gods, Trivikrama.
And at the end of the three-night fast, on the Kārttika full moon day, he should give an excellent bull, / made to bear all kinds of grain and adorned with jewels according to his capacity.
Having performed this month-long observance as prescribed, the heroic king reaches heaven for a very long time; / having dwelt there for a very long time, the man attains victory everywhere in the world of men.
3.214 / Vajra said: / Tell me of other optional observances, O bull among the twice-born, / for women or for men; I consider you all-knowing.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having fasted, one should worship the God Narasiṃha under the Kṛttikās in due order, / beginning from the Kārttika full moon day until the next Kārttika full moon,
always with unguents, flowers, and the like, as prescribed at all times. / And at the end of the observance, having given sandalwood and tagara to a twice-born,
as well as a shield, a principal weapon, and various garments, / he attains victory everywhere, wherever he is born.

3.43.s:
mārgaśīrṣādathārabhya mṛgaśīrṣe tathārcayet ..
yāvadāgrāyaṇī bhūyo rāmaṃ daśarathātmajam .. 5 ..
3.43.d:
मार्गशीर्षादथारभ्य मृगशीर्षे तथार्चयेत् ॥
यावदाग्रायणी भूयो रामं दशरथात्मजम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.43.m: Then, beginning from the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, under the Mṛgaśīrṣa constellation, he should likewise worship / Rāma, the son of Daśaratha, until the next Āgrāyaṇī [full moon],

3.43.s:
anulepanapuṣpādyaiḥ sarvaratnaiḥ sadaiva tu ..
vratāvasāne dadyādgāṃ tathā śvetāṃ dvijātaye .. 6 ..
3.43.d:
अनुलेपनपुष्पाद्यैः सर्वरत्नैः सदैव तु ॥
व्रतावसाने दद्याद्गां तथा श्वेतां द्विजातये ॥ 6 ॥
3.43.m: always with unguents, flowers, and all kinds of jewels. / At the end of the observance, he should give a white cow to a twice-born,

3.43.s:
śvetaṃ vastrayugaṃ caiva rajataṃ ca tathā nṛpa ..
upoṣitaḥ sadā kṛtvā vrataṃ syācchatruvarjitaḥ .. 7 ..
3.43.d:
श्वेतं वस्त्रयुगं चैव रजतं च तथा नृप ॥
उपोषितः सदा कृत्वा व्रतं स्याच्छत्रुवर्जितः ॥ 7 ॥
3.43.m: as well as a pair of white garments and silver, O king. / Having always performed this observance while fasting, he becomes free of enemies.

3.43.s:
pauṣamāsādathārabhya puṣpairnityamupoṣitaḥ ..
yāvatpauṣī bhavedbhūyo balabhadramathārcayet .. 8 ..
3.43.d:
पौषमासादथारभ्य पुष्पैर्नित्यमुपोषितः ॥
यावत्पौषी भवेद्भूयो बलभद्रमथार्चयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
3.43.m: Then, beginning from the month of Pauṣa, constantly fasting under the Puṣya constellation / until the next Pauṣa full moon, he should then worship Balabhadra,

3.43.s:
anulepanapuṣpānnaiḥ sarvaratnaistathaiva ca ..
vratāvasāne saghṛtaṃ kāṃsyaṃ kanakameva ca .. 9 ..
3.43.d:
अनुलेपनपुष्पान्नैः सर्वरत्नैस्तथैव च ॥
व्रतावसाने सघृतं कांस्यं कनकमेव च ॥ 9 ॥
3.43.m: with unguents, flowers, food offerings, and likewise all kinds of jewels. / At the end of the observance, [giving] a bell-metal vessel with ghee and gold,

3.43.s:
dattvā viprāya bhavati nityaṃ puṣṭiyuto naraḥ ..
māghamāsādathārabhya maghāsu satataṃ naraḥ .. 3.214.10 ..
3.43.d:
दत्त्वा विप्राय भवति नित्यं पुष्टियुतो नरः ॥
माघमासादथारभ्य मघासु सततं नरः ॥ 3.214.10 ॥
3.43.m: having given [them] to a brahmin, a man becomes permanently endowed with nourishment. / Then, beginning from the month of Māgha, a man constantly under the Maghā constellation,

3.43.s:
vārāhamarcayeddevaṃ tathā nityamupoṣitaḥ ..
ghṛtābhyaṅgena vidhivaccandanena sugandhinā .. 11 ..
3.43.d:
वाराहमर्चयेद्देवं तथा नित्यमुपोषितः ॥
घृताभ्यङ्गेन विधिवच्चन्दनेन सुगन्धिना ॥ 11 ॥
3.43.m: constantly fasting in this manner, should worship the Boar God / according to rule, with anointment of ghee and fragrant sandalwood,

3.43.s:
tathā ca paramānnena ghṛtahomena cāpyatha ..
dadyādvratāvasāne ca kṣitiṃ gāṃ vā narādhipa .. 12 ..
3.43.d:
तथा च परमान्नेन घृतहोमेन चाप्यथ ॥
दद्याद्व्रतावसाने च क्षितिं गां वा नराधिप ॥ 12 ॥
3.43.m: as well as with fine milk-rice and fire oblations of ghee. / And at the end of the observance, O ruler of men, he should give land or a cow.

3.43.s:
pitṛprasādamāpnoti kṛtvaitadvratamuttamam ..
phālgunāttu tathārabhya phālgunīṣu samarcayet .. 13 ..
3.43.d:
पितृप्रसादमाप्नोति कृत्वैतद्व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
फाल्गुनात्तु तथारभ्य फाल्गुनीषु समर्चयेत् ॥ 13 ॥
3.43.m: Having performed this supreme observance, he attains the favor of the ancestors. / Then, beginning from Phālguna, he should worship under the Phālgunī constellations

3.43.s:
naranārāyaṇau devau yāvatsyātphālgunī punaḥ ..
vratāvasāne śayanaṃ svāstīrṇe prati pādayeta .. 14 ..
3.43.d:
नरनारायणौ देवौ यावत्स्यात्फाल्गुनी पुनः ॥
व्रतावसाने शयनं स्वास्तीर्णे प्रति पादयेत ॥ 14 ॥
3.43.m: the two gods Nara and Nārāyaṇa, until the Phālgunī [full moon] arrives again. / At the end of the observance, he should present a well-spread bed.

3.43.s:
vratāvasāne nārī syātsubhartrā samalaṃkṛtā ..
bhāryāṃ narastathāpnoti rūpadraviṇasaṃyutām .. 15 ..
3.43.d:
व्रतावसाने नारी स्यात्सुभर्त्रा समलंकृता ॥
भार्यां नरस्तथाप्नोति रूपद्रविणसंयुताम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.43.m: At the end of the observance, a woman becomes graced with a good husband; / likewise, a man obtains a wife endowed with beauty and wealth,

3.43.s:
anukūlāṃ śriyaṃ nityaṃ tathā pakṣavatīṃ nṛpa ..
aviyogamavaidhavyaṃ karotyetanmahāvratam .. 16 ..
3.43.d:
अनुकूलां श्रियं नित्यं तथा पक्षवतीं नृप ॥
अवियोगमवैधव्यं करोत्येतन्महाव्रतम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.43.m: favorable, ever prosperous, and with many relatives, O king. / This great observance brings about freedom from separation and non-widowhood.

3.43.s:
caitramāsādathārabhya nityaṃ citrāsvathārcayet ..
vratāvasāne dadyācca citraṃ vastraṃ dvijanmane .. 17 ..
3.43.d:
चैत्रमासादथारभ्य नित्यं चित्रास्वथार्चयेत् ॥
व्रतावसाने दद्याच्च चित्रं वस्त्रं द्विजन्मने ॥ 17 ॥
3.43.m: Beginning from the month of Caitra, one should constantly worship during the Citrā [asterism]. / At the conclusion of the vow, he should give a variegated garment to a twice-born.

3.43.s:
vratenānena puruṣaḥ putrānāpnotyathepsitān..
nārī vā puruṣavyāghra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 18..
3.43.d:
व्रतेनानेन पुरुषः पुत्रानाप्नोत्यथेप्सितान्॥
नारी वा पुरुषव्याघ्र नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 18॥
3.43.m: By this vow a man attains desired sons, / or a woman [attains them], O tiger among men; there is no doubt in this regard.

3.43.s:
vaiśākhītastathārabhya viśākhāsu tathārcayet ..
yāvadbhūyastu vaiśākhī sopavāsaḥ pṛthuṃ vibhum.. 19..
3.43.d:
वैशाखीतस्तथारभ्य विशाखासु तथार्चयेत् ॥
यावद्भूयस्तु वैशाखी सोपवासः पृथुं विभुम्॥ 19॥
3.43.m: Beginning likewise from the full moon of Vaiśākha, he should worship during the Viśākhā [asterisms], / fasting, until the full moon of Vaiśākha returns, [worshipping] the vast, all-pervading Lord.

3.43.s:
dattvā vratānte kanakaṃ jñātiśraiṣṭhyamavāpnuyāt..
jyeṣṭhamāsādathārabhya jyeṣṭhāsu satataṃ naraḥ..3.214.20 ..
3.43.d:
दत्त्वा व्रतान्ते कनकं ज्ञातिश्रैष्ठ्यमवाप्नुयात्॥
ज्येष्ठमासादथारभ्य ज्येष्ठासु सततं नरः॥3.214.20 ॥
3.43.m: Having given gold at the end of the vow, he attains pre-eminence among his kinsmen. / Beginning from the month of Jyeṣṭha, a man should constantly, during the Jyeṣṭhā [asterism],

3.43.s:
arcayedbhārgavaṃ rāmaṃ yāvajjyeṣṭhaṃ punarbhavet ..
vratāvasāne dadyācca cchatropānahameva ca ..21 ..
3.43.d:
अर्चयेद्भार्गवं रामं यावज्ज्येष्ठं पुनर्भवेत् ॥
व्रतावसाने दद्याच्च च्छत्रोपानहमेव च ॥21 ॥
3.43.m: worship Rāma, descendant of Bhṛgu, until the month of Jyeṣṭha comes again. / At the conclusion of the vow, he should give an umbrella and sandals.

3.43.s:
vratenānena bhavati sarvaśreṣṭho narottama ..
āṣāḍhītastathārabhya dinadvayamupoṣitaḥ .. 22 ..
3.43.d:
व्रतेनानेन भवति सर्वश्रेष्ठो नरोत्तम ॥
आषाढीतस्तथारभ्य दिनद्वयमुपोषितः ॥ 22 ॥
3.43.m: By this vow he becomes the foremost of all, O best of men. / Beginning likewise from the full moon of Āṣāḍha, having fasted for two days,

3.43.s:
āṣāḍhyāṃ tvarcayeddevaṃ pradyumnamaparājitam ..
bhūyaḥ syādyāvadāṣāḍhī dadyācca śayanaṃ tataḥ .. 23 ..
3.43.d:
आषाढ्यां त्वर्चयेद्देवं प्रद्युम्नमपराजितम् ॥
भूयः स्याद्यावदाषाढी दद्याच्च शयनं ततः ॥ 23 ॥
3.43.m: on the full moon of Āṣāḍha he should worship the invincible god Pradyumna, / until the full moon of Āṣāḍha returns again; then he should donate a bed

3.43.s:
svāstīrṇaṃ tena cāpnoti nityaṃ rūpayutāḥ striyaḥ ..
śrāvaṇītastathārabhya śravaṇe satataṃ harim .. 24 ..
3.43.d:
स्वास्तीर्णं तेन चाप्नोति नित्यं रूपयुताः स्त्रियः ॥
श्रावणीतस्तथारभ्य श्रवणे सततं हरिम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.43.m: well-strewn [with bedding]; by this he constantly obtains women endowed with beauty. / Beginning from the full moon of Śrāvaṇa, constantly [worshipping] Hari during Śravaṇa,

3.43.s:
arcayetsopavāsaṃ taṃ yāvatsyācchrāvaṇī punaḥ ..
vratāvasāne dadyācca kāṃsyaṃ rūpyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā..25..
3.43.d:
अर्चयेत्सोपवासं तं यावत्स्याच्छ्रावणी पुनः ॥
व्रतावसाने दद्याच्च कांस्यं रूप्यं घृतं तथा॥25॥
3.43.m: fasting, he should worship him until the full moon of Śrāvaṇa returns. / At the conclusion of the vow, he should donate bronze, silver, and ghee.

3.43.s:
vratānyathaitāni mayā narendra proktāni te pāpaharāṇi nityam ..
nākapradānyuttamapūryamāṇānkāmānpradātṝṇi yatheṣṭamatra..26..
3.215
vajra uvāca ..
ārādhanārthaṃ devasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ..
vratānyanyāni me brūhi bhṛguvaṃśavivardhana .. 1 ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
gaṅgādvāre sukhāsīnaḥ pulastyaṛṣisattamaḥ ..
vratāni yāni dālbhyāya jagāda śṛṇu tāni me .. 2 ..
dālbhya uvāca .. ārādhanārthaṃ devasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ..
vratāni tvaṃ samācakṣva sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara .. 3 ..
pulastya uvāca ..
ekādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe phālgune māsi yo naraḥ ..
japankṛṣṇeti devasya nāma bhaktyā punaḥpunaḥ .. 4 ..
devārcane cāṣṭaśataṃ kṛtvaitattu japecchuciḥ ..
snātaḥ prasthānakāle ca utthāne skhalite kṣute .. 5 ..
pāṣaṇḍānpatitāṃścaiva tathaivāntāvasāyinaḥ ..
nālapeta tathā kṛṣṇamarcayecchraddhayānvitaḥ .. 6 ..
3.43.d:
व्रतान्यथैतानि मया नरेन्द्र प्रोक्तानि ते पापहराणि नित्यम् ॥
नाकप्रदान्युत्तमपूर्यमाणान्कामान्प्रदातॄणि यथेष्टमत्र॥26॥
3.215
वज्र उवाच ॥
आराधनार्थं देवस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥
व्रतान्यन्यानि मे ब्रूहि भृगुवंशविवर्धन ॥ 1 ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
गङ्गाद्वारे सुखासीनः पुलस्त्यऋषिसत्तमः ॥
व्रतानि यानि दाल्भ्याय जगाद शृणु तानि मे ॥ 2 ॥
दाल्भ्य उवाच ॥ आराधनार्थं देवस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥
व्रतानि त्वं समाचक्ष्व सर्वधर्मभृतां वर ॥ 3 ॥
पुलस्त्य उवाच ॥
एकादश्यां शुक्लपक्षे फाल्गुने मासि यो नरः ॥
जपन्कृष्णेति देवस्य नाम भक्त्या पुनःपुनः ॥ 4 ॥
देवार्चने चाष्टशतं कृत्वैतत्तु जपेच्छुचिः ॥
स्नातः प्रस्थानकाले च उत्थाने स्खलिते क्षुते ॥ 5 ॥
पाषण्डान्पतितांश्चैव तथैवान्तावसायिनः ॥
नालपेत तथा कृष्णमर्चयेच्छ्रद्धयान्वितः ॥ 6 ॥
3.43.m:
Thus these vows have been declared to you by me, O king, which constantly remove sin, / bestow heaven, and fulfill desires as wished, granting supreme fullness in this world.
3.215 / Vajra said: / For the sake of worshipping the god Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendour, / tell me other vows, O increaser of the lineage of Bhṛgu.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Seated comfortably at the Gateway to the Gaṅgā, the best of sages, Pulastya, / spoke vows to Dālbhya; listen to those from me.
Dālbhya said: / For the sake of worshipping the god Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendour, / explain the vows [to me], O best of all upholders of dharma.
Pulastya said: / That man who on the eleventh day of the bright fortnight in the month of Phālguna, / chanting the name of the god, 'Kṛṣṇa', again and again with devotion,
and having made one hundred and eight [recitations] in the worship of the god, should chant this, being pure, / bathed, both at the time of setting forth, when rising, slipping, or sneezing;
he should not converse with heretics, fallen people, / or outcasts, and he should worship Kṛṣṇa full of faith.

3.43.s:
idaṃ codāharetkṛṣṇe manaḥ sandhāya tatparaḥ ..
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa kṛpālustvamagatīnāṃ gatirbhava .. 7 ..
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ prasīda madhusūdana ..
evaṃ prasādyopavasetkṛtvā niyatamānasaḥ .. 8 ..
pūrvehni cānyedyuścāpi gavyaṃ saṃprāśya vai sakṛt ..
snātorcayitvā kṛṣṇeti punarnāma prakīrtayet .. 9 ..
vāridhārāvrate caiva vikṣipeddevapādayoḥ ..
caitravaiśākhayoścaiva tadvajjyeṣṭhe ca pūjayet .. 3.215.10 ..
martyaloke gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ dālbhya prāpnoti vai naraḥ ..
utkrāntikāle kṛṣṇasya smaraṇaṃ ca tathāśnute .. 11 ..
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe caiva māsi bhādrapade tathā ..
tathaivāśvayuje māsi anena vidhinā naraḥ .. 12 ..
upoṣya saṃpūjya tathā keśaveti ca pūjayet ..
gomūtraprāśanātpūtaḥ svargalokagatiṃ vrajet .. 13 ..
ārādhitasya jagatāmīśvarasyāvyayasya ca ..
utkrāntikāle smaraṇaṃ keśavasya tathāpnuyāt .. 14 ..
3.43.d:
इदं चोदाहरेत्कृष्णे मनः सन्धाय तत्परः ॥
कृष्णकृष्ण कृपालुस्त्वमगतीनां गतिर्भव ॥ 7 ॥
संसारार्णवमग्नानां प्रसीद मधुसूदन ॥
एवं प्रसाद्योपवसेत्कृत्वा नियतमानसः ॥ 8 ॥
पूर्वेह्नि चान्येद्युश्चापि गव्यं संप्राश्य वै सकृत् ॥
स्नातोर्चयित्वा कृष्णेति पुनर्नाम प्रकीर्तयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
वारिधाराव्रते चैव विक्षिपेद्देवपादयोः ॥
चैत्रवैशाखयोश्चैव तद्वज्ज्येष्ठे च पूजयेत् ॥ 3.215.10 ॥
मर्त्यलोके गतिं श्रेष्ठां दाल्भ्य प्राप्नोति वै नरः ॥
उत्क्रान्तिकाले कृष्णस्य स्मरणं च तथाश्नुते ॥ 11 ॥
आषाढे श्रावणे चैव मासि भाद्रपदे तथा ॥
तथैवाश्वयुजे मासि अनेन विधिना नरः ॥ 12 ॥
उपोष्य संपूज्य तथा केशवेति च पूजयेत् ॥
गोमूत्रप्राशनात्पूतः स्वर्गलोकगतिं व्रजेत् ॥ 13 ॥
आराधितस्य जगतामीश्वरस्याव्ययस्य च ॥
उत्क्रान्तिकाले स्मरणं केशवस्य तथाप्नुयात् ॥ 14 ॥
3.43.m:
And fixing his mind on Kṛṣṇa, intent on him, he should utter this: / 'O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, you are compassionate; become the refuge of the refuge-less!
Have mercy, O Madhusūdana, on those submerged in the ocean of worldly existence!' / Having thus propitiated him, he should observe a fast, with a controlled mind.
And on the previous day, and on the next day, having partaken of a bovine product once, / bathed, having worshipped, he should recite the name 'Kṛṣṇa' again.
And in the vow, he should pour a stream of water at the feet of the god. / He should worship likewise in Caitra and Vaiśākha, and in Jyeṣṭha.
A man indeed attains an excellent destiny in the mortal world, O Dālbhya, / and likewise at the time of death he attains remembrance of Kṛṣṇa.
In Āṣāḍha, Śrāvaṇa, and in the month of Bhādrapada, / and likewise in the month of Āśvayuja, a man according to this rule,
having fasted, having worshipped, should worship [saying] 'Keśava'. / Purified by consuming cow urine, he goes to the heavenly world.
He attains the worship of the unperishing Lord of the worlds, / and likewise at the time of death he attains remembrance of Keśava.

3.43.s:
kṣīrasya prāśanaṃ yastu vidhiṃ cemaṃ yathoditam ..
kārtikādi yathānyāyaṃ kuryānmāsacatuṣṭayam .. 15 ..
tenaiva vidhinā brahmanvipṇornāma prakīrtayet ..
sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ viṣṇuṃ smarati cākṣayam .. 16 ..
pratimāsaṃ dvijātibhyo dadyāddānaṃ yathāvidhi ..
cāturmāsye ca saṃpūrṇe puṇyaśravaṇakīrtanam .. 17 ..
atha vā vāsudevasya tadgītaṃ cāpi kārayet ..
evameti gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ devamānuṣyakīrtanāt .. 18 ..
kathitaṃ pāraṇaṃ yatte kāryaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam ..
ādhipatyaṃ tathā bhogāṃstena prāpnoti cākṣayān .. 19 ..
dvitīyena tathā bhogānaindrānāpnoti mānavaḥ ..
viṣṇulokaṃ tṛtīyena pāraṇena tathāpnuyāt .. 3.215.20 ..
evametatsamākhyātaṃ gatiprāpakamuttamam ..
vidhānaṃ dvijaśārdūla kṛṣṇatuṣṭipradaṃ nṛṇām .. 21 ..
3.43.d:
क्षीरस्य प्राशनं यस्तु विधिं चेमं यथोदितम् ॥
कार्तिकादि यथान्यायं कुर्यान्मासचतुष्टयम् ॥ 15 ॥
तेनैव विधिना ब्रह्मन्विप्णोर्नाम प्रकीर्तयेत् ॥
स याति विष्णुसालोक्यं विष्णुं स्मरति चाक्षयम् ॥ 16 ॥
प्रतिमासं द्विजातिभ्यो दद्याद्दानं यथाविधि ॥
चातुर्मास्ये च संपूर्णे पुण्यश्रवणकीर्तनम् ॥ 17 ॥
अथ वा वासुदेवस्य तद्गीतं चापि कारयेत् ॥
एवमेति गतिं श्रेष्ठां देवमानुष्यकीर्तनात् ॥ 18 ॥
कथितं पारणं यत्ते कार्यं मासचतुष्टयम् ॥
आधिपत्यं तथा भोगांस्तेन प्राप्नोति चाक्षयान् ॥ 19 ॥
द्वितीयेन तथा भोगानैन्द्रानाप्नोति मानवः ॥
विष्णुलोकं तृतीयेन पारणेन तथाप्नुयात् ॥ 3.215.20 ॥
एवमेतत्समाख्यातं गतिप्रापकमुत्तमम् ॥
विधानं द्विजशार्दूल कृष्णतुष्टिप्रदं नृणाम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.43.m:
He who consumes milk and performs this rule as prescribed / properly for the four months beginning with Kārtika,
by that very rule, O brahmin, he should recite the name of Viṣṇu. / He goes to the world of Viṣṇu and remembers imperishable Viṣṇu.
Each month he should give a donation to twice-borns according to rule; / and when the four months are complete, recitation and listening to meritorious [texts] [should be done].
Or else he should cause singing for Vāsudeva to be performed. / Thus he attains an exalted destination through the praising of gods and men.
The fast-breaking which was described to you is to be performed for four months; / by it he attains sovereignty and imperishable pleasures.
By the second [fast-breaking], a man obtains pleasures belonging to Indra; / by the third fast-breaking, he likewise attains the world of Viṣṇu.
Thus this supreme ritual, which brings about a good destiny / and gives satisfaction to Kṛṣṇa, has been declared to men, O tiger among twice-borns.

3.43.s:
sugatidvādaśīmetāṃ śraddadhānastu yo naraḥ ..
upoṣyati tathā nārī prāpnoti vividhāṃ gatim .. 22 ..
eṣā tithiḥ pāpaharātidhanyā nākapradā nākakarī tathoktā..
ārādhanārthaṃ tridaśeśvarasya devasya viṣṇordvijasaṃghapūjya .. 23 ..
3.43.d:
सुगतिद्वादशीमेतां श्रद्दधानस्तु यो नरः ॥
उपोष्यति तथा नारी प्राप्नोति विविधां गतिम् ॥ 22 ॥
एषा तिथिः पापहरातिधन्या नाकप्रदा नाककरी तथोक्ता॥
आराधनार्थं त्रिदशेश्वरस्य देवस्य विष्णोर्द्विजसंघपूज्य ॥ 23 ॥
3.43.m:
That man who, possessing faith, fasts on this Sugatidvādaśī, / or likewise a woman, attains various [favourable] destinies.
This lunar day, destroying sin, most auspicious, granting heaven and making heaven, is thus described / for the sake of worshipping the god Viṣṇu, lord of the thirty gods, O one revered by hosts of twice-borns.

3.44.s:
3.216
pulastya uvāca ..
pañcadaśyāṃ tu śuklasya phālgunasyaiva sattama ..
pāṣaṇḍānpatitāṃścaiva tathaivāntyāvasāyinaḥ .. 1 ..
3.44.d:
3.216
पुलस्त्य उवाच ॥
पञ्चदश्यां तु शुक्लस्य फाल्गुनस्यैव सत्तम ॥
पाषण्डान्पतितांश्चैव तथैवान्त्यावसायिनः ॥ 1 ॥
3.44.m: 3.216 / Pulastya said: / On the fifteenth day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna, O best of men, / [avoiding] heretics, fallen men, and outcasts,

3.44.s:
nāstikāñcitravṛttīṃśca pāpānanyāṃśca nālapet ..
nārāyaṇaṃ tvekamanāḥ puruṣo niyatendriyaḥ ..2..
3.44.d:
नास्तिकाञ्चित्रवृत्तींश्च पापानन्यांश्च नालपेत् ॥
नारायणं त्वेकमनाः पुरुषो नियतेन्द्रियः ॥2॥
3.44.m: unbelievers, those of crooked conduct, and other sinners, he should not converse [with them]. / But with a single mind, his senses restrained, a man [intent on] Nārāyaṇa,

3.44.s:
tiṣṭhanvrajanpraskhalite kṣute cāpi janārdanam ..
kīrtanaṃ tatkriyākāle saptakṛtvaḥ prakīrtayet ..3 ..
3.44.d:
तिष्ठन्व्रजन्प्रस्खलिते क्षुते चापि जनार्दनम् ॥
कीर्तनं तत्क्रियाकाले सप्तकृत्वः प्रकीर्तयेत् ॥3 ॥
3.44.m: standing, walking, even when stumbling or sneezing, should chant [the name of] Janārdana; / at the time of that action he should chant it seven times.

3.44.s:
lakṣmyā samanvitaṃ devaṃ tvarcayecca janārdanam ..
sandhyādyaparame cendusvarūpaṃ harimīśvaram .. 4 ..
3.44.d:
लक्ष्म्या समन्वितं देवं त्वर्चयेच्च जनार्दनम् ॥
सन्ध्याद्यपरमे चेन्दुस्वरूपं हरिमीश्वरम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.44.m: And he should worship the god Janārdana united with Lakṣmī. / At the first twilight and in the evening, [he should worship] Hari, the Lord whose form is the moon.

3.44.s:
rātrīṃ lakṣmīṃ ca saṃcintya samyagarghyeṇa pūjayet ..
naktaṃ ca bhuñjīta narastailakṣāravivarjitam .. 5 ..
3.44.d:
रात्रीं लक्ष्मीं च संचिन्त्य सम्यगर्घ्येण पूजयेत् ॥
नक्तं च भुञ्जीत नरस्तैलक्षारविवर्जितम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.44.m: Meditating on night and Lakṣmī, he should properly worship with an offering of water. / And a man should eat at night, free from oil and salt.

3.44.s:
tathaiva caitravaiśākhajyeṣṭheṣu munisattama ..
arcayettu tathā proktaṃ prāpteprāpte tu taddine .. 6 .
3.44.d:
तथैव चैत्रवैशाखज्येष्ठेषु मुनिसत्तम ॥
अर्चयेत्तु तथा प्रोक्तं प्राप्तेप्राप्ते तु तद्दिने ॥ 6 ।
3.44.m: Likewise in Caitra, Vaiśākha, and Jyeṣṭha, O best of sages, / he should worship as prescribed as each day arrives.

3.44.s:
niṣpāditaṃ bhavedekaṃ pāraṇaṃ dālbhya bhaktitaḥ ..
dvitīyaṃ cāpi vakṣyāmi pāraṇaṃ dvijasattama .. 7 ..
3.44.d:
निष्पादितं भवेदेकं पारणं दाल्भ्य भक्तितः ॥
द्वितीयं चापि वक्ष्यामि पारणं द्विजसत्तम ॥ 7 ॥
3.44.m: One fast-breaking would thus be accomplished with devotion, O Dālbhya; / and I shall declare the second fast-breaking, O best of twice-borns.

3.44.s:
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe cāpi prāpte bhādrapade tathā ..
tathaivāśvayujebhyarcya śrīdharaṃ vai śriyā saha ..
samyakcandramaso dattvā bhuñjītārghaṃ yathāvidhi .. 8 ..
3.44.d:
आषाढे श्रावणे चापि प्राप्ते भाद्रपदे तथा ॥
तथैवाश्वयुजेभ्यर्च्य श्रीधरं वै श्रिया सह ॥
सम्यक्चन्द्रमसो दत्त्वा भुञ्जीतार्घं यथाविधि ॥ 8 ॥
3.44.m: In Āṣāḍha and Śrāvaṇa, and likewise when Bhādrapada has arrived, / and similarly in Āśvayuja, having worshipped Śrīdhara together with Śrī, / and having duly offered an argha-offering to the moon, one should eat in accordance with the rule.

3.44.s:
dvitīyametadākhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ śṛṇu ..
kārtikādiṣu māseṣu tathaivābhyarcya keśavam .. 9 ..
3.44.d:
द्वितीयमेतदाख्यातं तृतीयं पारणं शृणु ॥
कार्तिकादिषु मासेषु तथैवाभ्यर्च्य केशवम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.44.m: This is declared to be the second. Hear now the third breaking of the fast: / in the months beginning with Kārtika, having likewise worshipped Keśava,

3.44.s:
bhūmyā samanvitaṃ dadyācchaśāṅkāyārhaṇaṃ niśi ..
bhuñjīta ca yathākhyātaṃ tṛtīyamiti pāraṇam .. 3.216.10 ..
3.44.d:
भूम्या समन्वितं दद्याच्छशाङ्कायार्हणं निशि ॥
भुञ्जीत च यथाख्यातं तृतीयमिति पारणम् ॥ 3.216.10 ॥
3.44.m: accompanied by Bhūmi, one should offer an oblation to the moon at night / and eat as described; this is the third breaking of the fast.

3.44.s:
pratipūjāsu dadyācca brāhmaṇebhyaśca dakṣiṇām ..
pratimāsaṃ ca vakṣyāmi prāśanaṃ kāyaśuddhaye .. .. 11 ..
3.44.d:
प्रतिपूजासु दद्याच्च ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् ॥
प्रतिमासं च वक्ष्यामि प्राशनं कायशुद्धये ॥ ॥ 11 ॥
3.44.m: At each worship, one should give a sacrificial fee to brahmins. / And I will describe what must be consumed month by month for the purification of the body:

3.44.s:
prathamāṃścaturo māsānpañcagavyamudāhṛtam ..
kuśodakaṃ tathaivānyaduktaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam .. 12 ..
3.44.d:
प्रथमांश्चतुरो मासान्पञ्चगव्यमुदाहृतम् ॥
कुशोदकं तथैवान्यदुक्तं मासचतुष्टयम् ॥ 12 ॥
3.44.m: for the first four months, the five products of the cow are prescribed; / water with kuśa grass is declared for another four months;

3.44.s:
sūryāṃśutaptaṃ tadvacca jalaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam ..
gītavādyādikaṃ pāṭhyaṃ tathā kṛṣṇasya vā kathām .. 13 ..
3.44.d:
सूर्यांशुतप्तं तद्वच्च जलं मासचतुष्टयम् ॥
गीतवाद्यादिकं पाठ्यं तथा कृष्णस्य वा कथाम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.44.m: likewise, water heated by the rays of the sun for four months. / Songs, instrumental music, and the like should be recited, or the tale of Kṛṣṇa.

3.44.s:
kārayettu ca devasya pāraṇaṃ pāraṇe gate ..
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatsapatnīkaṃ janārdanam.. .. 14 ..
3.44.d:
कारयेत्तु च देवस्य पारणं पारणे गते ॥
एवं संपूज्य विधिवत्सपत्नीकं जनार्दनम्॥ ॥ 14 ॥
3.44.m: When the breaking of the fast has passed, one should perform the breaking of the fast of the god. / Having thus duly worshipped Janārdana together with his consort,

3.44.s:
nāpnotīṣṭaviyogārtiṃ pumānyoṣittathāpi vā ..
janārdanaṃ salakṣmīkamarcayetprathamaṃ tataḥ .. 15 ..
3.44.d:
नाप्नोतीष्टवियोगार्तिं पुमान्योषित्तथापि वा ॥
जनार्दनं सलक्ष्मीकमर्चयेत्प्रथमं ततः ॥ 15 ॥
3.44.m: a man or a woman suffers no agony of separation from beloved ones. / Then one should first worship Janārdana accompanied by Lakṣmī,

3.44.s:
saśrīkaṃ śrīdharaṃ bhaktyā tṛtīye bhūtikeśavau ..
yāvantyetadvidhānena pāraṇānyarcayetprabhum ..
tāvanti janmāni sukhaṃ prāpnotīṣṭaviyogajam .. 16 ..
3.44.d:
सश्रीकं श्रीधरं भक्त्या तृतीये भूतिकेशवौ ॥
यावन्त्येतद्विधानेन पारणान्यर्चयेत्प्रभुम् ॥
तावन्ति जन्मानि सुखं प्राप्नोतीष्टवियोगजम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.44.m: in the second Śrīdhara accompanied by Śrī with devotion, and in the third Bhūti and Keśava. / For as many breakings of the fast as one worships the Lord according to this rule, / for so many births one attains happiness born of separation from sorrow.

3.44.s:
prāpnoti devasmaraṇe ca mṛtyau tadāpi cāpnoti manonukūlām ..
gatiṃ dvijaśreṣṭha tatopi kāle sāyujyamāyāti janārdanasya .. 17 ..
3.217
.. pulastya uvāca ..
śṛṇu dālbhya paraṃ kāmaṃ vrataṃ santatidaṃ nṛṇām ..
yadupoṣya na vicchedaḥ pitṛpiṇḍasya jāyate .. 1 ..
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caitramāse snāto niyatamānasaḥ ..
kṛṣṇamabhyarcya pūjāṃ ca devakyāḥ kurute naraḥ .. 2 ..
nirāhāro japannāma kṛṣṇasya jagataḥ pateḥ..
upaviṣṭo vrajan snātaḥ kṣutapraskhalanādiṣu .. 3 ..
pūjāyāṃ cāpi kṛṣṇasya saptavārānprakīrtayet ..
pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthānnālapeccaiva nāstikān .. 4 ..
prabhāte ca tataḥ snāto dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām ..
bhuñjīta kṛtapūjastu kṛṣṇasyaiva jagatpateḥ .. 5..
vaiśākhajyeṣṭhayoścaivaṃ pāraṇaṃ hi trimāsikam ..
upoṣya devadeveśaṃ ghṛtena snāpayeddharim .. 6 ..
3.44.d:
प्राप्नोति देवस्मरणे च मृत्यौ तदापि चाप्नोति मनोनुकूलाम् ॥
गतिं द्विजश्रेष्ठ ततोपि काले सायुज्यमायाति जनार्दनस्य ॥ 17 ॥
3.217
॥ पुलस्त्य उवाच ॥
शृणु दाल्भ्य परं कामं व्रतं सन्ततिदं नृणाम् ॥
यदुपोष्य न विच्छेदः पितृपिण्डस्य जायते ॥ 1 ॥
कृष्णाष्टम्यां चैत्रमासे स्नातो नियतमानसः ॥
कृष्णमभ्यर्च्य पूजां च देवक्याः कुरुते नरः ॥ 2 ॥
निराहारो जपन्नाम कृष्णस्य जगतः पतेः॥
उपविष्टो व्रजन् स्नातः क्षुतप्रस्खलनादिषु ॥ 3 ॥
पूजायां चापि कृष्णस्य सप्तवारान्प्रकीर्तयेत् ॥
पाषण्डिनो विकर्मस्थान्नालपेच्चैव नास्तिकान् ॥ 4 ॥
प्रभाते च ततः स्नातो दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥
भुञ्जीत कृतपूजस्तु कृष्णस्यैव जगत्पतेः ॥ 5॥
वैशाखज्येष्ठयोश्चैवं पारणं हि त्रिमासिकम् ॥
उपोष्य देवदेवेशं घृतेन स्नापयेद्धरिम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.44.m:
At death, one attains mindfulness of the god, and then also reaches a state / agreeable to the mind, O best of the twice-born; then in time one attains union with Janārdana.
Pulastya said: / Listen, O Dālbhya, to this supreme desire-granting observance that bestows offspring upon men, / fasting during which, no interruption of the ancestral rice-ball occurs.
On the eighth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Caitra, having bathed with a controlled mind, / a man, having worshipped Kṛṣṇa, performs the worship of Devakī.
Fasting, reciting the name of Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of the world, / whether seated, walking, or bathed, during sneezing, stumbling, and the like,
and during the worship of Kṛṣṇa, he should proclaim it seven times. / He must not converse with heretics, those living outside prescribed duties, or non-believers.
Then at dawn, having bathed, given a sacrificial fee to a brahmin, / and having performed the worship of Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of the world, he should eat.
And likewise in Vaiśākha and Jyeṣṭha: this is indeed a three-month breaking of the fast. / Having fasted, one should bathe Hari, the Lord of the god of gods, with ghee.

3.44.s:
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe caiva māsi bhādrapade tathā ..
upoṣyate dvitīyaṃ vai ghṛtena snapayeddharim ..7 ..
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe caiva māsi bhādrapade tathā ..
upoṣyate dvitīyaṃ vai pāraṇaṃ pūrvavadbhavet .. 8 ..
āśvine kārtike saumye tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ tathā ..
pauṣe māghe phālgune ca caturthaṃ dvijasattama .. 9 ..
pāraṇe pāraṇe pūrṇe ghṛtena snāpayeddharim ..
brāhmaṇebhyo ghṛtaṃ dadyāttathaiva pratipāraṇam .. 3.217.10 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ nākamanuprayāti mānuṣyamāsādya ca nirvṛtaḥ syāt..
santānavṛddhiśca tathāpnute'sau yāvanmahī sāgaramekhalāntā..11..
3.218
pulastya uvāca..āṣāḍhaśuklapakṣe tu bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ ..
bhogibhāge nijāṃ māyāṃ yoganidrāṃ ca mānayet..1..
śete'sau caturomāsānyāvadbhavati kārtikam..
viśiṣṭā na pravartante tadā yajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ..2..
3.44.d:
आषाढे श्रावणे चैव मासि भाद्रपदे तथा ॥
उपोष्यते द्वितीयं वै घृतेन स्नपयेद्धरिम् ॥7 ॥
आषाढे श्रावणे चैव मासि भाद्रपदे तथा ॥
उपोष्यते द्वितीयं वै पारणं पूर्ववद्भवेत् ॥ 8 ॥
आश्विने कार्तिके सौम्ये तृतीयं पारणं तथा ॥
पौषे माघे फाल्गुने च चतुर्थं द्विजसत्तम ॥ 9 ॥
पारणे पारणे पूर्णे घृतेन स्नापयेद्धरिम् ॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो घृतं दद्यात्तथैव प्रतिपारणम् ॥ 3.217.10 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं नाकमनुप्रयाति मानुष्यमासाद्य च निर्वृतः स्यात्॥
सन्तानवृद्धिश्च तथाप्नुतेऽसौ यावन्मही सागरमेखलान्ता॥11॥
3.218
पुलस्त्य उवाच॥आषाढशुक्लपक्षे तु भगवान्मधुसूदनः ॥
भोगिभागे निजां मायां योगनिद्रां च मानयेत्॥1॥
शेतेऽसौ चतुरोमासान्यावद्भवति कार्तिकम्॥
विशिष्टा न प्रवर्तन्ते तदा यज्ञादिकाः क्रियाः॥2॥
3.44.m:
In Āṣāḍha and Śrāvaṇa, and likewise in the month of Bhādrapada, / the second is fasted; one should bathe Hari with ghee.
In Āṣāḍha and Śrāvaṇa, and likewise in the month of Bhādrapada, / the second is fasted; the breaking of the fast should be as before.
In Āśvina, Kārtika, and Mārgaśīrṣa is the third breaking of the fast; / in Pauṣa, Māgha, and Phālguna is the fourth, O best of the twice-born.
When each breaking of the fast is complete, one should bathe Hari with ghee; / one should likewise give ghee to brahmins at each breaking of the fast.
Having performed the observance, he departs to heaven, and upon attaining human birth, he becomes happy; / he also attains increase of progeny as long as the earth is girdled by the oceans.
Pulastya said: / In the bright fortnight of Āṣāḍha, the blessed Madhusūdana / observes his own cosmic power and yogic sleep on the body of the serpent.
He sleeps for four months until Kārtika arrives; / during that time, special rites such as sacrifices are not undertaken.

3.44.s:
tatrāṣāḍhasitānte ca yo naro dinapañcakam ..
adhaḥśāyī bahiḥ snāyī māṃsābhyaṅgavivarjitaḥ .. 3 ..
vṛntākālābukūṣmāṇḍamadhukṣāravivarjitaḥ ..
samastamadirāvarjī sakṛnnaktāśano bhavet ..4..
brahmacārī jitakrodho japahomaparāyaṇaḥ..
hariṃ saṃpūjayennityaṃ gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā .. 5 ..
gītairvādyaistathā nṛttairdīpamālābhireva ca ..
sānnānāṃ jaladhenūnāṃ pradānena tathaiva ca .. 6 ..
tathā kārtikaśuklānte tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ bhaveta ..7..
hiṃsātmakaistu kiṃ tasya yajñaiḥ kāryaṃ mahātmanaḥ ..
prasvāpe ca prabodhe ca pūjito yena keśavaḥ .. 8 ..

agniṣṭomamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet .. 9 ..

3.44.d:
तत्राषाढसितान्ते च यो नरो दिनपञ्चकम् ॥
अधःशायी बहिः स्नायी मांसाभ्यङ्गविवर्जितः ॥ 3 ॥
वृन्ताकालाबुकूष्माण्डमधुक्षारविवर्जितः ॥
समस्तमदिरावर्जी सकृन्नक्ताशनो भवेत् ॥4॥
ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधो जपहोमपरायणः॥
हरिं संपूजयेन्नित्यं गन्धमाल्यान्नसंपदा ॥ 5 ॥
गीतैर्वाद्यैस्तथा नृत्तैर्दीपमालाभिरेव च ॥
सान्नानां जलधेनूनां प्रदानेन तथैव च ॥ 6 ॥
तथा कार्तिकशुक्लान्ते तृतीयं पारणं भवेत ॥7॥
हिंसात्मकैस्तु किं तस्य यज्ञैः कार्यं महात्मनः ॥
प्रस्वापे च प्रबोधे च पूजितो येन केशवः ॥ 8 ॥
दशाहमेतत्कृत्वा तु व्रतं विष्णुपरो नरः ॥
अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत् ॥ 9 ॥
कार्तिकश्चाग्निदैवत्यो मासो देवमुखः स्मृतः ॥
आश्वयुज्यामतीतायां यावत्स्याद्द्विज कार्तिकी ॥ 3.218.10 ॥
3.44.m:
At the end of the bright fortnight of Āṣāḍha, a man who for five days / sleeps on the ground, bathes outdoors, abstains from meat and unction,
abstains from eggplant, bottle gourd, pumpkin, honey, and alkaline substances, / avoids all intoxicating liquor, and eats once only at night,
celibate, having conquered anger, dedicated to silent recitation and burnt offerings, / should worship Hari constantly with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, and food,
with songs, instrumental music, and dances, with garlands of lamps, / and likewise through the gift of cows made of water together with food—
likewise, at the end of the bright fortnight of Kārtika, the third breaking of the fast takes place.
What need has that great-souled man of violent sacrifices, / by whom Keśava has been worshipped at his falling asleep and at his awakening?
Having performed this ten-day observance, a man devoted to Viṣṇu / obtains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma and delivers his family.
Kārtika is the month having Agni as deity, remembered as the mouth of the gods. / When the full moon of Āśvayuja has passed, until the full moon of Kārtika, O twice-born,

3.44.d:
व्रतं दशाहाभिहितं कृत्वा स्वर्गे महीयते ॥ ॥
पौण्डरीकमवाप्नोति कुलमुद्धरति स्वकम् ॥ 11 ॥
प्रत्यहं दीपदानेन कार्तिकाभिमुखो भवेत् ॥
चक्षुष्मान्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ तथा सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥ 12 ॥
एतावन्तं तथा कालं सर्वमांसविवर्जितः ॥
स्वर्गलोकात्परिभ्रष्टो मानुष्ये सुखमाप्नुयात् ॥ 13 ॥
आरोग्यसुखसम्पत्त्या युक्तश्च सुभगो भवेत् ॥
प्रसुप्ते देवदेवेशे सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 14 ॥
दशाहमुदितं कृत्वा खड्गधाराव्रतं नरः ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥ 15 ॥
मासं च कार्तिकं कृत्वा पौण्डरीकमवाप्नुयात् ॥
कृत्वा मासं यथेष्टं च वह्निष्टोममवाप्नुयात् ॥। 16 ॥
कृत्वा च चतुरो मासान्सुप्ते मधुनिषूदने ॥
अश्वमेधफलं प्राप्य नाकपृष्ठे महीयते ॥ 17 ॥
3.44.m:
having performed the declared ten-day observance, he is honored in heaven; / he obtains the fruit of the Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice and delivers his own family.
By giving a lamp every day, he becomes turned toward Kārtika; / endowed with good eyesight, O best of brahmins, he is honoured everywhere.
Abstaining from all meat for that length of time, / after falling from the heavenly world, he attains happiness in human birth;
endowed with the attainment of health and happiness, he becomes fortunate. / While the Lord of the god of gods is asleep, he obtains all desires.
A man, having performed the ten-day sword-edge observance as described, / enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice complete with all desired objects.
Having performed it for the month of Kārtika, he obtains the Pauṇḍarīka; / having performed it according to his pleasure for a month, he obtains the Agniṣṭoma.
Having performed it for four months while Madhuniṣūdana is asleep, / having obtained the fruit of the horse sacrifice, he is honoured on the summit of heaven.

3.44.s:
asidhārāvrataṃ kṛtvā tathā saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ ..
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇuloke ca gacchati .. 18 ..
3.44.d:
असिधाराव्रतं कृत्वा तथा संवत्सरं नरः ॥
सर्वयज्ञफलं प्राप्य विष्णुलोके च गच्छति ॥ 18 ॥
3.44.m: A man, having thus performed the sword-edge observance for a whole year, / having obtained the fruit of all sacrifices, goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

3.44.s:
yenayena tu kāmena khaḍgadhārāvrataṃ caret ..
taṃtaṃ kāmamavāpnoti viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 19 ..
3.44.d:
येनयेन तु कामेन खड्गधाराव्रतं चरेत् ॥
तंतं काममवाप्नोति विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥ 19 ॥
3.44.m: With whatever desire one undertakes the sword-edge observance, / he attains that very desire and is honoured in the world of Viṣṇu.

3.44.s:
tathā samartho bhavati dāne ca varaśāpayoḥ ..
ādityatejā bhavati nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..3.218.20..
3.44.d:
तथा समर्थो भवति दाने च वरशापयोः ॥
आदित्यतेजा भवति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥3.218.20॥
3.44.m: Likewise, he becomes capable of giving boons and curses; / he becomes endowed with the splendour of the sun; there is no doubt about this.

3.44.s:
dālbhya uvāca ..
asidhārāvratavidhiḥ samācakṣva mahādyute ..
etanme saṃśayaṃ cchindhi tvaṃ hi sarvaviducyase .. 21 ..
3.44.d:
दाल्भ्य उवाच ॥
असिधाराव्रतविधिः समाचक्ष्व महाद्युते ॥
एतन्मे संशयं च्छिन्धि त्वं हि सर्वविदुच्यसे ॥ 21 ॥
3.44.m:
Dālbhya said:
Declare to me the rule for the razor’s edge observance, O one of great splendour; / cut away this doubt of mine, for you are said to know all.

3.44.s:
pulastya uvāca ..

kṛtadaivata pūjastu strīsahāyaḥ svapenniśi .. 22 ..

पुलस्त्य उवाच ॥
स्नातः स्वलंकृतः स्रग्वी भुक्तवान्मांसवर्जितम् ॥
कृतदैवत पूजस्तु स्त्रीसहायः स्वपेन्निशि ॥ 22 ॥
3.44.m:
Pulastya said:
Having bathed, well adorned, wearing a garland, having eaten food free of meat, / having worshipped the deities, he should sleep at night accompanied by a woman.

3.44.s:
brahmacārī dvijaśreṣṭha khaḍgadhārāvrataṃ caran ..
apūrvā cāsya pūrvāśca samāliṃgya svapenniśi .. 23 ..
3.44.d:
ब्रह्मचारी द्विजश्रेष्ठ खड्गधाराव्रतं चरन् ॥
अपूर्वा चास्य पूर्वाश्च समालिंग्य स्वपेन्निशि ॥ 23 ॥
3.44.m: Remaining celibate, O best of the twice-born, while observing the razor’s edge observance, / embracing both a woman known before and one not known before, he should sleep at night.

3.44.s:
brahmacārī śataguṇaṃ phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam ..
atīva duṣkaramidaṃ khaḍgadhārāvrataṃ smṛtam .. 24 ..
3.44.d:
ब्रह्मचारी शतगुणं फलमाप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥
अतीव दुष्करमिदं खड्गधाराव्रतं स्मृतम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.44.m: Remaining celibate, he obtains a hundredfold reward without doubt; / this razor’s edge observance is considered exceedingly difficult to perform.

3.44.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ dvādaśavatsarāṇi trailokyarājyaṃ dhruvamāpnuyācca ..
bhuktvā ciraṃ taddvijamukhya cānte sāyujyamāyāti janārdanasya ..25..
3.219
pulastya uvāca ..
māsi proṣṭhapapade śukle dvādaśyāṃ jalaśāyinam ..
praṇamyānantamabhyarcya puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ śuciḥ .. 1 ..
pāṣaṇḍādibhirālāpamakurvanniyamātmavān ..
jaladhenuṃ dvije dattvā naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .. 2 ..
tiṣṭhaṃsthito vrajaṃścaiva kṣutapraskhalanādiṣu ..
anantanāmasmaraṇaṃ kurvannuccāraṇaṃ naraḥ .. 3 ..
anenaiva vidhānena māsadvādaśa vai kramāt ..
upoṣya pāraṇe pūrṇe dadyādvipreṣu dakṣiṇām .. 4 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ dvādaśametadiṣṭaṃ prāpnotyanaṃtāni phalāni vipra ..
samyakkṛtānāṃ niyamavratānāṃ cānantamārādhya na saṃśayotra .. 5 ..
3.44.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं द्वादशवत्सराणि त्रैलोक्यराज्यं ध्रुवमाप्नुयाच्च ॥
भुक्त्वा चिरं तद्द्विजमुख्य चान्ते सायुज्यमायाति जनार्दनस्य ॥25॥
3.219
पुलस्त्य उवाच ॥
मासि प्रोष्ठपपदे शुक्ले द्वादश्यां जलशायिनम् ॥
प्रणम्यानन्तमभ्यर्च्य पुष्पधूपादिभिः शुचिः ॥ 1 ॥
पाषण्डादिभिरालापमकुर्वन्नियमात्मवान् ॥
जलधेनुं द्विजे दत्त्वा नक्तं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः ॥ 2 ॥
तिष्ठंस्थितो व्रजंश्चैव क्षुतप्रस्खलनादिषु ॥
अनन्तनामस्मरणं कुर्वन्नुच्चारणं नरः ॥ 3 ॥
अनेनैव विधानेन मासद्वादश वै क्रमात् ॥
उपोष्य पारणे पूर्णे दद्याद्विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् ॥ 4 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं द्वादशमेतदिष्टं प्राप्नोत्यनंतानि फलानि विप्र ॥
सम्यक्कृतानां नियमव्रतानां चानन्तमाराध्य न संशयोत्र ॥ 5 ॥
3.44.m:
Having performed the observance for twelve years, he surely obtains the sovereignty of the three worlds; / having enjoyed that for a long time, O foremost of the twice-born, he attains absorption into Janārdana at the end.
3.219
Pulastya said:
In the month of Proṣṭhapada, during the bright fortnight on the twelfth day, one should bow to him who sleeps upon the waters, / and having worshipped Ananta with flowers, incense, and other offerings, being pure,
not conversing with heretics and the like, self-restrained in vows, / having given a water-cow to a twice-born, one should eat at night, restrained in speech.
Standing, staying, and walking, and during sneezing, stumbling, and the like, / a man should constantly remember and recite the name of Ananta.
By this very rule successively for twelve months indeed, / having fasted, when the breaking of the fast is complete, he should give a sacrificial fee to brahmins.
Having performed this beloved observance for twelve [months], one obtains endless fruits, O brahmin; / and by worshipping Ananta through vows and observances properly performed, there is no doubt in this.

3.44.s:
3.220
pulastya uvāca ..
pauṣamāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ śakradaivatam ..
nakṣatrayogaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca prathamaṃ tu samarcayet ..1..
tataḥ prabhṛti viprendra māsimāsi janārdanam ..
upoṣitaḥ pūjayate yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ gatam .. 2 ..

prācyaṃ yathāvadvidhivatkrameṇa taducyamānaṃ nikhilaṃ nibodha .. 3..
ghṛtaṃ yathā vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ yavānnamaṃbhaḥ kanakānupānam ..
chatraṃ payonnaṃ guḍaphāṇitāḍhyaṃ srakcandane vastramanukrameṇa .. 4 ..

sūryāṃśutaptaṃ jalamāśu darbhaṃ kṣīraṃ ca māsaṃ kramaśaḥ prayuñjyāta..5..

prāpnoti janmāvikalendriyaśca bhavatyarogo matimānsukhī ca .. 6 ..
samāptaḥ pulastyadālbhyasaṃvādaḥ ..
3.44.d:
3.220
पुलस्त्य उवाच ॥
पौषमासे सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां शक्रदैवतम् ॥
नक्षत्रयोगं विष्णुं च प्रथमं तु समर्चयेत् ॥1॥
ततः प्रभृति विप्रेन्द्र मासिमासि जनार्दनम् ॥
उपोषितः पूजयते यावत्संवत्सरं गतम् ॥ 2 ॥
मासेथ मासे विधिनोदितेन रम्यां तिथौ दानमथ ब्रवीमि ॥
प्राच्यं यथावद्विधिवत्क्रमेण तदुच्यमानं निखिलं निबोध ॥ 3॥
घृतं यथा व्रीहियवं हिरण्यं यवान्नमंभः कनकानुपानम् ॥
छत्रं पयोन्नं गुडफाणिताढ्यं स्रक्चन्दने वस्त्रमनुक्रमेण ॥ 4 ॥
गोमूत्रमंभो घृतमांसशाकं दूर्वादधिव्रीहियवं तिलांश्च ॥
सूर्यांशुतप्तं जलमाशु दर्भं क्षीरं च मासं क्रमशः प्रयुञ्ज्यात॥5॥
कुले प्रधाने धनधान्यपूर्णं विवेकवान्यस्तु समस्तदुःखे॥
प्राप्नोति जन्माविकलेन्द्रियश्च भवत्यरोगो मतिमान्सुखी च ॥ 6 ॥
समाप्तः पुलस्त्यदाल्भ्यसंवादः ॥
3.44.m:
3.220
Pulastya said:
In the month of Pauṣa, on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight, having Śakra as its deity, / one should first worship Viṣṇu in conjunction with the asterism.
From that time forward, O lord of brahmins, month by month he worships Janārdana / fasting, until a year has passed.
Now I shall declare the gift on that charming lunar day, month by month according to the prescribed rule; / learn all of that as it is declared, performed properly and in order according to tradition:
ghee, likewise rice and barley, gold, barley-food, water, gold with a drink, / an umbrella, milk-rice rich in jaggery and molasses, a garland and sandalwood, and a garment in succession;
cow-urine, water, ghee, meat and greens, dūrvā grass, curd, rice, barley, and sesame seeds, / water heated by the sun’s rays, quick darbha grass, and milk: he should consume [these] month by month in order.
One obtains birth in an eminent family, full of wealth and grain, / discerning in all adversity, with unimpaired faculties, and becomes free from illness, intelligent, and happy.
The dialogue between Pulastya and Dālbhya is ended.
